safi-cedvel:30-30.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive — or resumptive — (لو ترى إذ وقفوا) like the previous one; (على رب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وقفوا), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (قال) a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "huwa", i.e. Allah; (الهمزة) for rebuking interrogation; (ليس) an incomplete, non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb; (ها) a particle of alerting; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as the noun of laysa; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (الحق) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of laysa; (قالوا) its i'rab has passed; (بلى) a particle of answer with no grammatical position; (الواو) the wāw of oath; (ربّ) genitive by the wāw, attached to an implied verb "uqsimu" (I swear), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (قال) like the first; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (ذوقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (العذاب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الباء) a preposition of causation; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (ذوقوا), with the returning pronoun omitted, i.e. "takfurūna bihi".], (كنتم) an incomplete past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (تم) a pronoun, the noun of kāna, in the position of nominative; (تكفرون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كنتم ...) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (ذوقوا).
The clause «ترى....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the first clause «ترى» [Note: In verse (27) of this sūra.] .... or resumptive.
The clause «وقفوا....» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi ... and the jawāb of law is omitted, its implied form being "لرأيت أمرا عظيما" (you would have seen a terrible matter).
The clause «قال....» has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ربهم», with "qad" implied.].
The clause «أليس هذا بالحق» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «قالوا....» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause « (نقسم) » بربنا» has no grammatical position, parenthetical ... and the implied answer clause after the oath is the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «قال ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ذوقوا ... » is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you disbelieved in the world, then taste", and the condition with its apodosis is the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «كنتم تكفرون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle (ما) or the nominal (ما).
The clause «تكفرون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of kuntum.

* Rhetoric:
1- Implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «فَذُوقُوا الْعَذابَ», where tasting is borrowed for the punishment they will meet.
2- Representation (al-tamthīl): i.e. the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَلَوْ تَرى إِذْ وُقِفُوا عَلى رَبِّهِمْ» is a representation of their being detained for questioning and rebuke, or a metonymy (kināya) for it according to those who do not stipulate in it the possibility of the literal meaning.

* Benefits:
1- The grammarians divided the prepositions into three kinds:
original (aṣlī), redundant (zāʾid), and resembling the redundant (shabīh bi-l-zāʾid)..
They clarified the differences between these three groups as follows:
First: the original one needs an attachment (taʿlīq) and cannot be dispensed with, neither in meaning nor in i'rab, e.g. «قرأت في الكتاب» (I read in the book).
The second: the redundant, which cannot be dispensed with in i'rab and does not need an attachment; likewise it cannot be dispensed with in meaning, because it is brought only to emphasize the content of the speech, e.g. «ما جاءنا من أحد» (not anyone came to us) and «وليس سعيد بمسافر» (Saʿīd is not travelling).
The third: the one resembling the redundant, which cannot be dispensed with in wording or in meaning, but it does not need an attachment.
It is five particles: «ربّ وخلا وعدا وحاشى ولعلّ».
It resembles the redundant in one respect, since it does not need something to attach to, and resembles the original in another respect, since it cannot be dispensed with in wording or meaning.

safi-cedvel:31-31.t:
* I'rab:
(قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (خسر) a past verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (كذّبوا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (بلقاء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كذّبوا); (الله) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (حتى إذا جاءتهم الساعة) like its counterpart above [Note: In verse (25) of this sūra.]; (بغتة) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "mubāghitatan" (suddenly) [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being a kind of it, i.e. "they were visited with a sudden coming".]; (قالوا) like كذّبوا; (يا) a particle of vocative and lament; (حسرتنا) the one addressed, a muḍāf, accusative, and «نا» a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (على) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to «الحسرة», with the returning pronoun omitted.]; (فرّطنا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... (نا) the fāʿil; (في) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (فرط).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما فرّطنا) is in the position of genitive, attached to «الحسرة». (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يحملون) like تكفرون [Note: In the previous verse (30).] [Translator's note: the head word (أوزار) appears to have dropped out of the source here; what follows refers to it.] mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (على ظهور) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يحملون), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ألا) a particle of alerting; (ساء) a past verb for expressing blame (dhamm); (ما) an indefinite qualified noun (nakira mawṣūfa) in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of sāʾa [Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be accusative as a tamyīz (specification), specifying the necessarily latent pronoun that is the fāʿil of sāʾa.]; (يزرون) like يحملون ... and the specified object of blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "ḥimluhum dhāka" (that carrying of theirs).
The clause «قد خسر الذين....» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كذّبوا....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «جاءتهم الساعة» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا....» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause of lament «يا حسرتنا» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «فرّطنا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (ما) or the nominal one.
The clause «هم يحملون ... » is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of «قالوا».
The clause «يحملون....» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
The clause «ساء ما يزرون» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يزرون» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of (ما) [Note: Or in the position of accusative if (ما) is a tamyīz.].

* Morphology:
(لقاء): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb (لاقى); its pattern is فِعال with kasra on the fāʾ. In the word there is a substitution (ibdāl) of the weak letter yāʾ into hamza because it comes final after a quiescent alif; the original is لقاي.
(الساعة): a primitive (jāmid) noun meaning "time", borrowed for the Resurrection; its pattern is فَعْلة with fatḥa on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn, and its alif is converted from a wāw ... «ساع يسوع الرجل»: the man moved from hour to hour. Its plurals are ساعات and ساع.
(بغتة): the maṣdar of بغت يبغت, of the pattern-class فتح; its pattern is فَعْلة. There is another maṣdar, البغت, i.e. something coming upon one suddenly without one reckoning with it or paying it any mind; if a person sensed it and then it came quickly, it is not called «بغتة».
(حسرة): a heard maṣdar of the verb حسر يحسر, of the pattern-class فرح; its pattern is فَعْلة with fatḥa then sukūn. There is another maṣdar of the verb, حَسَر with two fatḥas. «حسر»: he grieved and yearned.
(أوزار): plural of وِزْر with kasra on the wāw, like حمل and أحمال; its verb is وزر يزر, of the pattern-class ضرب.
(يزرون): it contains a weakening (iʿlāl) by deletion because it is a mithāl weak verb whose fāʾ is deleted in the imperfect; its pattern is يَعِلون.

* Rhetoric:
1- Representative metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِلِقاءِ اللَّهِ»; meeting Allah the Exalted is a representative metaphor for the resurrection: the resurrection is likened to meeting Allah, then the thing likened is omitted and the thing it is likened to is kept.
2- Explicit representative metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya al-taṣrīḥiyya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزارَهُمْ عَلى ظُهُورِهِمْ», i.e. they carry their sins and wrongs; sins and misdeeds are made something carried on the back by way of explicit representative metaphor: sins are likened to heavy loads, then the thing likened is omitted and the thing it is likened to is kept. The intent is to show the evil of their state and the severity of the hardship and pains they find.
3- Conjunction (al-muqārana) in the noble verse: two kinds of the arts of badīʿ are joined in the speech, namely al-tankīt (the pointed subtlety) and al-mubālagha (hyperbole). One might say: what is the subtle point that favoured assigning the carrying to backs rather than heads? The answer is that the point in this is to indicate the heaviness of the loads, because backs are better able to carry heavy things than heads; and what follows from mentioning backs — the inability of heads to carry these loads — of exaggerating their heaviness is joined to the tankīt.

* Benefits:
- ألا: it is one of the particles of urging (taḥḍīḍ) and of causing regret (tandīm). Some grammarians clarified the difference between urging and causing regret, saying:
If one of these particles «هلّا وألّا ولوما وألا» enters an imperfect verb, it is for urging action and abandoning negligence of it, e.g. «هلا يرتدع فلان عن غيّه» (will so-and-so not desist from his error?); and if it enters a past verb it is for causing regret: it makes the agent regret the missing of the matter and his negligence of it, e.g. «هلّا اجتهدت» (why did you not strive?), and the saying of Allah the Exalted: أَلا ساءَ ما يَزِرُونَ

safi-cedvel:32-32.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negating, inoperative (muhmala); (الحياة) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (الدنيا) a naʿt (adjective) of «الحياة», nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (لعب) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الواو) conjunctive; (لهو) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to لعب, nominative; (الواو) conjunctive; (اللام) of inception (al-ibtidāʾ), conveying emphasis; (الدار) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الآخرة) a naʿt of «الدار», nominative; (خير) khabar, nominative; (اللام) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير»; (يتقون) like يحملون «1»; (الهمزة) for interrogation; (الفاء) resumptive [Note: The grammarians make this fāʾ conjunctive, conjoining the overt verb to an implied one, i.e. "are you heedless, so you do not understand?" ... It is observed that the implied element is a resumptive clause; therefore there is no objection to making the fāʾ resumptive; the meaning does not refuse it, nor does the craft of grammar refuse it.]; (لا) negating; (تعقلون) like يحملون «3».
The clause «ما الحياة..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «للدار الآخرة ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يتقون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «تعقلون» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(لعب): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb يلعب, of the pattern-class فرح; its pattern is فَعِل with fatḥa then kasra. There are other maṣdars of the verb: لَعْب and لِعْب, with fatḥa or kasra on the lām and sukūn on the ʿayn, and تَلْعاب with fatḥa on the tāʾ.
(لهو): a heard maṣdar of the verb لها يلهو, of the pattern-class نصع [Translator's note: so in the source; the pattern-class of لها يلهو is normally نصر]; its pattern is فَعْل with fatḥa then sukūn.
[Translator's note: the source has no «Rhetoric» heading here, though what follows is rhetoric.]
1- Eloquent simile (al-tashbīh al-balīgh): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَمَا الْحَياةُ الدُّنْيا إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ». The meaning is: the deeds of the worldly life that are particular to it are nothing but like play and amusement in their lack of benefit and permanence. So the speech is an eloquent simile even if no muḍāf is implied, and the world itself is made play and amusement by way of hyperbole, as in the saying: «إنما هي إقبال وإدبار» (she is nothing but coming and going).

safi-cedvel:33-35.t:
* I'rab:
(قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq) and emphasis; (نعلم) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "naḥnu" (We) for majesty; (إن) a particle resembling the verb, and (الهاء) the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), the noun of inna; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis; (يحزن) like نعلم, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (يقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. "yaqūlūnahu"; (الفاء) for giving the reason (taʿlīl), because the preceding statement conveys a prohibition, i.e. "do not grieve"; (إنهم) like إنّه, and the pronoun refers back to the fāʿil of يقولون; (لا) negating; (يكذبون) like يقولون, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) conjunctive; (لكن) a particle resembling the verb, for rectification (istidrāk); (الظالمين) the noun of lākinna, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يجحدون; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (يجحدون) like يقولون.
The clause «قد نعلم ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إنّه ليحزنك ...» is in the position of accusative, standing in for the two objects of نعلم; the verb has been suspended (ʿulliqa) because of the entry of the overt lām of inception into the khabar of inna [Note: The hamza of inna takes kasra because of the lām coming in its khabar.].
The clause «يحزنك..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna.
The clause «يقولون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «إنّهم لا يكذبونك» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لا يكذبونك» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «لكنّ الظالمين ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the reason-giving clause.
The clause «يجحدون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of lākinna.
(34) (الواو) conjunctive; (اللام) the lām of oath, for an implied oath; (قد) a particle of realization; (كذّبت) a past verb, passive; (التاء) for the feminine; (رسل) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذبت), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunctive; (صبروا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (على) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (كذّبوا) a past verb, passive, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; (الواو) conjunctive; (أوذوا) like كذّبوا ...
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كذّبوا) is in the position of genitive, attached to (صبروا).
(حتى) a particle of limit and genitive; (أتى) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied fatḥa, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (نصر) fāʿil, nominative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أتاهم نصرنا) is in the position of genitive by (حتى), attached to (صبروا) [Note: It is also permissible to attach it to (أوذوا) if that verb is made conjoined to (صبروا), and to (أوذوا) alone if it is made resumptive.].
(الواو) conjunctive; (لا) of generic negation; (مبدل) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (لكلمات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مبدل; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; and the khabar of lā is omitted, its implied form being "موجود" (existing); (الواو) conjunctive — or resumptive —; (اللام) occurring in the answer of an implied oath; (قد) like the first; (جاءك) like أتاهم ... and the fāʿil is omitted, indicated by the word «الرسل», the implied form being "the news has come to you"; (من نبأ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of جاء [Note: al-Akhfash permitted the preposition to be redundant so that (نبأ) is the fāʿil of جاءك, contrary to Sībawayh.], i.e. "the news has come to you, being part of the tidings of the messengers"; (المرسلين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قد كذبت رسل ... » has no grammatical position, the answer of an implied oath ...
The implied oath clause is conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «صبروا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause of the oath's answer.
The clause «كذبوا» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «أوذوا....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause صبروا [Note: It may be conjoined to the clause of the oath's answer ... or conjoined to the ṣila clause (كذّبوا), i.e. "they were patient over their being denied and harmed" ... and it may be resumptive.].
The clause «أتاهم نصرنا» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «لا مبدل لكلمات الله» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the implied oath clause [Note: It may be parenthetical.].
The clause «جاءك من نبأ....» has no grammatical position, the answer of an implied oath ... and the implied oath clause is conjoined to the first oath clause ... or is resumptive.
(35) (الواو) conjunctive; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (كان) an incomplete past verb, indeclinable, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its noun being the latent pronoun of the matter [Note: The noun may be a necessarily latent pronoun referring to (إعراض), which is contended for (mutanāzaʿ ʿalayhi) together with the verb كبر; but the i'rab above is closer to the Quranic style, and because bringing in (كان) keeps the condition in the past.]; (كبر) a past verb; (على) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (كبر); (إعراض) the fāʿil of كبر, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إن) like the first; (استطاع) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis; (التاء) a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (تبتغي) an imperfect verb, accusative, its fāʿil a latent pronoun implied as "anta"; (نفقا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تبتغي) [Note: Or attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (نفقا), or to a ḥāl of the pronoun in (تبتغي), i.e. "while you are in the earth".]; (أو) a conjunction; (سلّما) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (نفقا), accusative; (في السماء) like في الأرض.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تبتغي) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, governed by استطعت.
(الفاء) conjunctive; (تأتي) like تبتغي and conjoined to it; (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بآية) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb تأتيهم. (الواو) conjunctive; (لو) a non-jussive conditional; (شاء) like كبر; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (اللام) occurring in the answer of law; (جمع) a past verb, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (على الهدى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جمعهم), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the alif; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تكوننّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive, and the nūn is the nūn of emphasis; its noun is a latent pronoun implied as "anta"; (من الجاهلين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of تكونن, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «كان كبر ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قد نعلم.
The clause «كبر ... إعراضهم» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of kāna.
The clause «استطعت ... » is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition (إن كان).
The clause «تبتغي ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «تأتيهم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تبتغي.
The clause «لو شاء الله» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كان كبر.
The clause «جمعهم ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تكوننّ ... » is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you have known Allah's will not to guide them, then do not be ..."

* Morphology:
(أوذوا): it contains a weakening (iʿlāl) by conversion: the alif after the hamza was converted to a wāw because it came quiescent after a ḍamma — to suit the passive form. It also contains a weakening by deletion: its origin is أوذيوا with ḍamma on the yāʾ; the ḍamma was felt heavy on the yāʾ, so it was made quiescent and the vowel transferred to the dhāl; then when the quiescent yāʾ met the quiescent wāw of the plural, the yāʾ was deleted ... its pattern is فوعوا.
(أتاهم): it contains a weakening by conversion; its origin is أتي with the yāʾ vowelled with fatḥa; since the yāʾ came vowelled after a fatḥa it was converted to alif.
(نصر): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb نصر ينصر, the first pattern-class; its pattern is فَعْل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(مبدّل): an active participle from the quadriliteral (بدّل); its pattern is مُفَعِّل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the doubled ʿayn.
(المرسلين): plural of المرسل, a passive participle from the quadriliteral (أرسل); its pattern is مُفْعَل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(نفقا): a primitive (jāmid) noun meaning a tunnel in the earth with an exit to a known place; its verb is نفق ينفق, the first and fourth pattern-classes; its pattern is فَعَل with two fatḥas.
(سلّما): a primitive noun for that on which one climbs, of wood, stone or clay; it is masculine and feminine; its plurals are سلالم and سلاليم; its pattern is فُعَّل with ḍamma on the fāʾ and fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Borrowing one of two opposites for the other: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُ لَيَحْزُنُكَ».
The word «قد» is for emphasizing knowledge of what is mentioned, which conveys emphasis of the threat, as in the saying of Allah the Exalted «قَدْ يَعْلَمُ ما أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ», by taking it out into the meaning of multiplicity (taktīr), following the custom of the Arabs when intending excess in multiplying: you say to one of the army commanders "how many horsemen do you have?" and he says "rubba fārisin ʿindī" (perhaps a horseman or so is with me), meaning thereby going to lengths in multiplying his horsemen, but he wishes to show his innocence of exaggeration and to display that he understates the many he has, let alone overstating the few; and on this basis is His saying, Mighty and Majestic, «رُبَما يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ كانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ». This is a way taken only when the matter is so clear that no tinge of doubt truly hovers around it.
2- Placing the overt noun in the place of the pronoun: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَلكِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ بِآياتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ», i.e. "but they deny His signs, exalted is He"; the overt noun was put in the place of the pronoun to record against them their being firmly rooted in wrongdoing, of which this denial of theirs is one of its kinds.
3- The exquisite shift (al-iltifāt al-badīʿ): from the third-person pronoun to the first-person pronoun in the saying of Allah the Exalted «حَتَّى أَتاهُمْ نَصْرُنا», to indicate concern for the matter of the help; had the speech followed its sequence it would have been said: «نصره» (His help).

* Benefits:
1- Among the subtleties of this language and the factors of its vitality is that we find for a single particle of meaning (ḥarf al-maʿnā) several significations or several meanings that the one particle can express. The subject of this subtlety among the subtleties of the language is «اللام», and it has six meanings, which we restrict ourselves to naming for fear of lengthening: the lām of genitive, the lām of command, the lām of inception (al-ibtidāʾ), the lām of distance, the lām of answer, and the lām paving the way for an oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam).
The lām of inception has occurred in this verse [Translator's note: so in the source; the first instance is in the previous verse 32] in two places: «وللدار الآخرة» and «إِنَّهُ لَيَحْزُنُكَ», where it has shifted because of the presence of inna at the beginning of the speech.
2- Among the grammarians are those who hold that the lām of inception, when it enters a past verb, is the lām of oath, and that the oath is omitted and its answer has come accompanied by the lām. An example of that: «لَقَدْ كانَ فِي يُوسُفَ وَإِخْوَتِهِ آياتٌ لِلسَّائِلِينَ» and the saying of Allah the Exalted «لَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ», the verse.
3- The lām of inception has two benefits:
The first: emphasizing the content of the affirmative clause, and for this it is called «the lām of emphasis»; it was called the lām of inception because originally it enters the mubtadaʾ, or because it occurs at the beginning of speech.
The second: its making the khabar purely for the present; therefore the imperfect after it is purely for present time, after having been open to both present and future.

safi-cedvel:36-36.t:
* I'rab:
(إنما) the restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (يستجيب) an imperfect verb, nominative; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (يسمعون) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الواو) conjunctive; (الموتى) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (يبعث) like يستجيب, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (إلى) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يرجعون), which is an imperfect passive verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «يستجيب الذين....» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يسمعون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «الموتى يبعثهم الله» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «يبعثهم الله» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate).
The clause «يرجعون» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يبعثهم الله.

* Morphology:
(الموتى): plural of الميت.... see verse (28) of Sūrat al-Baqara.

safi-cedvel:37-37.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (قالوا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (لولا) a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) meaning «هلّا»; (نزل) a past verb, passive; (على) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نزّل); (آية) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (من رب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نزّل) [Note: It may be attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «آية».], and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (قل) an imperative verb, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "anta"; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (قادر) the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative; (على) like the first; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (ينزّل) an imperfect verb, accusative, its fāʿil a latent pronoun implied as "huwa"; (آية) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن ينزل) is in the position of genitive by (على), attached to «قادر».
(الواو) conjunctive; (لكن) a particle resembling the verb, for rectification (istidrāk); (أكثر) the noun of lākinna, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (لا) negating; (يعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قالوا....» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لولا نزل عليه آية» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إن الله قادر» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «ينزل....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.
The clause «لكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «لا يعلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of lākinna.

* Morphology:
(قادر): an active participle of قدر يقدر, of the pattern-classes نصر, ضرب and فرح; its pattern is فاعل.

* Benefits:
1- لولا: in this verse it has come for causing regret (tandīm), and tandīm is a kind of urging (taḥḍīḍ).
On distinguishing between urging and causing regret:
The grammarians distinguished between the two, saying: if لولا enters an imperfect verb it is for urging, and if it enters a past verb it is for causing regret.

safi-cedvel:38-38.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negating, inoperative (muhmala); (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (دابة) genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ (subject); (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «دابة»; (الواو) conjunctive; (لا) redundant, for emphasizing the negation; (طائر) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to دابة, genitive like it in form; (يطير) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa"; (بجناحي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يطير) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of يطير, and it is an emphasizing ḥāl.], the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (أمم) khabar (predicate), nominative; (أمثال) a naʿt of «أمم», nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ما) negating; (فرّطنا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (في الكتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فرّطنا) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of (شيء) — a naʿt placed before the noun it qualifies.]; (من) like the first; (شيء) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ثم) a conjunction; (إلى رب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يحشرون), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (يحشرون) an imperfect passive verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «ما من دابة ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يطير ... » is in the position of genitive — or nominative — as a naʿt of «طائر».
The clause «ما فرطنا ... » has no grammatical position, parenthetical, to affirm the content of what precedes it.
The clause «يحشرون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.

* Morphology:
(طائر): a primitive (jāmid) noun for the well-known creature; its pattern is فاعل, on the pattern of the active participle, because originally it was such and was then transferred to the primitive; derived from طار يطير, of the pattern-class ضرب.
(جناحيه): dual of جناح, a primitive noun for the well-known limb of the bird; its pattern is فَعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ; taken from جنح يجنح, of the pattern-classes نصر, ضرب and فتح.
[Translator's note: the source writes the pattern as «فعل»; فَعال is what the stated form جناح requires.]

* Rhetoric:
1- The art of al-infiṣāl, for added generality and comprehensiveness:
It is that the speaker says something known and evident, but it contains a matter beyond that, of farther aim and loftier reach. That is in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَما مِنْ دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلا طائِرٍ يَطِيرُ بِجَناحَيْهِ». One might say: why was it not said: "There is no creature nor bird but are nations like you"? And what is the meaning of adding His saying «فِي الْأَرْضِ» and «يَطِيرُ بِجَناحَيْهِ»? I say: the meaning of that is added generality and encompassing, as if it were said: there is no creature at all in all the seven earths, and no bird at all in the air of the sky, of all that flies with its two wings, but they are nations like you, their states preserved, their affair not neglected. If you say: what is the purpose in that? I say: indicating the greatness of His power, the subtlety of His knowledge, and the breadth of His dominion and His management of those creatures of differing genera and multiplying kinds.
And He is the Keeper of what is for them and what is against them, Overseer of their states.

safi-cedvel:39-39.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (كذّبوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كذّبوا), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (صمّ) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الواو) conjunctive; (بكم) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to صمّ, nominative; (في الظلمات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in بكم [Note: Or attached to another khabar of the mubtadaʾ, implied as "ʿumyun" (blind), or attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «بكم», i.e. "dumb, being in the darkness".]; (من) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (يشأ) an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), vowelled with kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (يضلل) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "huwa", and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: As for the object of يشأ, it is omitted, its implied form being "إضلاله" (his being led astray); that is according to the rule: if the will (mashīʾa) occurs as a condition, its object is the pronoun of the requital.]; (الواو) conjunctive; (من يشأ يجعله) like its counterpart above; (على صراط) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجعله) [Note: It is in fact the second object of (يجعله), i.e. "guided".
(3, 4) The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis.]; (مستقيم) a naʿt of «صراط», genitive like it.
The clause «الذين كذّبوا....» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كذّبوا....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «من يشأ ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive, coming to affirm the state of those who denied.
The clause «يشأ الله ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «3».
The clause «يضلله» has no grammatical position, the apodosis not joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «من يشأ» (the second) has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من يشأ (the first).
The clause «يشأ....» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «4».
The clause «يجعله ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis not joined to the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
2- Eloquent simile (al-tashbīh al-balīgh): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا صُمٌّ وَبُكْمٌ فِي الظُّلُماتِ»; the speech is an eloquent simile according to the more correct view on its like, i.e. they are like the deaf and like the dumb: they do not hear the signs with a hearing by which their souls are affected, nor are they able to speak the truth; and therefore they do not respond, and they say about the signs what they say.

* Benefits:
1- Multiple khabars are permissible on condition that in the multiplicity there is complete difference, as when we say: «أحمد كريم شجاع» (Aḥmad is generous, brave); and your saying «أحمد طويل قصير» (Aḥmad is tall-short) is not of this kind, because the combination of the two attributes indicates a single attribute, namely that he is of medium height.

safi-cedvel:40-40.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta"; (الهمزة) for interrogation; (رأيت) a verb and its fāʿil, and (كم) a particle of address [Note: Around this expression there is long discussion on which the scholars of Basra differed with the scholars of Kufa; what we have followed above is the view of the scholars of Basra ... As for al-Kisāʾī, he made (الكاف) a pronoun, the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and al-Farrāʾ made the tāʾ a particle of address and (الكاف) in the place of the fāʿil, the accusative pronoun being borrowed for the nominative ...
There are many other branching views; refer to them in al-Baḥr al-Muḥīṭ of Abū Ḥayyān, and al-Jamal in his gloss on al-Jalālayn.] with no grammatical position ... The verb means "inform me", and the object of رأيت is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "iyyāhu", referring to the punishment that comes; and in the speech there is contention (tanāzuʿ) between the two verbs: رأيت — أتى. (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (أتى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (عذاب) the fāʿil of أتى, nominative [Note: Here the verb أتى governed the overt noun (العذاب), so it was its fāʿil; had the first one governed, (العذاب) would have been accusative as mafʿūl bihi governed by أرأيتكم, and the fāʿil of أتى would be a latent pronoun referring to the punishment.
Some do not see contention in the speech: for them the object is omitted, indicated by the speech, i.e.:
"Have you considered your worship of the idols — will it benefit you when the Hour comes?".. and this is indicated by the saying of Allah the Exalted: أغير الله تدعون?]; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (أو) a conjunction; (أتتكم الساعة) like أتاكم عذاب ... and the second tāʾ is for the feminine; (الهمزة) for rebuking interrogation; (غير) mafʿūl bihi placed first, accusative; (الله) like the first; (تدعون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إن) like the first; (كنتم) an incomplete past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis ... and (تم) a pronoun, the noun of kāna; (صادقين) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أرأيتكم....» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «إن أتاكم عذاب ... » has no grammatical position, parenthetical, affirming the meaning of seeing ... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "if the punishment of Allah comes to you, then inform me about it: will you call on other than Allah to remove it?" [Note: The implied apodosis may indicate the content of the coming interrogation, i.e. "then whom will you call?"
Or "if [it] comes to you ... you would call on Him".].
The clause «أتتكم الساعة....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أتاكم عذاب ...
The clause «تدعون» is in the position of accusative as the second object of the verb أرأيتكم.
The clause «كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position, resumptive ... and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "then call on other than Allah".

* Rhetoric:
1- The interrogation departing from its original meaning: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ». The origin of the expression [Translator's note: i.e. أرأيتكم] is asking about knowledge, recognition or sight, but it has been used figuratively for the meaning "inform me", and it is used only in asking for information about an astonishing state of something.

safi-cedvel:1-1.t:
* I'rab:
(الحمد) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty, (خلق) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he), (السّموات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the kasra, (الواو) conjunction, (الأرض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات, accusative, (الواو) conjunction, (جعل) like خلق, (الظلمات) like السموات, (الواو) conjunction, (النور) conjoined to الظلمات, accusative, (ثمّ) a conjunction for delay (tarākhī) and for expressing unlikelihood (istibʿād), (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, (كفروا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil, (بربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كفروا) [Note: It may be attached to (يعدلون), in which case it has the meaning of equating, so its object is omitted.. As for the attachment above, it is intransitive, i.e. they turn away from Him.], and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), (يعدلون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the retention of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «الحمد لله ...»: has no grammatical position, being initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «خلق السموات ...»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «جعل الظلمات....»: has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «الذين كفروا ...»: has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the initial clause.
The clause «كفروا»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يعدلون»: is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).

* Rhetoric:
1- The affirmation of the permanence that He, Glorified is He, deserves, namely the permanence of praise to Him because He is the Bestower of favours; the speech is declarative, intended as a command.
2- Antithesis (al-ṭibāq): between السموات and الأرض, and between الظلمات and النور; when antithesis is multiplied it is called contrast (muqābala).
3- Variation between singular and plural: in His saying, the Exalted, «وَجَعَلَ الظُّلُماتِ وَالنُّورَ», where He put الظلمات in the plural because of the evident multitude of its causes and locations among people and their witnessing them in detail; and He placed it before النور because privations precede possessions (al-aʿdām ʿalā al-malakāt), together with what that contains of observing a fine contrast between the two paired clauses.
4- Using the overt noun in the place of the pronoun (al-iẓhār fī mawḍiʿ al-iḍmār): in His saying, the Exalted, «ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ», where الرب was put in the place of His pronoun, the Exalted, to increase the censure and the condemnation; and the fronting is for greater emphasis and hastening to establish the focus of the disapproval and the unlikelihood, and for preserving the verse endings.
5- Omission of the object: in His saying, the Exalted, «يعدلون», i.e. «به (with Him)». The object was left out because it is evident, or to direct the disapproval to the act itself by treating it as intransitive, signalling that it is the focus of the unlikelihood and disapproval, not the particularity of the object. This is the verification befitting the eloquence of the Revelation and worthy of the grandeur of its majestic status.

* Benefits:
1- The verb «جعل» is one of the verbs that put two objects in the accusative, and that is when it means «صيّر» (to make into); but in this verse it means «أنشأ» (to bring into being), and for that reason it put only one object in the accusative. The perceptive person grasps the fine difference between الجعل and الخلق: the first contains the meaning of transforming from one thing to another, and الخلق contains beginning from nothing. Ibn Jinnī noted that and said in al-Khaṣāʾiṣ: «The Arabs may extend usage and put one of two verbs in the place of the other, signalling that this verb has acquired the meaning of the other verb».
2- The verb «عدل» admits the meaning of opposites (taḍādd): in this verse it means turning away from the path of what is right and deviating with whims. It is also used in the meaning of justice (العدل), which is equating between two things and fairness in giving people their rights. This is among the characteristics of the language of the ḍād, and the person of understanding grasps the difference between the two meanings and assigns the verb one of them based on the context of the speech and what the situation requires ...
3- The object of the verb «يعدلون» is omitted because it is understood from the context of the speech; this is a kind of concision (ījāz) and a characteristic of the rules of the language, which take implication (taqdīr) as one of their ancient principles.

safi-cedvel:2-2.t:
* I'rab:
(هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), (الذي) a relative noun, khabar (predicate), (خلقكم) like خلق السموات [Note: In the previous verse.], (من طين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلق) [Note: There is an omitted muḍāf in the speech, i.e. He created your origin from clay ... and it may be attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied [muḍāf].], (ثمّ) a conjunction, (قضى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he), (أجلا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), (الواو) conjunction, (أجل) mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) [Note: It was permissible to make the indefinite noun a mubtadaʾ because it has been qualified.], (مسمّى) naʿt (adjective) of أجل, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the alif, (عند) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted khabar, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), (ثمّ) a conjunction, (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, (تمترون) like يعدلون [Note: In the previous verse.].
The clause «هو الذي....»: has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «خلقكم....»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «قضى....»: has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أجل مسمّى عنده»: has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أنتم تمترون»: has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «تمترون»: is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم).

* Morphology:
(تمترون), it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is تمتريون with ḍamma on the yāʾ. The ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made vowelless and transferred to the rāʾ; and when two vowelless letters met - the yāʾ and the wāw of the plural - the yāʾ was deleted, and it became تمترون; its pattern is تفتعون.

* Rhetoric:
1- Conjoining with ثم: in His saying, the Exalted, «ثُمَّ أَنْتُمْ تَمْتَرُونَ», and that is an expression of unlikelihood and disapproval of their doubting the resurrection after their witnessing the dazzling proofs mentioned that point to it; i.e. you doubt its occurrence and its reality in itself, while you witness in yourselves evidence that cuts off the very substance of doubt entirely.
2- Indefiniteness (al-tankīr): in His saying, the Exalted, «وأجل»: He began with it while it is indefinite, and beginning with it was valid because it is specified by the qualification, or because it occurs in a position of detailing, and «عنده» is the khabar. Its tanwīn is for magnifying its status and making its matter awesome. The adverb was placed after it [in the order mubtadaʾ before khabar], although what is common with an indefinite noun of which something is predicated by an adverb is that the adverb must precede it, in fulfilment of the right of magnification.
[Translator's note: The Arabic sentence "وقدم على خبره الظرف" literally reads "and the adverb was placed before its khabar"; in context it means the indefinite mubtadaʾ أجل was placed before its adverbial khabar عنده, and it has been rendered by sense.]

safi-cedvel:3-3.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction, (هو) like the previous [Note: In the previous verse.], (الله) the Name of Majesty, khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the Name of Majesty, because it contains the meaning of "the One worshipped in the heavens and the earth" [Note: There is long discussion in justifying this attachment, which can be summarised as follows:], (الواو) conjunction, (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what في السموات is attached to, for it is conjoined to it, (يعلم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he), (سرّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), (الواو) conjunction, (جهركم) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to سرّكم, accusative, (الواو) conjunction, (يعلم) like the first, (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, (تكسبون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
[Translator's note: The footnote ends with "as follows:" and no summary follows it in the source.]
The clause «هو الله ...»: has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse, and the clause «يعلم..»: is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هو) [Note: Or it has no grammatical position, being resumptive.].
The clause «يعلم (the second)»: is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يعلم (the first).
The clause «تكسبون»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).

* Morphology:
(سرّكم), a noun for what a person conceals within himself; it may be a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the quadriliteral verb أسرّ; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn; its plural is أسرار.

* Benefits:
1- The attachment of the preposition and its genitive noun «فِي السَّماواتِ وَفِي الْأَرْضِ» has occupied the vanguard of the exegetes and the parsers, and they went in its attachment many ways, which some of them counted, and they exceeded twelve ways:
[Translator's note: The source has "فأضفت على اثني عشر وجها", evidently a misprint for "فأنافت على" (exceeded); rendered accordingly.]
The leading ones among them, including al-Zajjāj and al-Zamakhsharī, relied on attaching them to an adjective of the Name of Majesty, or to the omitted khabar, on the basis that the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ and the pronoun «هو» is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). The implied form is «الله كائن أو معبود أو موجود (Allah is existing, or worshipped, or present)» in the heavens and in the earth, and we have no need for fronting and postponing, complication and making things difficult. As for one who has a taste for following the strong and the weak, the sound and the anomalous opinions, and taking the paths of comparison and weighing, let him consult the extensive works of grammar and the compositions of the exegetes ...

safi-cedvel:41-41.t:
* I'rab:
(بل) for digression (iḍrāb) and inception; (إياه) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first; (تدعون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الفاء) conjunctive, linking the effect to the cause [Note: I.e. it conveyed that the removal follows from the supplication, the supplication being a cause of it.]; (يكشف) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "huwa", i.e. Allah; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi [Note: Or an indefinite qualified noun (nakira mawṣūfa), and the clause after it is a naʿt (adjective) of it.]; (تدعون) like the first; (إلى) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تدعون), i.e. "to its removal"; the pronoun refers back to the relative; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (شاء) a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (الواو) conjunctive; (تنسون) like تدعون; (ما) like the first; (تشركون) like تدعون.
The clause «تدعون (the first)» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يكشف ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «تدعون (the second)» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «شاء....» has no grammatical position, parenthetical.... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "if He wills to remove, He removes".
The clause «تنسون ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يكشف.
The clause «تشركون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).

safi-cedvel:42-42.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) occurring in the answer of an implied oath; (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (أرسلنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent) — the object is implied (muqaddar), i.e. "messengers" —; (إلى أمم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أرسلنا); (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أرسلنا), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) conjunctive; (أخذنا) like (أرسلنا), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بالبأساء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخذناهم) through its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "we punished them"; (الواو) conjunctive; (الضراء) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to البأساء, genitive; (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope (tarajjī), and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of laʿalla; (يتضرعون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «أرسلنا ... » has no grammatical position, the answer of an implied oath.
The clause «أخذناهم....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied clause, i.e. "so they denied them, so We seized them".
The clause «لعلهم يتضرعون» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) or giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يتضرعون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(البأساء): a noun for hardship and poverty; it is a feminine form with no masculine, so أبأس is not said except as an elative (tafḍīl); its pattern is فَعْلاء, taken from بئس يبأس, of the pattern-class فرح.
(الضراء): a noun for hardship and illness — the opposite of السراء —; it is a feminine form with no masculine, so أضرّ is not said except as an elative; its pattern is فَعْلاء, from ضر يضر, of the pattern-class نصر.

safi-cedvel:43-43.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunctive; (لولا) a particle of rebuke and regret [Note: Because it is followed by a past verb, namely (تضرّعوا), even though it is separated from it by (إذ).]; (إذ) an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تضرعوا); (جاء) a past verb, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بأسنا) fāʿil (agent), nominative, and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (تضرعوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الواو) conjunctive; (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk); (قست) a past verb ... and the tāʾ is for the feminine; (قلوب) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (زيّن) like جاء; (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (زيّن); (الشيطان) fāʿil, nominative; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi [Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is the object of زين.]; (كانوا) an incomplete past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of kāna; (يعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «جاءهم بأسنا» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تضرّعوا» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «قست قلوبهم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تضرّعوا.
The clause «زيّن ... الشيطان» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قست قلوبهم [Note: It may be cut off entirely as resumptive.].
The clause «كانوا يعملون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «يعملون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of kānū.

safi-cedvel:44-44.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunctive; (لمّا) an adverb (ẓarf) meaning "when", containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فتحنا); (نسوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ذكروا) a past passive verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الباء) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (ذكّروا); (فتحنا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and its fāʿil; (على) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (فتحنا); (أبواب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (كلّ) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (حتى) a particle of inception; (إذا) an adverb of future time, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to (أخذناهم); (فرحوا) like نسوا; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (فرحوا); (أوتوا) like ذكّروا; (أخذنا) like فتحنا, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بغتة) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) [Note: See verse (31) of this sūra.]; (الفاء) conjunctive; (إذا) of surprise (fujāʾiyya) [Note: According to the view of al-Akhfash; it is an adverb of place according to the view of Sībawayh and al-Mubarrad, attached to (مبلسون).]; (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (مبلسون) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «نسوا....» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ذكّروا....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «فتحنا ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «فرحوا....» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أوتوا....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «أخذناهم....» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of the non-jussive condition.
The clause «هم مبلسون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the apodosis clause [Note: The conjoining is by the fāʾ, which carries the meaning of causation, so it links the effect, namely the despair, to the sudden seizing.].

* Morphology:
(نسوا): it contains a weakening (iʿlāl) by making quiescent and by deletion; its origin is نسيوا with ḍamma on the yāʾ; the ḍamma was felt heavy on the yāʾ, so it was made quiescent and the vowel transferred to the sīn — weakening by making quiescent —; then the yāʾ was deleted because it met, quiescent, the wāw of the plural, and it became نسوا; its pattern is فَعُوا — weakening by deletion —.
(مبلسون): plural of مبلس, an active participle from the quadriliteral أبلس, meaning the despairing one whose hope is cut off; its pattern is مُفْعِل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn. In al-Mukhtār: «أبلس من رحمة الله»: he despaired.

* Benefits:
فَإِذا هُمْ مُبْلِسُونَ:
1- The Basrans, among them al-Kisāʾī [Translator's note: so in the source; al-Kisāʾī is usually counted among the Kufans], held that إذا is an adverb of time attached to the khabar that follows it.
2- The Kufans held that it is a particle that needs no attachment, and we will return to it in other places.

safi-cedvel:45-45.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunctive; (قطع) a past passive verb; (دابر) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (القوم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of «القوم»; (ظلموا) like نسوا «1»; (الواو) resumptive; (الحمد) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (رب) a naʿt of «الله», genitive like it; (العالمين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قطع دابر....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (هم مبلسون) «2».
The clause «ظلموا» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «الحمد لله ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(دابر): an active participle from the triliteral دبر, of the pattern-class نصر, meaning "the last"; its pattern is فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- Placing the overt noun in the place of the pronoun: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «فَقُطِعَ دابِرُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا», to signal the reason for the ruling, for their destruction was because of their wrongdoing, which is putting disbelief in the place of gratitude and setting up acts of disobedience in the place of acts of obedience.

safi-cedvel:46-46.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "anta"; (الهمزة) for interrogation; (رأيتم) a past verb and its fāʿil, meaning "inform me"; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (أخذ) a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (سمع) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunctive; (أبصاركم) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to سمعكم, accusative like it, and muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (ختم) like أخذ; (على قلوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ختم), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (إله) khabar (predicate), nominative; (غير) a naʿt (adjective) of «إله», nominative like it; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (يأتي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الباء) a preposition; (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يأتي); (انظر) like قل; (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), governed by نصرف; (نصرف) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the verb [Translator's note: so in the source; read "the fāʿil"] is a latent pronoun implied as "naḥnu" (We) for majesty; (الآيات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (ثم) a conjunction; (هم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (يصدفون) an imperfect verb, nominative.... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause (قل ... ) has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أرأيتم....» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «أخذ الله....» has no grammatical position, parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the coming interrogation, i.e. "if Allah takes your hearing ...
then inform me: what god other than Allah ... " or "then no one other than Allah will bring it to you".
The clause «ختم....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أخذ الله.
The clause «من إله....» is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi, governed by رأيتم, and the first object is omitted, its implied form being "have you considered your hearing and your sight ..."
The clause «يأتيكم به» is in the position of nominative as a second naʿt of «إله».
The clause «انظر....» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «نصرف....» is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the verb of looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.
The clause «هم يصدفون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause نصرف.
The clause «يصدفون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.

safi-cedvel:47-47.t:
* I'rab:
(قل أرأيتكم ... الله) its i'rab has passed [Note: In verse (40) of this sūra.]; (بغتة) like the previous one [Note: In verse (44) of this sūra and verse (31).]; (أو) a conjunction; (جهرة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to بغتة, accusative like it; (هل) an interrogative particle; (يهلك) an imperfect passive verb, nominative; (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (القوم) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (الظالمون) a naʿt (adjective) of «القوم», nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أرأيتكم....» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «أتاكم عذاب الله....» has no grammatical position, parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "then inform me".
The clause «يهلك....» is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), governed by أرأيتكم.

safi-cedvel:112-113.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (كذلك): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive (majrūr) by the kāf «[Note: The kāf may be a noun meaning "like", a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, in the position of the accusative.]», attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq that emphasises what follows … and (الكاف) is a particle of address and (اللام) is for distance. (جعلنا): a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and its fāʿil (agent). (لكل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (عدوا) — a naʿt (adjective) placed before what it qualifies. (نبي): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (عدوا): second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), governed by جعل, accusative. (شياطين): first mafʿūl bihi, accusative «[Note: It may be a badal (substitute) of (عدوا), on the view that the latter is the first object, in which case the preposition and its noun (لكل) become the second object.]». (الإنس): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الجن): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الإنس by the wāw, genitive. (يوحي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ. (بعض): fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إلى بعض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يوحي). (زخرف): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (القول): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (غرورا): mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative «[Note: Or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl.]». (الواو) conjunction (لو): a non-jussive conditional particle (شاء): past verb (رب): fāʿil, nominative, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (ما): negating (فعلوا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma … and the wāw is the fāʿil, (والهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الفاء): connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition (ذر): imperative verb, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you" (أنت), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو): the wāw of accompaniment — or a conjunction — (ما): relative noun «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by what follows, the referring pronoun being omitted and the clause after it a naʿt … or a maṣdar particle.]», indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment) «[Note: Or conjoined by the wāw to the accusative pronoun in ذرهم.]». (يفترون): imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «جعلنا....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يوحي بعضهم....» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of شياطين «[Note: Or in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of (عدوا); it may also be cut off as resumptive, so it would have no position.]».
The clause «شاء ربك» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «ما فعلوه» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «ذرهم....» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if the inspiration comes from some of them, then leave them.
The clause «يفترون» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
(الواو) conjunction (اللام) of purpose (تصغي): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the implied fatḥa. (إلى): a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (تصغي). (أفئدة): fāʿil, nominative. (الذين): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (لا) negating (يؤمنون): like يفترون. (بالآخرة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤمنون).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تصغي....) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to the verb يوحي, because it is conjoined in meaning to (غرورا), both being objects of purpose governed by يوحي «[Note: (غرورا) is accusative because it is a maṣdar that shares its agent with the verb … whereas the inclining (الإصغاء) does not share its agent with the inspiring (الإيحاء), because the one who inspires is "some of them" while those who incline are the hearts; therefore it is put in the genitive by the preposition lām.]». (الواو) conjunction (اللام) like the first (يرضوا): imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil, (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يرضوه) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (يوحي) by virtue of the conjunction.
(الواو) conjunction (ليقترفوا): like ليرضوا in i'rab and attachment. (ما): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (هم): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (مقترفون): khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «تصغي ... أفئدة» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «لا يؤمنون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يرضوه» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «يقترفوا» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «هم مقترفون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (ما), the referring pronoun being omitted, i.e.: هم مقترفوه.

* Morphology:
(زخرف): a noun meaning false embellishments of speech; its pattern is فعلل, with ḍamma on the fāʾ and the lām and a quiescent ʿayn between them.
(تصغي): the alif is converted from wāw, because the imperfect also comes as يصغو; when the wāw came vowelled after a fatḥa it was turned into alif in both the bare and the augmented forms, i.e.: صغا and أصغى.
(يرضوه): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the alif, which is the lām of the verb, was deleted because it came quiescent before the quiescent wāw of the plural; its pattern is يفعوه.
(مقترفون): plural of مقترف, active participle of the five-letter verb اقترف; its pattern is مفتعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Benefits:
1- The lām of purpose (lām al-taʿlīl), which occurs in three places in the verse mentioned, is originally one of the genitive-governing lāms in its effect, so what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive by the lām; in terms of meaning, besides purpose it conveys becoming and outcome (al-ṣayrūra wa-l-ʿāqiba), as al-Zamakhsharī held, and this is an acceptable view.

safi-cedvel:4-5.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (ما) negating, (تأتي) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), (من) redundant (zāʾida), (آية) genitive in wording, nominative in position, the fāʿil (agent) of تأتي, (من آيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of آية, (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), (كانوا) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of كان, (عن) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to معرضين, (معرضين) khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «تأتيهم ...»: has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كانوا ...»: is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of تأتي or of its fāʿil.
(الفاء) causal (taʿlīliyya) [Note: al-Zamakhsharī made it the connector of the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if they turn away from the signs, then do not wonder, for they have belied the truth.], (قد) a particle of verification (taḥqīq), (كذّبوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذّبوا), and the verb may be made to include the meaning of "استهزءوا" (they mocked), (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", containing the meaning of condition, attached to the apodosis, (جاء) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition, (سوف) a particle of the future, (يأتيهم) like تأتيهم, (أنباء) fāʿil, nominative, (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, (كانوا به) like كانوا عنها, and the preposition [with its noun] is attached to the verb, (يستهزئون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «كذّبوا بالحقّ»: has no grammatical position, being causal.
The clause «جاءهم»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما). [Translator's note: The source reads "في محلّ لها صلة الموصول (ما)", a garbled phrase (the usual formula is "لا محلّ لها"); and «جاءهم» is not in fact the ṣila of ما here (the ṣila is «كانوا به يستهزئون»). It is translated with the intended formula and flagged as written.]
The clause «يستهزئون»: is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of كانوا.

safi-cedvel:6-6.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation, (لم) a particle of negation, jussive and conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning], (يروا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) [Note: The seeing may be visual, or mental, of knowledge.], (كم) declarative (khabariyya), an allusion to a number, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: al-ʿUkbarī parsed it as interrogative, and in some of his parsings he made it an adverb, and a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the object of أهلكنا is قرن, on the basis that (من) is redundant.], (أهلك) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil, (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أهلكنا), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), (من قرن) a preposition and its genitive noun, the tamyīz (specification) of كم, (مكّنّا) like أهلكنا, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi - and it refers back to القرون in the meaning of "nations" -, (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مكّناهم), (ما) an indefinite noun qualified (nakira mawṣūfa), a noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi governed by مكّناهم, by making it include the meaning of أعطيناهم (We gave them) [Note: Or a relative noun, naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, i.e.: We established them in the land with the establishment with which We have not established you.], (لم) like the first, (نمكّن) an imperfect verb, jussive, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن" (We), for magnification, (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (نمكّن), (الواو) conjunction, (أرسلنا) like أهلكنا, (السماء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أرسلنا), (مدرارا) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of السماء, (الواو) conjunction, (جعلنا) like أهلكنا, (الأنهار) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, (تجري) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هي", (من تحت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تجري), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. There is an omitted muḍāf in the speech, i.e. "from beneath their dwellings", (الفاء) conjunction, (أهلكنا) like the first, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, (بذنوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أهلكنا), and the الباء is causal, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, (الواو) conjunction, (أنشأنا) like أهلكنا, (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنشأنا), and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi, (قرنا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, (آخرين) naʿt of قرن - which is a collective noun (ism jamʿ) - accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «يروا ...»: has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أهلكنا ...»: is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the verb of seeing [Note: Or in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of يروا, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by (كم).].
The clause «لم نمكّن لكم»: is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of (ما) [Note: Or it has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).].
The clause «أرسلنا ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause مكناهم.
The clause «جعلنا....» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause مكناهم.
[Translator's note: The source says these two clauses are "in the position of the genitive", and it has not stated a position for the clause «مكّناهم» to which they are conjoined; translated as written.]
