The clause «تجري ...» is in the position of the accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi governed by جعلنا [Note: If the verb is transitive to one object, the clause is a ḥāl ...].
The clause «أهلكناهم ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. "they disbelieved, so We destroyed them".
The clause «أنشأنا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أهلكناهم.

* Morphology:
(قرن), a collective noun (ism jamʿ) like قوم and رهط, and it has many meanings: it means a group of people, because of their being joined together (اقتران) in a period of time; it is applied to the period of time that falls within a hundred years, and some make it more than that or less than that; and it is said to be the middle measure of people's lifespans ... its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Iltifāt (shift of address): in His saying, the Exalted, «ما لَمْ نُمَكِّنْ لَكُمْ», because confronting them with the weakness of their state gives further clarity to the matter of the two parties, and removes from the outset any confusion about the referents of the two pronouns; the context would require: ما لم نمكن لهم (with which We have not established them).
2- Majāz mursal (metonymic trope): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَأَرْسَلْنَا السَّماءَ», i.e. the clouds; its use for that is a majāz mursal, and the relation is that of location (al-maḥalliyya). The clouds were expressed by السماء because the rain comes down from it.
[Translator's note: The Arabic reads "لأنه ينزل منها" (because it comes down from it), without naming the subject; "the rain" is the translator's reading.]

* Benefits:
1- His saying: ما لَمْ نُمَكِّنْ لَكُمْ.
«ما» admits of being in several states....
The first of them: that it is a complete indefinite noun meaning "thing", in the position of a mafʿūl muṭlaq or a second mafʿūl bihi. The second of them: that it is maṣdariyya ẓarfiyya (adverbial-maṣdar), i.e. "for the duration of your being established".
The third of them: that it is a relative noun meaning الذي, i.e. "the establishment with which We have not established you".
The i'rab of the clause after it differs according to the implication we posit and the i'rab we adopt.

safi-cedvel:7-7.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle, (نزّلنا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn ... (ونا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent), (على) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نزلنا), (كتابا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), (في قرطاس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كتابا) [Note: It is in the meaning of "written", and it may be attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of كتاب.] (الفاء) conjunction, (لمسوا) a past verb and its fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, (بأيدي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (لمسوه), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لو, (قال) a past verb, (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil, (كفورا) a past verb and its fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; read كفروا.], (إن) a particle of negation, (ها) a particle of calling attention (tanbīh), (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), (سحر) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), (مبين) naʿt, nominative.
The clause «نزّلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لمسوه ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «قال الذين ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إن هذا إلا سحر» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying).

* Morphology:
(قرطاس), a primitive (jāmid) noun for what one writes on; its pattern is فعلال with kasra on the fāʾ, which is the better known, and the fāʾ may take ḍamma ... and in al-Qāmūs the qāf takes all three vowels. One does not say قرطاس unless it has writing on it; otherwise it is a طرس or a كاغد.

* Rhetoric:
1- Iṭnāb (amplification): in His saying, the Exalted, «فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ», even though it is evident that touching is usually only with the hands; it is for greater specification and to ward off the possibility of figurative usage that occurs in His saying, the Exalted, «وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّماءَ», i.e. "we examined". That is: they touched it with their hands after having seen it with their eyes, so that no confusion about it remained for them and they could not make the excuse that their eyes had been dazzled.
[Translator's note: The source has "فمسوه" here, evidently for "فلمسوه" (they touched it); rendered accordingly.]

safi-cedvel:8-9.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction, (قالوا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), (لولا) a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), i.e. "هلا" (why not) [Note: Some make it for interrogation - like al-Harawī - and some make it for rebuke - like Ibn Hishām -.], (أنزل) a passive past verb, (عليه) like عليك [Note: In the previous verse.], attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل), (ملك) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ), (الواو), resumptive, (لو أنزلنا ملكا) like لو نزلنا ... كتابا [Note: In the previous verse (7).], (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لو, (قضي) a passive past verb, (الأمر) nāʾib fāʿil, nominative, (ثم) a conjunction, (لا) negating, (ينظرون) a passive imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous [verse].
The clause «أنزل عليه ملك» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying).
The clause «أنزلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قضي الأمر....» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لا ينظرون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
(9) (الواو) conjunction, (لو جعلناه ملكا) a conditional particle, a verb, its fāʿil, its first object and its second object, (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لو, (جعلنا) a past verb and its fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), (رجلا) second mafʿūl bihi, (الواو) conjunction, (اللام) like the first, (لبسنا) like جعلنا, (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (لبسنا) like جعلنا (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (لبسنا), (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi [Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We would have confused them as they confuse others".], (يلبسون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
[Translator's note: The source repeats the words "like جعلنا (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (لبسنا)"; the repetition is reproduced as written.]
The clause «جعلناه ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أنزلنا.
The clause «جعلنا (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لبسنا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the apodosis.
The clause «يلبسون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).

* Morphology:
(ملك), the singular of الملائكة, a noun from (ملك يملك), of the class of ضرب, or from (ألك) meaning "to deliver the message", with metathesis (al-qalb). See further detail in verse (30) of Sūrat al-Baqara.

* Benefits:
1- Some grammarians devoted a special section to «لولا and لوما»; we summarise for you what they set out about them:
They said: these two particles have two uses:
The first: the impossibility of their apodosis because of the existence of their condition. In this case they are restricted to nominal clauses, as in His saying, the Exalted: «لَوْلا أَنْتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ», and the saying of the poet:
لولا الإصاخة للوشاة لكان لي ... من بعد سخطك في الرضاء رجاء
(Were it not for listening to the slanderers, I would have had, after your anger, hope of your goodwill.)
In this case the khabar (predicate) must be omitted, because it is known from the context of the speech; the apodosis indicates its impossibility, and the existence of the mubtadaʾ (subject) indicates that the apodosis must be implied.
The second use: their indicating urging (taḥḍīḍ). In this case they are restricted to verbal clauses, as in His saying, the Exalted: «لَوْلا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْمَلائِكَةُ».
Equal to them in urging and in being restricted to verbs are «هلّا and ألّا and ألا».
We add to the two basic uses of these particles that they may be used for reprimand, denunciation and causing regret, and then they are restricted to the past or what is interpreted as it, as in:
«لَوْلا جاؤُ عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَداءَ», and the saying of the poet:
نبئت ليلى أرسلت بشفاعة ... إليّ فهلّا نفس ليلى شفيعها
(I was told that Laylā sent an intercession to me; why then was not Laylā herself its intercessor?)
2- «Between Sībawayh and al-Mubarrad» ..
Sībawayh holds that «لولا» puts the pronoun in the genitive, and he cites as evidence the saying of Yazīd ibn al-Ḥakam al-Thaqafī:
وكم موطن لولاي طحت كما هوى ... بأجرامه من قلّة النوق منهوي
(How many a place where, but for me, you would have perished, as one falling with his body plunges from the top of a peak.)
Al-Mubarrad rejects this, holding that the correct use of it with a pronoun is for the pronoun to be detached, as in our saying: «لولا أنت and لولا أنا», and His saying, the Exalted: «لَوْلا أَنْتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ»; and after the speech of Allah there is no [further] proof.

safi-cedvel:71-71.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت). (الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī). (ندعو) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the wāw; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن). (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ندعو) by its being made to carry the meaning of "we worship" (نعبد) «[Note: It may also be a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of (ندعو), i.e. "passing beyond..."; or a ḥāl of the relative (ما) — an adjective placed before it.]». (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (ما) a relative noun «[Note: Or it is an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, in the position of the accusative, and the clause after it is a naʿt (adjective) of it.]», indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (لا) negative. (ينفع) an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو) — and it is the resumptive pronoun (al-ʿāʾid) — and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) conjunction. (لا) like the first one. (يضرّنا) like ينفعنا. (الواو) conjunction. (نردّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, passive; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن). (على أعقاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نردّ), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi «[Note: It may be attached to an omitted ḥāl of the pronoun in (نردّ), i.e. "turning back on our heels".]». (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (نردّ). (إذ) an adverb of past time, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (هدى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الكاف) a preposition. (الذي) relative, in the position of the genitive, attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil of نردّ, i.e. "losers, like the one whom the devils have lured away" «[Note: Or attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "we are turned back with a turning like the turning of the one whom the devils lured away"; so it involves the omission of a muḍāf, as is evident.]». (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun; there are several possibilities for what it is attached to... a- attached to the verb استهوته; b- attached to an omitted ḥāl of the object of استهوته; c- attached to an omitted ḥāl of the latent pronoun in حيران. (حيران) a ḥāl, accusative, of the object pronoun in استهوته. (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first. (أصحاب) a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later, nominative. (يدعون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (إلى الهدى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يدعون), the sign of the genitive being the implied kasra. (ائت) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت), and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (قل) like the first one. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh). (هدى) the noun of inna, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif. (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (هو) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) for emphasis «[Note: Or a detached pronoun as mubtadaʾ whose khabar is (الهدى), and the clause is the khabar [of inna]! ...]». (الهدى) the khabar of inna, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif. (الواو) conjunction. (أمرنا) a past verb, passive, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (نا) a pronoun, nāʾib fāʿil. (اللام) has several explanations.. a- it gives the reason for the omitted object, i.e. "we were commanded to sincerity for the sake of submission".. b- it gives the reason for the command, i.e. "we were commanded for the sake of Islam"; c- it is redundant (zāʾida) with the object «[Note: This is the view of Ibn Hishām.]», i.e. "we were commanded to submit".. d- it is in the sense of the bāʾ, i.e. "we were commanded to submit (بأن نسلم)" «[Note: This is the view of Jalāl al-Dīn al-Suyūṭī.]». (نسلم) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām; the fāʿil is "we".
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نسلم) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (أمرنا) — or in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, if the lām is redundant.
(لربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نسلم). (العالمين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قل....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ندعو....»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «ينفعنا»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «يضرّنا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «نردّ....»: in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause ندعو.
The clause «هدانا الله»: in the position of the genitive through (إذ) being annexed to it.
The clause «استهوته الشياطين»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «له أصحاب ...»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in حيران «[Note: Or it has no grammatical position, resumptive.]».
The clause «يدعونه....»: in the position of the nominative as a naʿt of أصحاب.
The clause «ائتنا»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl of an omitted verb of saying, and the omitted clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the agent pronoun in (يدعونه) «[Note: The clause (ائتنا) may have no grammatical position ... being the answer to the calling, since it is made to carry the meaning of a vocative; or it is an explanation of the content of the calling.]».
The clause «قل (the second) ....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إنّ هدى الله ...»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أمرنا....»: in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause إنّ هدى ...

* Morphology:
(استهوت): the verb has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the meeting of two quiescent letters: the alif — the lām of the word — was deleted because it came quiescent before the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine. Its pattern is استفعته.
(حيران): a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) from حار يحار, of the bāb فتح; its feminine is حيرى. Its pattern is فعلان.

* Rhetoric:
1- The negated representative simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): in the saying of the Exalted «كَالَّذِي اسْتَهْوَتْهُ الشَّياطِينُ فِي الْأَرْضِ», where the one who was freed from polytheism and then turned back on his heels is likened to the state of one whom the devils have carried off into the wilderness and led astray after he had been on the straight highway.

safi-cedvel:72-72.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (أن) a maṣdar particle «[Note: Or an explicative particle.. and the clause after it is explicative, preceded by the verb (أمرنا), which has the meaning of saying without its letters.]». (أقيموا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الصلاة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الواو) conjunction. (اتّقوا) like أقيموا, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) resumptive. (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (الذي) relative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). (إلى) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تحشرون), which is an imperfect verb, passive, nominative ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أقيموا) is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar preceding it in the previous verse (أن نسلم); or in the position of the accusative by position, because it is the second object of the verb أمرنا.
The clause «أقيموا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن) «[Note: Or explicative.]».
The clause «اتّقوا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أقيموا.
The clause «هو الذي....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تحشرون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذي).

safi-cedvel:73-73.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (هو الذي) their i'rab has preceded «[Note: In the previous verse (72).]». (خلق) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو). (السموات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (الواو) conjunction. (الأرض) conjoined to السموات, genitive «[Translator's note: so in the source; as a maʿṭūf (conjoined) on an accusative noun it would be accusative.]». (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of خلق. (الواو) conjunction. (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first «[Note: Or a mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر) ... It may also be stripped of its adverbial sense and conjoined to the accusative pronoun in His saying (اتّقوه) in the previous verse, with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "and fear the punishment of the day on which He says ..."]». (يقول) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو). (كن) a complete (tāmm) imperative verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت). (الفاء) conjunction, linking the effect to the cause «[Note: Some consider it resumptive ... and Ibn Hishām rejected that.]». (يكون) a complete imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "it" (هو) «[Note: It refers back to everything Allah creates, or it is a pronoun referring back to the day ... The fāʿil may also be (قوله), i.e. "His word, the truth, comes into being"; then the adverb (يوم) is attached to a verb drawn from the content of (قوله الحقّ), i.e. "His word proves true on the day He says".]». (قول) a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الحق) a naʿt (adjective) of (لقوله), nominative «[Note: It may be a khabar for the mubtadaʾ (الحقّ) ... and then (يوم) is parsed by one of the parsings mentioned above.]» «[Translator's note: so in the source; the sense is evidently that (الحقّ) may be the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (قوله).]». (الواو) conjunction. (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a khabar placed first. (الملك) a mubtadaʾ placed later, nominative. (يوم) a badal (substitute) of (يوم يقول) «[Note: Or attached to the verb يحشرون in the previous verse, or attached to الملك, or to a ḥāl of الملك whose governing word is the [implied] "being established" (al-istiqrār), or attached to (عالم الغيب).]». (ينفخ) an imperfect verb, passive, nominative. (في الصور) a preposition and its genitive noun, in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (عالم) the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "he" (هو). (الغيب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الواو) conjunction. (الشهادة) conjoined by the wāw to الغيب, genitive. (الواو) conjunction. (هو) a pronoun, mubtadaʾ. (الحكيم) khabar, nominative. (الخبير) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «هو الذي....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هو الذي إليه تحشرون «[Note: In the previous verse (73).]» «[Translator's note: so in the source; the clause referred to is in verse 72.]».
The clause «خلق السموات....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «يقول....»: in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «كن....»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «يكون»: in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause يقول «[Note: Or it is resumptive, according to those who hold that view, contrary to Ibn Hishām.]».
The clause «قوله الحقّ يوم....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause (خلق ...).
The clause «له الملك....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قوله الحقّ....
The clause «ينفخ في الصور»: in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «(هو) عالم ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هو الحكيم ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the last resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(الصور): a primitive (jāmid) noun taken from صار يصور, of the bāb نصر, in the sense of "to make a sound". It is the horn. Its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn.
(الشهادة): a noun for what is witnessed in the manifest world. Its pattern is فعالة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:74-74.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (إذ) an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر). (قال) a past verb. (إبراهيم) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (لأبيه) a preposition and its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال). (آزر) a badal (substitute) of أبي or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, since it is a diptote on account of being a proper name and foreign, or [being] on the pattern of a verb. (الهمزة) for the interrogative of rebuke. (تتّخذ) an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت). (أصناما) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (آلهة) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — one of the abrogators (nawāsikh) — and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna. (أرى) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "I" (أنا). (الواو) conjunction. (قوم) conjoined to the attached pronoun in (أراك), following it in the accusative, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (في ضلال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) «[Note: Or to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi, if the seeing is mental (qalbiyya).]». (مبين) a naʿt (adjective) of ضلال, genitive.
The clause «قال إبراهيم....»: in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أتتّخذ....»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «إنّي أراك....»: has no [grammatical] position, resumptive, within the scope of the preceding speech, giving the reason.
The clause «أراك....»: in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna.

* Morphology:
(آزر): of the measure of آدم, with fatḥa on the zāy. It is foreign according to those who say it is not derived, or on the pattern of a verb according to those who say it is derived from الوزر or الأزر.
(أصناما): plural of صنم, a primitive (jāmid) noun, meaning the statue or the idol. Its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(آلهة): plural of إله, a noun for the one worshipped in general. Its pattern is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:114-114.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة): for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī). (الفاء): conjunction. (غير) «[Translator's note: the source prints "(غير 9", evidently a typographical slip for the closing bracket.]»: a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) «[Note: It may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (حكما) if the latter is parsed as the mafʿūl bihi — an adjective placed before what it qualifies …]». (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (أبتغي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "I" (أنا). (حكما): tamyīz (specification), accusative «[Note: Or a ḥāl of غير if the latter is parsed as the mafʿūl bihi.]». (الواو): of the ḥāl. (هو): a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). (الذي): relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). (أنزل): past verb, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (إلى): a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل). (الكتاب): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (مفصلا): ḥāl of الكتاب, accusative. (الواو): resumptive. (الذين): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (آتينا): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn … and نا is the fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الكتاب): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (يعلمون): imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (أن): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) — and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of أن. (منزل): khabar, nominative. (من رب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (منزل), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (بالحق): a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl of the pronoun in منزل or of رب.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّه منزل) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of يعلمون.
(الفاء): connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. (لا): the jussive lā of prohibition. (تكوننّ): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive (majzūm), and (النون) is for emphasis; its noun is a latent pronoun, implied as "you" (أنت). (من الممترين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of تكوننّ «[Note: The prohibition, as it concerns the Messenger, peace be upon him, can be interpreted as addressed to him while someone else is intended.]».
The clause «أبتغي....» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to an implied clause which is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "Say to them: Shall I incline to the embellishments of the devils and so seek a judge?"
The clause «هو الذي....» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «أنزل ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «الذين آتيناهم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آتيناهم الكتاب....» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يعلمون ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «لا تكونن من الممترين» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. if the People of the Book know that it is sent down from Allah, then do not be …

* Morphology:
(مفصّلا): passive participle of the four-letter verb فصّل; its pattern is مفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn.
(منزل), with doubling — and without doubling —: passive participle of the four-letter verb نزل — or أنزل —; its pattern is مفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn, doubled — or not doubled.

safi-cedvel:115-115.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (تمت): past verb … and (التاء) is for the feminine. (كلمة): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (رب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (صدقا): a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) «[Note: It may be a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) … al-ʿUkbarī parsed it as a tamyīz (specification), and al-Suyūṭī followed him in that.]». (الواو): conjunction. (عدلا): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (صدقا), accusative. (لا): the lā of generic negation. (مبدّل): noun of lā, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative. (لكلمات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of lā, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (هو): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (السميع): khabar, nominative. (العليم): second khabar, nominative.
The clause «تمت كلمة ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا مبدل لكلماته» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: If one regards "words" (كلمات) as the link, it is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تمت.]».
The clause «هو السميع ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لا مبدل لكلماته.

* Rhetoric:
- Metonymic trope (al-majāz al-mursal): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ», what is meant by "the word" is speech, and by it the Qur'an is intended. Its application to it is either by way of majāz mursal or of metaphor (istiʿāra), and its relation refuses that "the word" be applied to a non-informative sentence; but such an application was not found in their speech. This expression was chosen for the subtlety in it, which is not hidden from one who looks closely. «[Translator's note: the source repeats the words "this expression" (هذا التعبير) twice, and the final sentence lacks closing punctuation.]»

safi-cedvel:116-117.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إن): a jussive conditional particle. (تطع): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you" (أنت). (أكثر): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (من): relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. (يضلّوا): imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (عن سبيل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يضلّوك). (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إن): negating. (يتّبعون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (إلا): particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (الظن): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو): conjunction. (إن): negating. (هم): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (إلا): like the first. (يخرصون): like يتبعون.
The clause «تطع ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause تمت in the previous verse.
The clause «يضلّوك ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of the condition not joined by the fāʾ.
The clause «يتبعون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: It may be in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of يضلوك.]».
The clause «إن هم إلّا يخرصون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يتبعون....
The clause «يخرصون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
(إن): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh). (ربّ): noun of إن, accusative, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (هو): a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: Or a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is (أعلم), and the clause هو أعلم is the khabar of إن.]», with no governing effect, conveying emphasis. (أعلم): khabar of إن, nominative. (من): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. هو أعلم بمن يضل «[Note: (من) may be a relative or an indefinite qualified noun in the position of the accusative by an omitted verb indicated by the noun أعلم … and it may be interrogative, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause يضل, the interrogative clause being one from which the implied verb is suspended (muʿallaq).]». (يضل): imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil a latent pronoun, implied as "he" (هو), and it is the referring pronoun. (عن سبيل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يضل), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (هو): a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, in the position of the nominative. (أعلم): khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative. (بالمهتدين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعلم, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «إن ربك ... أعلم» has no grammatical position: conjoined, resumptive.
The clause «يضلّ ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «هو أعلم ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the khabar of إن, either the word or the clause.

* Morphology:
(تطع): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) on account of the jussive, since two quiescent letters met, namely the ʿayn and the lām of the verb, so the ʿayn was deleted; its pattern is تفل, with kasra on the fāʾ.
(الظن): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb ظن يظن, of the class نصر; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
1- «إن» of negation: it negates the past, as in «ان جاء الا أنتم», and it negates the present, as in «إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ». It enters on the verb and on the noun. Both examples occur in the verse mentioned, so reflect. «[Translator's note: the source says both examples occur in the verse mentioned, though the first quoted example is not from this verse.]»

safi-cedvel:48-48.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negating; (نرسل) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "naḥnu" (We) for majesty; (المرسلين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (مبشرين) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (الواو) conjunctive; (منذرين) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to مبشرين, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (الفاء) conjunctive; (من) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (آمن) a past verb, indeclinable, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil a latent pronoun implied as "huwa"; (الواو) conjunctive; (أصلح) like آمن and conjoined to it; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) negating, inoperative (muhmala) [Note: Or operating like laysa, with (خوف) its noun and (عليهم) its khabar.]; (خوف) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (على) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (الواو) conjunctive; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), for emphasizing the negation; (هم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (يحزنون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «نرسل....» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «من آمن....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «آمن....» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «أصلح» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause آمن.
The clause «لا خوف عليهم» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «هم يحزنون» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «يحزنون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.

* Morphology:
(نرسل): it contains deletion of the hamza for lightening; its origin is نؤرسل, its past being أرسل; its pattern is نُفْعِل with ḍamma on the nūn and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Benefits:
1- The «لا» resembling laysa is inoperative among all the Arabs except the people of the Hijaz, who may make it operate under conditions that whoever seeks this science will find in their proper places. Among what distinguishes it from the «لا» of generic negation is that it may negate the single one and may negate the genus, and that is known from the context of speech.
We return to saying that the more fitting for the first [Translator's note: the source's wording «الأولى بالأولى» is unclear; it apparently means "the more fitting for this lā"] is to leave it inoperative, so that what follows it is a mubtadaʾ and khabar; and when it is inoperative it is often repeated, as in the saying of Allah the Exalted in the verse we are dealing with:
فَلا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

safi-cedvel:49-49.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (كذّبوا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كذّبوا), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (يمسّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (العذاب) fāʿil, nominative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (كانوا) an incomplete past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of kāna; (يفسقون) an imperfect verb, nominative.... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا ... ) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (يمسّهم), i.e. the punishment touches them because of their transgression:
The clause «الذين كذّبوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من آمن [Note: In the previous verse (48).].
The clause «كذّبوا....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يمسهم العذاب» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «كانوا....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative.
The clause «يفسقون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of kānū.

* Rhetoric:
1- Explicit dependent metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya al-tabaʿiyya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «يَمَسُّهُمُ الْعَذابُ». It appears that what is mentioned is built on touching being a property of living beings, so it is as though the punishment were a living being doing to them whatever pains it wishes.

safi-cedvel:50-50.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta"; (لا) negating; (أقول) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "anā"; (اللام) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أقول); (عند) an adverb (ẓarf) of place, accusative, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (خزائن) mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after, nominative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunctive; (لا أعلم) like لا أقول; (الغيب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الواو) conjunctive; (لا أقول لكم) like the first; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; (ملك) the khabar of inna, nominative; (إن) negating; (أتبع) like أقول; (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (يوحى) an imperfect passive verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied ḍamma, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun implied as "huwa", which is the returning pronoun; (إلى) a preposition, and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يوحى); (قل) like the first; (هل) an interrogative particle; (يستوي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ; (الأعمى) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif; (الواو) conjunctive; (البصير) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الأعمى, nominative; (الهمزة) for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī); (الفاء) conjunctive; (لا) negating; (تتفكّرون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا أقول....» is in the position of accusative as the first maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «عندي خزائن....» is in the position of accusative as the second maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «لا أعلم....» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause عندي خزائن ...
The clause «لا أقول (the second)» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause لا أقول (the first).
The clause «إنّي ملك» is in the position of accusative as the (third) maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «إن أتّبع....» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya), or an implied resumption.
The clause «يوحى إليّ» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «قل....» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هل يستوي الأعمى» is in the position of accusative as the fourth maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «تتفكرون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. "do you not hear, and so reflect on it?"

* Morphology:
(الأعمى): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb عمي يعمى, of the pattern-class فرح; its pattern is أفعل. It contains a weakening (iʿlāl) by conversion: the yāʾ — the lām of the word — was converted to alif because it is quiescent and what precedes it has fatḥa [Translator's note: so in the source; the usual statement is "because it is vowelled and preceded by fatḥa"].
(خزائن): plural of خزانة, a noun for that in which necessities are kept; its pattern is فِعالة with kasra on the fāʾ, and the plural is فعائل.
(يوحى): it contains a weakening by conversion to suit the passive form; its active is يوحي; the yāʾ was converted to alif because it is vowelled and preceded by fatḥa.

* Rhetoric:
1- Antithesis (al-ṭibāq): between الأعمى and البصير; they are two eloquent similes for the one astray and the one rightly guided. They may also be considered explicit metaphors (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya), because the thing likened is not mentioned and the thing it is likened to is mentioned.
2- The interrogation departing from its original meaning: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمى وَالْبَصِيرُ». The interrogation here is disapproving (inkārī); the intent is to deny the equality of one who does not know the realities mentioned and one who knows them, while signalling their complete evidence, repelling from misguidance and encouraging toward guidance; and the command is repeated to fix the reproach firmly and to emphasize the binding argument.

* Benefits:
1- The style of restriction (ḥaṣr) is frequent in the Noble Qur'an, because it is a means of establishing rulings and emphasizing them.
Most often it comes preceded by negation, whether by «ما», «لا» or «إن», as in this verse. And in all of these «إلا» departs from being a particle of exception and becomes a particle of restriction. Nothing more..!

safi-cedvel:51-51.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (أنذر) an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "anta"; (الباء) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنذر); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يخافون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (يحشروا) an imperfect passive verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يحشروا) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, governed by يحشروا [Translator's note: so in the source; the governing verb is evidently يخافون, as the gloss shows], i.e. they fear their being gathered to their Lord.
(إلى رب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يحشروا), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ليس) an incomplete, non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb; (لهم) like به, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of laysa placed first; (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ولي», and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ولي) the noun of laysa placed after, nominative; (الواو) conjunctive; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), for emphasizing the negation; (شفيع) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to وليّ, nominative like it; (لعل) a particle resembling the verb, for hope (tarajjī), and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of laʿalla; (يتّقون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «يخافون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين) ...
The clause «أنذر....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clauses of قل in the previous verse.
The clause «يحشروا....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «ليس لهم ... وليّ» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the nāʾib fāʿil of the verb يحشروا.].
The clause «لعلهم يتقون» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يتقون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(شفيع): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from شفع يشفع, of the pattern-class فتح; its pattern is فعيل.

safi-cedvel:52-52.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تطرد) an imperfect verb, jussive, vowelled with kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يدعون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ربهم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بالغداة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يدعون); (العشي) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الغداة by the wāw, genitive like it; (يريدون) like يدعون; (وجه) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ما) negating; (على) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (من حساب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of شيء, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (شيء) genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; (الواو) conjunctive; (ما من حسابك ... شيء) like its counterpart [Note: (من حسابك) may be made the khabar or a ḥāl, and likewise (عليك), interchangeably.]; (الفاء) the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya); (تطرد) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the fāʾ, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "anta"; (الفاء) conjunctive; (تكون) an incomplete imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (تطرد) [Note: This is the view of al-Zamakhsharī ... The fāʾ may also be the fāʾ of causation, with the verb accusative by an implied «أن», and the interpreted maṣdar (أن تكون ... ) conjoined to a maṣdar extracted (mutaṣayyad) from the preceding prohibition, i.e. "let there be no driving away from you ... and so wrongdoing".], and its noun is a latent pronoun implied as "anta"; (من الظالمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of تكون, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تطردهم) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding negation, i.e. "there is no taking to account, and so [no] driving away".
The clause «لا تطرد ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنذر in the previous [verse].
The clause «يدعون....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يريدون....» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يدعون.
The clause «ما عليك....» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya) — or an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «ما من حسابك ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ما عليك ...
The clause «تطردهم....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «تكون من الظالمين» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تطردهم.

* Morphology:
(الغداة): a noun for the time between dawn and sunrise; its origin is الغدوة with fatḥa on the dāl and the wāw; since the wāw was vowelled and preceded by fatḥa, it was converted to alif; so the word contains a weakening (iʿlāl) by conversion.

* Rhetoric:
1- The art of radd al-ʿajuz ʿalā al-ṣadr (returning the end upon the beginning): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَما مِنْ حِسابِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ». The meaning of this art is that the speaker places one of two words — agreeing in pronunciation and meaning, or similar in pronunciation but not meaning, or joined by derivation or quasi-derivation — at the end of the speech, after placing the other word at its beginning.

* Benefits:
- Among the images of equality in Islam:
The chiefs of the polytheists said to the Messenger ﷺ: "If you drove away from us these slaves — «ʿAmmār ibn Yāsir, Ṣuhayb and Bilāl» — and those like them, we would sit with you and converse with you." He ﷺ said: "I am not one to drive away the believers." They said: "Then make them rise away from us when we come, and when we leave, seat them with you if you wish." He said: "Yes," hoping for their Islam. They said: "Write us a document to that effect." So he brought the sheet and called ʿAlī to write. And behold, Jibrīl descended from heaven conveying to the Messenger of Allah the saying of Allah the Exalted: «وَلا تَطْرُدِ ...», the verse.
This is one of the splendid images of equality in Islam ... !

safi-cedvel:10-10.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath, (قد) a particle of verification (taḥqīq), (استهزئ) a passive past verb, (برسل) a preposition and its genitive noun, in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of رسل [Note: Or attached to the verb (استهزئ).], and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), (الفاء) conjunction, to connect the effect with the cause, (حاق) a past verb, (الباء) a preposition, (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to (حاق), (سخروا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (سخروا) [Note: If the pronoun refers back to those who mocked, the preposition is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of سخروا.], (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of حاق, and the referential pronoun (al-ʿāʾid) is the هاء in (به) [Note: Here He put the cause in place of the effect, which is the punishment understood from the context of the verse, i.e. the punishment whose cause was their mocking of the messengers encompassed them ... It is also permissible for (ما) to be a maṣdar-forming particle, i.e. "their mocking", and the هاء in (به) refers back to the messenger implied in the plural, i.e. the consequence of ... encompassed them] [Translator's note: The footnote breaks off at "حاق بهم عاقبة" in the source.] (كانوا) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the noun of كان, (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يستهزئون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «استهزئ ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to an implied oath.
The clause «حاق ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the response clause.
The clause «سخروا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of (ما), the nominal or the particle relative.
The clause «يستهزئون» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

* Morphology:
(حاق), it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion (qalb): the alif in it was originally a yāʾ, because its imperfect is يحيق; the yāʾ came with a vowel after a fatḥa, so it was converted into an alif.

* Rhetoric:
1- Kināya (metonymy): in His saying, the Exalted, «فَحاقَ بِالَّذِينَ», for it is a kināya for their destruction, and attributing it to what it was attributed to is a rational (ʿaqlī) figure of speech, since it is known that the doctrine of the people of truth is that the Destroyer is none but Allah the Exalted, so attributing it to other than Him can only be figurative.
2- The art of returning the end to the beginning (radd al-aʿjāz ʿalā al-ṣudūr): in this verse there is a kind of verbal and semantic embellishment which the scholars of rhetoric called «returning the end to the beginning (radd al-ʿajuz ʿalā al-ṣadr)». It is a subtle art in which the poets of old competed, and the prose writers followed them; this art remains a kind of beauty as long as it does not enter the door of artificiality and affectation. Of this art is His saying, the Exalted: وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَحاقَ بِالَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا مِنْهُمْ ما كانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ.
Notice with me this echoing between «استهزئ and يستهزئون», and how the soul finds rest in this correspondence, as though it had been waiting for it to come before it came ... Many poets eyed this art and aspired to it before it turned from craftsmanship into artificiality..
ثوى بالثرى من كان يحيى به الثرى ... ويغمر صرف الدهر نائله الغمر
(In the soil lies one by whom the soil used to be revived, whose abundant bounty would overwhelm the vicissitudes of time.)

safi-cedvel:11-11.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you), (سيروا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (سيروا) [Note: It may be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in (سيروا).], (ثم) a conjunction, (انظروا) like سيروا, (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان, (كان) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, (عاقبة) the noun of كان, nominative (marfūʿ), (المكذبين) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «سيروا....» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying).
The clause «انظروا ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause of the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «كان عاقبة ...» is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.

safi-cedvel:12-12.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) like the previous «1», (اللام) a preposition, (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate), (ما) a noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما, (الواو) conjunction, (الأرض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات, genitive like it, (قل) like the first «2», (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar, and the mubtadaʾ is implied, indicated by the previous mubtadaʾ, i.e.: what is in the heavens belongs to Allah, (كتب) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he), (على نفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كتب) by making it include the meaning of أوجب and قضى (made obligatory, decreed), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), (الرحمة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), (اللام) occurring in the response to an implied oath, (يجمع) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative ... (والنون) for emphasis, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", (إلى يوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجمعنكم) by making it include the meaning of يؤخرنكم (He will surely defer you), (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, (لا) of generic negation, (ريب) noun of لا, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative, (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to the omitted khabar of لا, (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, (خسروا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida) [Note: The الفاء came as redundant because its addition in the khabar is not prohibited in the view of the majority, or because (الذين) has a resemblance to a condition, which required connecting its khabar with the الفاء.], (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, (لا) negating, (يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
[Translator's note: The footnote markers «1» and «2» have no accompanying footnote text in the source.]
The clause «قل....» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لمن ما في السموات» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying).
The clause «قل (the second)» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) to confirm the first clause.
The clause «(هو) لله» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «كتب ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive, not included within the scope of the saying.
The clause «ليجمعنكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to an implied oath.
The clause «لا ريب فيه» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of يوم القيامة.
The clause «الذين خسروا....» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «خسروا أنفسهم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هم لا يؤمنون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «لا يؤمنون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

safi-cedvel:13-13.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate), (ما) a relative noun, postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), (سكن) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (it), and it is the referential pronoun (al-ʿāʾid), (في الليل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of سكن [Note: Or attached to (سكن).], (الواو) conjunction, (النهار) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الليل, genitive [Note: If (سكن) is interpreted in the meaning of "dwelt/settled", there is no omission in the verse; if it is interpreted in the meaning of "became still", there is an omission in the verse, i.e.: to Him belongs what is still in the night and moves in the day.], (الواو) conjunction, (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, (السميع) khabar, nominative (marfūʿ), (العليم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «له ما سكن ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: It may be conjoined to the reported clause in the previous verse, i.e. "and say: to Him belongs what dwells ..."].
The clause «سكن» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «هو السميع....» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Rhetoric:
1- Sufficing with one of two opposites (al-iktifāʾ): in His saying, the Exalted, «ما سَكَنَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهارِ», as in His saying, the Exalted, «سَرابِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ الْحَرَّ». The implied form is "what is still and what moves"; He sufficed with stillness in place of its opposite, rather than the reverse, because stillness is more widespread in existence and the end of every moving thing is stillness, and because stillness is usually a blessing, being rest, which is not so with movement.

safi-cedvel:14-15.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you), (الهمزة) for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), (غير) a fronted first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), (أتخذ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا" (I), (وليا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, (فاطر) badal (substitute) of the Name of Majesty, genitive like it, or a naʿt (adjective) of it, (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, (الواو) conjunction, (الأرض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات, genitive, (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya), (هو) like the previous [Note: In the previous verse.], (يطعم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "هو" (He), (الواو) conjunction, (لا) negating, (يطعم) a passive imperfect verb, nominative, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", (قل) like the first, (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters) and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of إنّ, (أمرت) a passive past verb ... and the tāʾ is a pronoun in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil, (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle, (أكون) a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا", (أول) khabar (predicate) of أكون, accusative, (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi [Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified (nakira mawṣūfa), occurring in the place of a collective noun, i.e. "the first group that submitted", and the clause after it is in the position of the genitive as its naʿt.], (أسلم) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and it is the referential pronoun (al-ʿāʾid).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أكون) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted باء, i.e. بأن أكون ..., attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أمرت).
(الواو) conjunction, (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing, (تكوننّ) a defective imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) ... and the nūn is for emphasis, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت", (من المشركين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of تكونن, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أتخذ ...» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying).
The clause «هو يطعم» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
The clause «لا يطعم» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هو).
The clause «لا يطعم» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يطعم.
[Translator's note: The first of these two lines evidently intends the clause «يطعم» (without لا) as the khabar of هو; the source repeats «لا يطعم», and it is translated as written.]
The clause «قل (the second)» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «إنّي أمرت» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أمرت» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «أكون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «لا تكوننّ ...» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl of an implied saying, i.e.: it was said to me: "Do not be ..."; and the implied clause of saying is conjoined to the resumptive clause قل [Note: It may be conjoined to the resumptive clause قل إني ..., so it has no grammatical position.].
(قل) like the first, (إنّي أخاف) like إنّي أمرت, but the verb is active and the fāʿil is "أنا", (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle, (عصيت) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) ... and the tāʾ is the fāʿil, (ربّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on what precedes the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, (عذاب) mafʿūl bihi governed by أخاف, accusative, (يوم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, (عظيم) naʿt of يوم, genitive.
The clause «قل....» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «إنّي أخاف....» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أخاف....» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «عصيت ...» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical ... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the content of the preceding speech, i.e. if I disobey my Lord, the punishment will befall me.

* Morphology:
(فاطر), active participle of the triliteral فطر; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:75-79.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (الكاف) a preposition of comparison «[Note: Or a noun in the sense of "like" (مثل), in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar.. According to some, the kāf is in the sense of the lām of reason, i.e. "and on account of that disapproval We show Ibrāhīm the dominion ..."]». (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq «[Note: Or attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "and the matter is thus".]», and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address. (نري) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "We" (نحن), for majesty. (إبراهيم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), prevented from nunation on account of being a proper name and foreign. (ملكوت) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (الواو) conjunction. (الأرض) conjoined to السموات, genitive. (الواو) conjunction. (اللام) of reason (taʿlīl). (يكون) a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — accusative by an implied أن after the lām; its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو). (من الموقنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of يكون.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يكون) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (نري); and it is conjoined to an omitted interpreted maṣdar, i.e. "We show him ... so that he may infer, and so that he may be among those who are certain".
The clause «نري إبراهيم....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumptive [clause], i.e.: "We showed him the error of his people and his father, and We show him the dominion of the heavens ... likewise".
The clause «يكون ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
(76) (الفاء) conjunction. (لمّا) an adverb in the sense of "when" (حين), containing the meaning of a condition, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, attached to the apodosis رأى. (جنّ) a past verb. (على) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (جنّ). (الليل) fāʿil, nominative. (رأى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو). (كوكبا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (قال) like جنّ. (ها) a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (ربّ) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi «[Note: al-Akhfash makes this clause non-declarative (inshāʾiyya) by assuming an interrogative hamza before it, i.e.: "Is this my Lord? ..."]».
(فلمّا أفل) like فلمّا جنّ. (قال) like جنّ. (لا) negative. (أحبّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "I" (أنا). (الآفلين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «جنّ عليه الليل ...»: in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «رأى....»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «قال (the first) ....»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «هذا ربّي»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «أفل....»: in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال (the second) ....»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لا أحبّ....»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
(78) «[Translator's note: so in the source; this section is verse 77.]» (فلمّا رأى) like فلمّا جنّ. (القمر) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (بازغا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of القمر. (قال هذا ربّي) «[Note: See footnote no. (1) on the previous page.]» like the first. (فلمّا أفل قال) like the first. (اللام) the lām preparing for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam). (إن) a jussive conditional particle. (لم) a particle of negation only. (يهد) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter..
and (النون) for protection (al-wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (ربّ) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (اللام) the lām of the oath. (أكوننّ) a defective imperfect verb — an abrogator — indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative.. and the nūn is for emphasis; its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "I" (أنا). (من القوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of أكون. (الضالّين) a naʿt (adjective) of القوم, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «رأى القمر....»: in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال ... (the second)»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «هذا ربّي»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أفل (the second)»: in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال (the fourth)»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لئن لم يهدني ربّي ...»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أكوننّ ...»: has no grammatical position, the answer to the oath ... and the apodosis of the condition (إن) is omitted, the answer to the oath indicating it.
(78) (فلمّا رأى الشمس بازغة) like لمّا رأى القمر بازغا. (قال هذا ربّي) like the first. (هذا) like the first. (أكبر) khabar, nominative. (فلما أفلت قال) like فلمّا أفل قال, and the tāʾ in the verb is for the feminine. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator — and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna. (بريء) the khabar [of inna], nominative. (من) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to بريء «[Note: Or a maṣdar particle which, together with the verb, is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the genitive ... and the clause after it is the ṣila of the particle relative.]». (تشركون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «رأى الشمس ...»: in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال (the fifth)»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «هذا ربّي»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «هذا أكبر»: in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) of the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أفلت ...»: in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال (the sixth) ....»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of the condition.
The vocative clause «يا قوم, and what is within its scope»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl «[Note: The vocative clause may be parenthetical and so have no grammatical position, and the clause إنّي بريء is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.]».
The clause «إنّي بريء ...»: has no grammatical position, the answer to the vocative.
The clause «تشركون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما). And all the conditional clauses and their apodoses are conjoined to the preceding resumption.
(79) (إنّي) like the first. (وجّهت) a past verb and its fāʿil. (وجه) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (اللام) a preposition. (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (وجّهت). (فطر) like جنّ. (السموات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (الواو) conjunction. (الأرض) conjoined to السموات, accusative. (حنيفا) a ḥāl, accusative, of the agent pronoun in (وجّهت). (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negative «[Note: It may be operating like laysa.]». (أنا) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ «[Note: It may be in the position of the nominative as the noun of mā, with the preposition and its genitive noun as the khabar.]». (من المشركين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «إنّي وجّهت ...»: has no grammatical position, a badal of the clause إلّي بريء «[Translator's note: so in the source, a misprint for إنّي بريء.]» «[Note: Or it is an explanatory resumption.]».
The clause «وجّهت ...»: in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «فطر السّموات»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative الذي.
The clause «ما أنا من المشركين»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّي وجهت.

* Morphology:
(نري): it has the deletion of two hamzas for lightening: the first is the augment hamza, because its past form أرى is on the pattern أفعل, and the second is the ʿayn of the word.. Its original form is نؤرئي; the first hamza was deleted just as it is deleted from the imperfect of every verb on the pattern أفعل, such as يخرج and يكرم ... and the second was deleted in the verb رأى specifically..
The pattern of نري is نفي.
(ملكوت): a noun for what is owned, in the sense of المُلك (dominion); they said it is specific to the dominion of Allah the Exalted, and this is what is fitting. Its pattern is فعلوت.
(الموقنين): plural of الموقن, an active participle from the quadriliteral أيقن, on the pattern مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.. The word has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution: its original form is ميقن; the yāʾ came quiescent after a ḍamma, so it was changed to wāw, and it became (موقن).
(رأى): it has iʿlāl by substitution: its original form is رأي — with yāʾ at its end; the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was changed to alif.
(كوكبا): a primitive (jāmid) noun for the extinguished heavenly body. Its pattern is فعلل, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(الآفلين): plural of الآفل, an active participle from the triliteral أفل. Its pattern is فاعل ...
The hamza of the verb was merged with the alif of فاعل, because the hamza is vowelled with fatḥa and the alif is quiescent, and the madda was placed above it.
(بازغا): an active participle from the triliteral بزغ. Its pattern is فاعل.
(يهدني): it has iʿlāl by deletion on account of the jussive. Its pattern is يفعني.

* Rhetoric:
1- The interrogative departing from its original meaning: in the saying of the Exalted «قالَ هذا رَبِّي», for in the speech there is an omitted interrogative of disapproval; omitting the interrogative particle is frequent in their speech, and of it is the saying of the Exalted «فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ», i.e. "has he then not attempted (أفلا اقتحم)".
2- The art of allusion (taʿrīḍ): in this noble verse, where he alluded to their error here; and he, upon him be peace, did not allude to their being in error until he was confident that they would listen to the full purpose and hear him out to the end. The proof of that is that he ﷺ rose, in the third round, to declaring openly his disavowal of them and declaring openly that they were in polytheism, when the proof against them had been fully established, the truth had dawned, and it had reached the utmost degree of clarity.

safi-cedvel:80-80.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (حاجّ) a past verb, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (قوم) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (قال) a past verb; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو). (الهمزة) interrogative. (تحاجّون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and the second (النون), merged with the sign of the nominative, is for protection (al-wiqāya). (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (في الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تحاجّون), with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "concerning the oneness of Allah". (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq). (هدى) a past verb, and (النون) for protection, and the omitted yāʾ of the speaker is the mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) resumptive. (لا) negative. (أخاف) an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "I" (أنا).
