(ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, and the clause after it is a naʿt (adjective) of it.]». (تشركون) like تحاجّون. (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (تشركون) «[Note: The pronoun in (به) may possibly refer back to the worshipped idol or to the Name of Majesty.]». (إلّا) a particle of exception. (أن) a maṣdar and subjunctive particle. (يشاء) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb). (ربّ) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (شيئا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, i.e. "some willing".]».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يشاء ربّي) is in the position of the accusative as an excepted [term] in a disjunctive (munqaṭiʿ) or conjunctive (muttaṣil) exception, i.e. "except the will of my Lord [that I] fear what you have associated".
(وسع) a past verb. (ربّي) like the first. (كلّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (علما) tamyīz (specification) «[Note: If (وسع) were made to carry the meaning of "knew" (علم), the word (علما) would be a mafʿūl muṭlaq.]», accusative. (الهمزة) like the first. (الفاء) resumptive. (لا) negative. (تتذكّرون) like تحاجّون.
The clause «حاجّه قومه ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قال....»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أتحاجّونّي ...»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «قد هدان....»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of تحاجّونيّ, or of the Name of Majesty.
The clause «لا أخاف....»: has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the speech.
The clause «تشركون....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «يشاء ربّي»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «وسع ربّي....»: has no grammatical position, giving the reason for the exception.
The clause «تتذكّرون»: has no grammatical position, resumptive «[Note: It may be conjoined by the fāʾ to an implied resumptive clause, i.e. "do you turn away, and so not take heed?"]».

* Morphology:
(هدان): it has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution: its original form is هدي, with yāʾ; the yāʾ came vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was changed to alif.

* Rhetoric:
1- Using the overt noun in place of the pronoun: in the saying of the Exalted «وَسِعَ رَبِّي كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْماً», as emphasis of the meaning mentioned and taking delight in mentioning Him, Glorified and Exalted is He.

* Benefits:
1- أَفَلا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ — ألا: the opening (istiftāḥiyya) [particle] occurs for several purposes, among them: rebuke and disapproval. It is composed of the interrogative hamza and the negative lā, and the fāʾ has been inserted between them.
In this verse Allah rebukes them and disapproves of their failure to recall the truth and to grasp the reality.

safi-cedvel:118-119.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. (كلوا): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (من): a preposition. (ما): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كلوا) «[Note: It may be an indefinite noun qualified by what follows, in the position of the genitive.]». (ذكر): past verb, passive. (اسم): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (على): a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (ذكر). (إن): a jussive conditional particle. (كنتم): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogating verb (nāsikh) — indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) … and (تم) a pronoun, the noun of كان. (بآيات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مؤمنين, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (مؤمنين): khabar (predicate) of كنتم, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «كلوا ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. if you, O Muslims, are true in faith, then eat …
The clause «ذكر اسم..» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما) «[Note: Or in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of (ما) taken as an indefinite qualified noun.]».
The clause «كنتم مؤمنين» has no grammatical position: an explication of the implied condition mentioned before; the apodosis of the second condition is omitted, indicated by the apodosis of the first condition.
(الواو): conjunction. (ما): interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (اللام): a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to the omitted khabar of ما. (أن): a maṣdar particle. (لا): negating. (تأكلوا): imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألا تأكلوا) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "what is with you in your not eating".
(مما ذكر ... عليه): like the first. (الواو): of the ḥāl. (قد): particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (فصّل): past verb, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (لكم): like the first, attached to (فصل). (ما): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (حرم عليكم): like فصّل لكم. (إلا): particle of exception, connected or disconnected (muttaṣil or munqaṭiʿ). (ما): like the preceding, accusative as the excepted. (اضطررتم): past verb, passive … and (تم) a pronoun, nāʾib fāʿil. (إلى): a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (اضطررتم). (الواو): resumptive. (إن): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle. (كثيرا): noun of إنّ, accusative. (اللام): for emphasis. (يضلون): imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (بأهواء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يضلون), the bāʾ being causal, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (بغير): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يضلّون, i.e. "clothed with lack of knowledge". (علم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إن ربك ... بالمعتدين): the i'rab of its like has already passed «[Note: In verse (117) of this sūra.]».
The clause «ما لكم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the implied conditional clause.
The clause «تأكلوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «ذكر اسم الله» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «فصّل لكم ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «حرّم عليكم» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «اضطررتم..» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the third relative (ما).
The clause «إن كثيرا ليضلون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يضلون..» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of إن.
The clause «إن ربك هو أعلم» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Benefits:
1- «ما لَكُمْ أَلَّا تَأْكُلُوا»: «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
The interrogative has two particles, the hamza and هل, and nine nouns: «ما, من, أي, كم, كيف, أين, أنى, متى and أيان».
All the interrogative tools are divided, with respect to taṣawwur (conception) and taṣdīq (assent), into three groups:
1- «هل» for taṣdīq only.
2- «الهمزة» shared between taṣawwur and taṣdīq.
3- The remaining interrogative nouns are for seeking taṣawwur without taṣdīq. Consult the books of rhetoric (balāgha) for a full treatment of this topic.

safi-cedvel:120-121.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (ذروا): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (ظاهر): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الإثم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الواو): conjunction. (باطن): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ظاهر, accusative, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (إن): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh). (الذين): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as the noun of إن. (يكسبون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الإثم): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (السين): particle of the future. (يجزون): imperfect verb, passive, nominative … and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (الباء): a preposition. (ما): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يجزون) «[Note: (ما) may be a maṣdar particle, the interpreted maṣdar being in the position of the genitive; and it may be an indefinite noun.]». (كانوا): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma … and the wāw is the noun of كان. (يقترفون): like يكسبون.
The clause «ذروا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «إن الذين ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يكسبون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «سيجزون ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of إن.
The clause «كانوا يقترفون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يقترفون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of كانوا.
(الواو): conjunction. (لا): the jussive lā of prohibition. (تأكلوا): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (مما لم يذكر اسم الله عليه): the i'rab of its like has already passed «[Note: In verse (118) of this sūra.]». (الواو): resumptive. (إن): like the first, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of إن. (اللام): for emphasis. (فسق): khabar, nominative. (الواو): resumptive. (إن): like the first. (الشياطين): noun of إن, accusative. (اللام): like the first. (يوحون): like يكسبون. (إلى أولياء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يوحون), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (اللام): the lām of purpose (lām al-taʿlīl). (يجادلوا): imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يجادلوا) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (يوحون).
(الواو): conjunction. (إن): a jussive conditional particle «[Note: The lām that prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam) has been omitted for lightness, and the answer has come joined with the lām in His saying: (إنكم لمشركون).]». (أطعتم): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) … (وتم) a pronoun, fāʿil, and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida), lengthening the vowel of the mīm, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (إنّكم لمشركون): like إنه لفسق, the sign of the nominative of the khabar being the wāw.
The clause «لا تأكلوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ذروا.
The clause «يذكر اسم ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «إنه لفسق» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: It may be in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) … just as it may be conjoined to the performative (inshāʾī) clause before it, on the view of Sībawayh.]».
The clause «إن الشياطين.» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يوحون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of إن.
The clause «يجادلوكم» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «إن أطعتموهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause إن الشياطين ...
The clause «إنكم لمشركون» has no grammatical position: the answer to an implied oath … and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath.

* Morphology:
(ظاهر): active participle of the three-letter verb ظهر; its pattern is فاعل.
(باطن): active participle of the three-letter verb بطن; its pattern is فاعل.
(يوحون): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by quiescence and iʿlāl by deletion. Its origin is يوحيون, with ḍamma on both yāʾs; the ḍamma on the second yāʾ was felt heavy so it was made quiescent, and the vowel was moved to the ḥāʾ — iʿlāl by quiescence — then the yāʾ was deleted because it came quiescent together with the wāw of the plural, and it became (يوحون); its pattern is يفعون.

* Benefits:
1- This verse is the site of an unending disagreement among the jurists concerning the ruling of permission and prohibition,
and among the grammarians concerning this wāw, on account of which the disagreement among the jurists broke out.
The outcome of this disagreement is as follows:
a- al-Shaʿbī, Ibn Sīrīn and Mālik hold that it is prohibited, whether the invocation of the Name (al-tasmiya) was omitted deliberately or through forgetfulness.
b- al-Thawrī and Abū Ḥanīfa distinguished between the two cases: they said that if the tasmiya is omitted deliberately the animal is prohibited, and if it is omitted through forgetfulness it is permitted.
c- al-Shāfiʿī and Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal said that the slaughtered animal is permitted, whether the tasmiya was omitted deliberately or through forgetfulness.
Their reasoning for that is that the wāw is not a conjunction but a wāw of ḥāl, so eating is prohibited only in the case of its being an act of transgression (fisq). So choose — may Allah protect you from error.
And if you are one who loves verification, refer to the books of jurisprudence, for in them is what you aspire to verify.

safi-cedvel:151-151.t:
* I'rab:
(قل): its i'rab has been given before [Note: In ayah (149) of this sūra.]. (تعالوا): a frozen (jāmid) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on what its ending is pronounced with, and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent). (أتل): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (حرّم): a past verb. (ربّ): fāʿil, nominative, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (على): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حرّم) [Note: Or to the verb أتل.].
(أن): a particle of explanation [Note: It is preceded by a word with the meaning of saying, namely أتل ... The following commands are conjoined to the prohibitions and fall under the explicative (أن), on the assumption of an omission, i.e.: what He has forbidden you and what He has commanded you; so He stated explicitly what He forbade and omitted what He commanded, and the meaning is: what He has prohibited you from and what He has commanded you ... and the command relates to kindness to parents, giving full measure and weight, speaking justly ... etc.
Further, (أن) may be a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative and is interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun); then (لا) with it is a redundant (zāʾida) particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) for the omitted resumptive pronoun, i.e.: I will recite what your Lord has forbidden you: your associating anything with Him; or it is a badal for (ما) ... It may also be in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: what is forbidden is your associating.
And (لا) may be a negating particle, in which case the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, the implied form being: I enjoin upon you your not associating; or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar precedes it, namely (عليكم), and the pause is then at ربّكم, i.e.: upon you is not associating.]. (لا): a prohibitive particle that puts the verb in the jussive. (تشركوا): an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (تشركوا). (شيئا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar ... i.e. anything of association.]. (الواو): conjunction. (بالوالدين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "أوصيكم" (I enjoin you) [Note: It may be attached to the maṣdar (إحسانا) ... and the bāʾ is synonymous with (إلى) with this verb ...
Or it is on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e.: kindness in dutifulness to parents ... The implied element may also be what governs the maṣdar, i.e.: be kind to parents. See further explanation and detail at ayah (83) of Sūrat al-Baqara.]. (إحسانا): mafʿūl bihi of the implied verb, accusative [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, standing in place of the verb in the command, as though He said: and be kind to parents ... or it is an emphasis of the verb ... It may also be a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) of an omitted verb, i.e.: We enjoined you concerning parents out of kindness from Us, i.e. for the sake of Our kindness; and the verb has come explicitly in the words of the Exalted: «ووصينا الإنسان بوالديه حسنا ...».]. (الواو): conjunction. (لا تقتلوا): like لا تشركوا. (أولاد): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (من إملاق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تقتلوا), and (من) is causal. (نحن): a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, in the position of nominative. (نرزق): an imperfect verb, nominative, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن", for majesty. (الواو): conjunction. (إيّاهم): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, conjoined to the attached pronoun in (نرزقكم). (الواو): conjunction. (لا تقربوا الفواحش): like لا تقتلوا أولادكم. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a badal of الفواحش, a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl). (ظهر): a past verb, and the fāʿil is "huwa". (من): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil pronoun. (الواو): conjunction. (ما بطن): like ما ظهر and conjoined to it. (الواو): conjunction. (ولا تقتلوا النفس): like لا تقتلوا أولادكم. (التي): a relative, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of النفس. (حرّم): like the first. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (إلّا): a particle of restriction. (بالحقّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil in (تقتلوا), i.e.: do not kill it except while being in accordance with the right [Note: The preposition and its genitive noun may be attached to an omitted naʿt of an implied mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e.: except a killing that is in accordance with the right.]. (ذلكم): a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the reference is to the five matters mentioned. (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) is for address. (وصّى): a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "huwa". (به): like the first, attached to (وصّاكم). (لعلّ): a particle resembling the verb, for hope — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of لعلّ. (تعقلون): an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قل ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تعالوا ...»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أتل ...»: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if you come, I will recite.
The clause «حرّم ربّكم ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا تشركوا ...»: has no grammatical position, explicative.
The clause «(أوصيكم) بالوالدين»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the explicative clause «1».
The clause «لا تقتلوا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the explicative clause «2».
The clause «نحن نرزقكم»: has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «نرزقكم ...»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of نحن.
The clause «لا تقربوا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the explicative clause.
The clause «ظهر ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the first relative (ما).
The clause «بطن ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «لا تقتلوا (the second)»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the explicative clause.
The clause «حرّم الله»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (التي).
The clause «ذلكم وصّاكم»: has no grammatical position, parenthetical.
The clause «وصّاكم به»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلكم).
The clause «لعلّكم تعقلون»: has no grammatical position, causal.
The clause «تعقلون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of لعلّ.

* Morphology:
(أتل): it has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the jussive; its origin is أتلو, and its pattern is أفع with ḍamma on the ʿayn.
(إملاق): a regular maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb أملق; its pattern is إفعال with kasra on the hamza.

* Rhetoric:
1- The device of tawhīm (creating a false impression): in the words of the Exalted «أَلَّا تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئاً». It is that the speaker brings a word whose following speech gives the impression that the speaker intended a distortion of it, while he intends something else. For the outward sense of the words in the noble ayah indicates the forbidding of the negation of shirk, the corollary of which is the permitting of shirk; and this is impossible and contrary to the intended meaning. The interpretation that resolves the difficulty is that the injunctions mentioned in the context of the ayah are what was forbidden to them and what they are commanded: for associating partners with Allah, killing the forbidden soul and consuming the orphan's property are among what is forbidden outwardly and inwardly, while giving full measure and weight with equity, and justice in speech — let alone in deed — fulfilling the covenant and following the straight path are among the acts commanded with an obligatory command. Had the speech come without «لا», it would have been cut off, disordered and its meaning corrupted, for the meaning would become: He has forbidden you shirk and kindness to parents, and this is the opposite of the intended meaning.
For this reason the addition whose outward sense gives the impression of a corrupted meaning came, so that one resorts to the interpretation by which the conjoining of the remaining injunctions to what preceded is sound.
1- The device of taghāyur (contrast): in the words of the Exalted «وَلا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلادَكُمْ مِنْ إِمْلاقٍ». Its definition is the contrast of two positions, either regarding a single meaning, such that a person praises or blames something, or blames what another has praised, and vice versa, or prefers one thing to another, then returns and makes the less-preferred the preferred. Among taghāyur is the contrast of meaning due to the contrast of wording, and this is what concerns us in this noble ayah. The wording in the ayah differs from His words on this meaning in Banī Isrāʾīl: «وَلا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلادَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ إِمْلاقٍ». The address in each ayah is to a category, and it is not a single address: the one addressed by His words, glorified is He, «مِنْ إِمْلاقٍ» is the one afflicted with poverty, and by the words of the Exalted «خَشْيَةَ إِمْلاقٍ» the one who has no poverty but fears its occurrence in the future. For this reason He put their provision first here, in His words, Mighty and Majestic is He, «نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ». [Translator's note: The wording quoted here is that of Banī Isrāʾīl (17:31); the ayah under discussion (6:151) reads «نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكُمْ وَإِيَّاهُمْ», in which the provision of the addressees (the parents) comes first.]

* Benefits:
1- This ayah is set forth to explain the forbidden acts, just as the previous ayah explained the forbidden foods. This ayah has included the forbidding of associating partners with Allah, mistreating parents, killing children because of poverty, engaging in obscenities both open and hidden, then killing a soul without a cause that permits killing; and all of that is detailed and explained in the books of fiqh and tafsir.

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الكاف) a preposition of likening [Note: Or a noun meaning "like", in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar that is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "and We tried [them] with a trying like that".]; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq governed by فتنا, i.e. "and with a trying like that We tried some of them"; and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; (فتنّا) a past verb.. (نا) the fāʿil (agent); (بعض) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ببعض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of بعضهم; (اللام) the lām of outcome (ʿāqiba) or of reason (taʿlīl); (يقولوا) an imperfect verb [Translator's note: the source omits "accusative" here] by an implied «أن» after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يقولوا) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (فتنّا).
(الهمزة) interrogative, for belittling; (ها) a particle of alerting; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (منّ) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (على) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (منّ); (من بين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (منّ) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl of the pronoun in «عليهم».], and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الهمزة) for interrogation; (ليس) an incomplete, non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of laysa, nominative; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (أعلم) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of laysa; (بالشاكرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أعلم), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «فتنّا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يقولوا....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «هؤلاء منّ الله....» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «منّ الله عليهم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هؤلاء).
The clause «ليس الله ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (إذا) an adverb (ẓarf) of the future containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis قل; (جاء) a past verb, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤمنون), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "anta"; (سلام) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative [Note: Beginning with an indefinite noun is permissible because the expression is a supplication, and supplication carries the meaning of generality, which is one of the justifying factors.]; (عليكم) like عليهم in the previous verse, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (كتب) like جاء; (رب) fāʿil, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (على نفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كتب), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الرحمة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna — it is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn) —; (من) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (عمل) a past verb, indeclinable, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "huwa"; (من) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (عمل); (سوءا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (بجهالة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil of عمل, i.e. "being involved in ignorance"; (ثم) a conjunction; (تاب) like عمل; (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تاب), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (أصلح) like عمل; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (إنّ) like the first, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna, referring to the Name of Majesty; (غفور) khabar, nominative; (رحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «جاءك الذين ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يؤمنون....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «قل....» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «سلام عليكم» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «كتب ربكم....» has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying [Note: The clause may be the maqūl al-qawl, with the clause (سلام عليكم) parenthetical.].
The clause «إنه من عمل....» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «من عمل ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «عمل منكم سوءا» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «تاب....» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause عمل....
The clause «أصلح» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause تاب.
The clause «إنّه غفور....» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined to the fāʾ, and the link with the condition is implied, i.e. "Forgiving, Merciful to him" [Note: In a reading, the hamza of (إنّ) may take fatḥa in both places, or fatḥa in the first and kasra in the second (al-Jamal, vol. 2, p. 35).].

* Morphology:
(سلام): a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the quadriliteral verb سلم [Translator's note: i.e. سلّم]; its pattern is فَعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:55-55.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (كذلك نفصل) like كذلك فتنا [Note: In verse (53) of this sūra.]; (الآيات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (الواو) conjunctive; (اللام) for reason (taʿlīl); (تستبين) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām; (سبيل) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (المجرمين) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تستبين) is in the position of genitive, conjoined to an omitted interpreted maṣdar, its implied form being "so that the truth may appear".... attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نفصّل).
The clause «نفصّل ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تستبين» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).

* Morphology:
(المجرمين): plural of المجرم, an active participle from the quadriliteral أجرم; its pattern is مُفْعِل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:56-58.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "anta"; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; (نهيت) a past passive verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn ... and (التاء) a pronoun, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (أعبد) an imperfect verb, accusative, its fāʿil a latent pronoun implied as "anā"; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (تدعون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi, by making the verb تدعون include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "you make" [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied object pronoun in (تدعون), i.e. "you call on him as existing apart from Allah".]; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (قل) like the first; (لا) negating; (أتّبع) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "anā"; (أهواء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (ضللت) a past verb and its fāʿil; (إذا) a particle of answer with no grammatical position; (الواو) conjunctive; (ما) negating, operating like laysa; (أنا) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the noun of mā; (من المهتدين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of mā, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إني نهيت» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «نهيت» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «أعبد....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «تدعون....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «قل ... (the second)» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا أتبع....» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «قد ضللت ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) or giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «ما أنا من المهتدين» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قد ضللت.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أعبد....) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to (نهيت); the implied form is "I have been forbidden from worshipping ..."
(قل إني) like the first; (على بينة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of inna; (من رب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «بينة», with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "from my Lord's presence", and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (كذّبتم) like ضللت; (الباء) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (كذبتم); (ما) negating, inoperative (muhmala); (عند) an adverb (ẓarf) of place, accusative, attached to an omitted khabar placed first, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; (تستعجلون) like تدعون; (به) like the first, attached to (تستعجلون); (إن) negating; (الحكم) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (يقصّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (الحق) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunctive; (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (حير) [Translator's note: so in the source, a misprint for (خير)] nominative; (الفاصلين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إني على بينة» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «كذّبتم ... » is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, with "qad" implied.
The clause «ما عندي ما تستعجلون» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تستعجلون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «إن الحكم إلا لله» has no grammatical position, having the force of giving the reason.
The clause «يقص ... » is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the Name of Majesty.
The clause «هو خير ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يقص.
(قل) like the first; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (أن) a particle resembling the verb; (عندي ما تستعجلون به) like the first, the adverb being the khabar of anna and «ما» its noun; (اللام) occurring in the answer of law; (قضي) a past passive verb; (الأمر) nāʾib fāʿil, nominative; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ, attached to (قضي), and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (بينكم) like بيني, and attached to what that is attached to; (الواو) resumptive; (الله أعلم بالظالمين) the i'rab of its counterpart has passed.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لو (ثبت) وجود....» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «تستعجلون....» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «قضي الأمر» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «الله أعلم....» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن عندي ما تستعجلون به) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being "ثبت" (were established), i.e. "if the existence of what you seek to hasten were established, the matter would have been decided".

* Morphology:
(بيّنة): a derived adjective, sometimes used as a noun; its pattern is فَيْعِلة without weakening (iʿlāl), and the tāʾ is either for the feminine or for intensiveness.
(الفاصلين): plural of الفاصل, an active participle from the triliteral فصل; its pattern is فاعل.
(أعلم): a derived adjective that came on the pattern of the elative (ism al-tafḍīl) but has no comparison in it; the pattern of أعلم is أفعل, from علم يعلم, of the pattern-class فرح.

* Benefits:
1- al-Farrāʾ holds regarding the writing of «إذا» [Translator's note: so in the source; the discussion concerns إذن] that if it is operative it is written with alif, and if it is inoperative it is written with nūn; Ibn Kharūf followed him in this distinction, and it is a good and sound distinction.
إذن may occur as void (laghw), and that is when what precedes it requires what comes after it, as in the poet's saying:
وما أنا بالساعي إلى أم عاصم ... لأضربها اني إذن لجهول
(I am not one to go to Umm ʿĀṣim to strike her; then indeed I would be ignorant.)

safi-cedvel:16-16.t:
* I'rab:
(من) a jussive-governing conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), (يصرف) a passive imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (it), referring back to the punishment in the previous verse, (عن) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يصرف), (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (يصرف) [Note: It may be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (يصرف).], (إذ) an adverbial noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the tanwīn is a compensation for an omitted clause, (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), (قد) a particle of verification (taḥqīq), (رحمه) a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. Allah, (الواو) conjunction, (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ ... and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address, (الفوز) khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), (المبين) naʿt (adjective) of الفوز, nominative.
The clause «من يصرف....» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يصرف....» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: Or the khabar is the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «قد رحمه» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the الفاء.
The clause «ذلك الفوز....» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Benefits:
1- The tanwīn of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ)..
The tanwīn that attaches to «إذ» when it is joined to يوم or حين and what is in their group, such as الوقت, الساعة, القرن and the rest of this family..
as in يومئذ, حينئذ and ساعتئذ. The grammarians called it the tanwīn of compensation because it takes the place of the clause that ought properly to be mentioned after the adverb, the adverb then being annexed to it. It is a kind of concision (ījāz) in which the language of the ḍād is distinguished, and its aim is beautifying the wording besides brevity.
As for the kasra attached to the «ذال», it is not a kasra of declension, because «إذ» is permanently indeclinable; rather it is for the meeting of two vowelless letters.

safi-cedvel:17-17.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle, (يمسس) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), (بضرّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يمسس), (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), (لا) of generic negation, (كاشف) noun of لا, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative, (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of لا, (إلا) a particle of exception, (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as a badal (substitute) from the position of لا together with its noun [Note: Or a badal from the pronoun concealed in the khabar.] (الواو) conjunction, (إن يمسسك بخير) like إن يمسسك بضر, (الفاء) connecting the apodosis, (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), (على كل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قدير, (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, (قدير) khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو, nominative.
The clause «إن يمسسك الله....» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لا كاشف له....» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the الفاء.
The clause «إن يمسسك بخير» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «هو ... قدير» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis [Note: Some hold that this clause is causal, with no grammatical position, for both the first and the second apodosis ... and that the second apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: "there is none to repel it other than Him" - as came in Sūrat Yūnus, verse (107). What we have set down above is the view of Ibn Hishām, who made the clause (هو على كل شيء قدير) the apodosis of the second condition (Shudhūr al-Dhahab, p. 415, 3rd ed.).].

* Morphology:
(ضرّ), an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb ضر يضر, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma on the fāʾ. There is another maṣdar, ضرّ with fatḥa on the ḍād.
(كاشف) active participle of كشف يكشف, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:18-18.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), (القاهر) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), (فوق) an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (القاهر) [Note: Or attached to an omitted second khabar, its implied form being "غالب" (prevailing) or "مسيطر" (dominant) ... and it may be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in القاهر.], (عباد) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, (الواو) conjunction, (هو الحكيم) like هو القاهر, (الخبير) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «هو القاهر ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «هو الحكيم....» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(القاهر), active participle of قهر يقهر, of the class of فتح; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:19-19.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you), (أي) an interrogative noun, indeclinable [Translator's note: so in the source, although أيّ is normally declinable.], in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), (أكبر) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), (شهادة) tamyīz (specification), accusative (manṣūb), (قل) like the first, (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative, (شهيد) khabar, nominative [Note: Or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو", and the khabar of (الله) is omitted, indicated by the question at the beginning, i.e.: Allah is greatest in testimony.], (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on what precedes the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, and the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) (شهيد) [Note: Or attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of شهيد.], (الواو) a conjunction, (بينكم) an adverb like بيني and attached to what it is attached to, (الواو) a conjunction, (أوحي) a passive past verb, (إلى) a preposition and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أوحي), (ها) a particle of calling attention (tanbīh), (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), (القرآن) badal (substitute) of (ذا) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it, nominative, (اللام) the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl), (أنذر) an imperfect verb, accusative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا" (I), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أنذر).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أنذر) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (أوحي).
(الواو) conjunction, (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the pronoun of address in (أنذركم), and the referential pronoun (al-ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. "whom the Qur'an reached", (بلغ) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. the Qur'an, (الهمزة) for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters) and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of إن, (اللام) it is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), (تشهدون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, (أن) like إنّ, (مع) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar, (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, (آلهة) the noun of أن, accusative, (أخرى) naʿt of آلهة, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the fatḥa implied on the alif.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن مع الله آلهة) is in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi governed by تشهدون.
(قل) like the first, (لا) negating, (أشهد) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا", (قل) like the first, (إنما) the restraining [ما] and the restrained [إنّ] (kāffa wa-makfūfa), (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, (إله) khabar, nominative, (واحد) naʿt of إله, nominative, (الواو) conjunction, (إن) like the first, and (النون) for protection (al-wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of إنّ, (بريء) khabar of إنّ, nominative, (من) a preposition, (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to بريء [Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive, i.e. "of your associating".], (تشركون) like تشهدون.
The clause «قل ... (the first)» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أي شيء أكبر» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying).
The clause «قل ... (the second)» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «الله شهيد» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl ... and it is in the sense of the answer to the question.
The clause «أوحي إليّ....» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause الله شهيد [Note: It may be separated as a resumption, so that it has no grammatical position.].
The clause «أنذركم به» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied (muḍmar) particle-relative (أن).
The clause «بلغ» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «إنكم لتشهدون» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تشهدون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «قل ... (the third)» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لا أشهد» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «قل ... (the fourth)» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «هو إله ...» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «إنني بريء....» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause هو إله ...
The clause «تشركون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).

* Rhetoric:
- The interrogative departing from its original meaning: in His saying, the Exalted, «أَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ مَعَ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً أُخْرى», the interrogative here is for affirmation (taqrīr) or for disapproval (inkār), and it is said: for both, and in it there is a combination of figurative meanings.

* Benefits:
- The grammarians devoted a special section to «أي», and clarified that it comes to indicate several matters; they mentioned divisions of it, which we touch on briefly:
a- It is used to request the specification of a thing, as in «أي رجل جاء؟ (which man came?)» ...
b- It is a link for addressing what has «ال», with the hāʾ of calling attention attached, as in «يا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ»; we touched on this division previously.
c- It is a relative noun..
d- It may come to indicate the meaning of perfection, and is called «أيّ of perfection (al-kamāliyya)», as in «خالد رجل أي رجل (Khālid is a man, and what a man!)», i.e. he is perfect in the qualities of men; it is parsed as an adjective after an indefinite noun and as a ḥāl (circumstantial) after a definite noun.

safi-cedvel:20-20.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), (آتينا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... (ونا) fāʿil (agent), and (هم) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), (الكتاب) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), (يعرفون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, (الكاف) a preposition, (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle, (يعرفون) like the first, (أبناء) mafʿūl bihi, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يعرفون) is in the position of the genitive by the الكاف, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. they know [it] with a knowing like their knowing of their sons.
(الذين خسروا) like الذين آتينا, (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida), because the relative noun resembles the condition, (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, (لا) negating, (يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «الذين آتيناهم..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آتيناهم الكتاب» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يعرفونه» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «يعرفون أبناءهم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «الذين خسروا» has no grammatical position, being a badal (substitute) from the resumptive clause - or resumptive.
The clause «خسروا..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هم لا يؤمنون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «لا يؤمنون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Benefits:
1- Some modern scholars parsed the «الفاء» in His saying, the Exalted, «الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لا يُؤْمِنُونَ» as connecting the apodosis, justifying that by saying: the relative noun contains the meaning of condition.
We do not reject that, but we prefer calling it the redundant الفاء, as the scholars of grammar called it. They defined it as «the الفاء that enters upon the khabar of the mubtadaʾ when it contains the meaning of condition», and they exemplified it by their saying «الذي يأتي فله درهم (whoever comes shall have a dirham)». It is redundant only because the khabar has no need of a connector linking it to the mubtadaʾ; so reflect..

safi-cedvel:122-122.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة): for the interrogative. (الواو): resumptive «[Note: The parsers have generally taken the (الواو) as a conjunction, conjoining the clause after it to an omitted resumptive clause before it which the context requires.]». (من): relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (كان): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogating verb (nāsikh) — its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he" (هو), and it is the referring pronoun. (ميتا): khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative (manṣūb). (الفاء): conjunction. (أحيينا): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn … (ونا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent), and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الواو): conjunction. (جعلنا): like أحيينا. (اللام): a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object. (نورا): first mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (يمشي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, its fāʿil a latent pronoun, implied as "he" (هو), referring to من. (به): like له, attached to the verb يمشي. (في الناس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of يمشي. (الكاف): a preposition of likening. (من): relative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من. (مثل): mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (في الظلمات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar. (ليس): an incomplete past verb — an abrogating verb — its noun a latent pronoun, implied as "he" (هو), referring to من. (الباء): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (خارج): genitive in form, accusative in position, khabar of ليس. (من): a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to خارج. (الكاف): like the first «[Note: Or a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, i.e. the disbelievers' deeds were made fair-seeming to them with a making-fair like that making-fair.]». (ذلك): demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "a making-fair like that making-fair for the believers" … and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address. (زين): past verb, passive. (للكافرين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (زين). (ما): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) «[Note: Or it is a maṣdar particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil.]». (كانوا): an incomplete past verb — an abrogating verb — and the wāw is the noun of كان. (يعملون): imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «من كان ميتا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كان ميتا....» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «أحييناه» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «جعلنا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يمشي ...» is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of نورا).
The clause «مثله في الظلمات» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second relative (من).
The clause «ليس بخارج....» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the relative (من) «[Note: Or an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).]».
The clause «زيّن....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كانوا....» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يعملون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of كان.

* Morphology:
(ميتا): a noun for one who has lost life; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn … and it may be a derived adjective.

* Rhetoric:
1- Representational simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): in the noble verse, where the one whom Allah guided after misguidance and granted success to the certainty by which he distinguishes between the one in the right and the one in falsehood, the guided and the astray, is likened to one who was dead, then He gave him life and made for him a light by which he walks among people, seeking help by it, and so distinguishes some of them from others.
And the one who remained in misguidance is likened to one stumbling about in darknesses, who cannot get free of them nor escape.

* Benefits:
1- «أَوَمَنْ»: this word is composed of three of the parts of speech: the hamza of interrogation, the wāw of conjunction, and the relative noun. It is one of the forms of eloquence and the creative expressions in the Noble Qur'an — and how many they are! Is it not the inimitable and creative speech of Allah?!
2- The style of representation (tamthīl), with the movement and personification it contains, is one of the characteristics of the Noble Qur'an, which contains artistic depiction in its most creative forms and widest dimensions, because of the strength of effect and ease of expression in it.

safi-cedvel:123-123.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (كذلك): like the previous «1», and what governs it is جعلنا. (جعلنا): like أحيينا «2». (في كل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جعلنا) «[Note: The second object is implied, its implied form being "plotters" (ماكرين), indicated by (ليمكروا); the preposition and its noun may also be in the position of the second object, in which case (مجرميها) is parsed as a badal (substitute) of أكابر, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.]». (قرية): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (أكابر): first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (مجرمي): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, the nūn being dropped for the construct, and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (اللام): the lām of outcome (lām al-ʿāqiba) — or of purpose —. (يمكروا): imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn …. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (في): a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يمكروا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يمكروا) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (جعلنا).
(الواو): resumptive. (ما): negating. (يمكرون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (إلا): particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (بأنفس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يمكرون), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): of the ḥāl. (ما يشعرون): like ما يمكرون.
The clause «جعلنا....» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause زيّن ... in the previous verse.
The clause «يمكروا....» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «ما يمكرون....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ما يشعرون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of يمكرون.

* Benefits:
1- This verse depicts the state of the corrupters in every place and every time. Would that those who spread corruption in the land grasped the import of the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَما يَمْكُرُونَ إِلَّا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ وَما يَشْعُرُونَ». If the covering were removed from people's eyes and insights, the one who commits crimes against people would see that his crime returns upon himself before people. But how can people see? It is not the eyes that are blind, but blind are the hearts that are in the breasts.

safi-cedvel:124-124.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذا): an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis قالوا. (جاءت): past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (آية): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (قالوا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (لن): a particle of negation and of the accusative. (نؤمن): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "we" (نحن). (حتى): a particle of limit and of the genitive. (نؤتى): imperfect verb, passive, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) a latent pronoun, implied as "we" (نحن). (مثل): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (ما): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (أوتي): past verb, passive. (رسل): nāʾib fāʿil, nominative. (الله): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نؤتى) is in the position of the genitive by (حتى), attached to (نؤمن).
(الله): the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (أعلم): khabar (predicate), nominative. (حيث): an adverb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, attached to an omitted verb indicated by the noun أعلم «[Note: According to some, this adverb is a mafʿūl bihi governed by the implied verb, because Allah the Exalted is not more knowing in one place than in another place … Abū Ḥayyān said: the apparent view is to keep (حيث) as a figurative adverb and to make أعلم include the meaning of something that is transitive to the adverb, the implied form being: "Allah is more penetrating in knowledge where He places …", i.e. He is penetrating in knowledge in this place … And al-Safāqusī said: the apparent view is that it remains in its meaning of adverbiality.]». (يجعل): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (رسالة): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (السين): particle of the future. (يصيب): like يجعل, and its fāʿil is (صغار). (الذين): relative, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (أجرموا): like قالوا … (عند): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (يصيب) «[Note: Or attached to صغار since it is a maṣdar; it may also be attached to a naʿt (adjective) of صغار.]». (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو): conjunction. (عذاب): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to صغار, nominative. (شديد): naʿt, nominative. (الباء): a preposition. (ما): a maṣdar particle «[Note: Or a relative noun, or an indefinite qualified noun, the referring pronoun being omitted, i.e. يمكرون به.]». (كانوا): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogating verb (nāsikh) — indeclinable on the ḍamma … and the wāw is the noun of كان. (يمكرون): imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا ...) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (يصيب).
The clause «جاءتهم آية» is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of (إذا) to it.
The clause «قالوا....» has no grammatical position: apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لن نؤمن ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «نؤتى ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «أوتي» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «الله أعلم....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يجعل ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «سيصيب ... صغار» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أجرموا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «كانوا يمكرون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «يمكرون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of كانوا.

* Morphology:
(صغار): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb صغر يصغر, of the class فرح; its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ. There are other maṣdars: صغر with kasra on the ṣād and fatḥa on the ghayn, صغر with ḍamma then sukūn, and صغر with two fatḥas.

safi-cedvel:81-81.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), its governing word being أخاف. (أخاف ما أشركتم) like أخاف ما تشركون «[Note: In the previous verse (80).]». (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (لا) negative. (تخافون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of anna. (أشركتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil. (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أشركتم). (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective ... and the clause after it is a naʿt (adjective) of it.]». (لم) a particle of negation, jussive and conversion [to the past]. (ينزّل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو). (الباء) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (ينزّل) «[Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic text has به, i.e. (الهاء), not كم.]». (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (ينزّل) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of سلطان — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies.]». (سلطانا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) ...
The interpreted maṣdar (أنكم أشركتم ...) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, its governing word being تخافون.
(الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition. (أيّ) an interrogative noun, indeclinable «[Translator's note: so in the source; أيّ is ordinarily declinable, and it is nominative here.]», in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (الفريقين) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ. (أحقّ) khabar (predicate), nominative. (بالأمن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أحقّ. (إن) a jussive conditional particle. (كنتم) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) ... and (تم) a pronoun, the noun of kāna. (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «أخاف ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا أخاف «[Note: In the previous verse (80).]».
The clause «أشركتم»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا تخافون ...»: in the position of the nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "you" (أنتم), and the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl «[Note: The clause may be conjoined by the wāw to the resumptive clause.]».
The clause «أشركتم (the second)»: in the position of the nominative as the khabar of (أنّ).
The clause «ينزّل ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «أيّ الفريقين أحقّ..»: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: "if you grasp my words, then which of the two parties...".
The clause «كنتم تعلمون»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.. and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, what precedes indicating it, i.e.: "then which of the two parties has more right to security".
The clause «تعلمون»: in the position of the accusative as the khabar of كنتم.

safi-cedvel:82-82.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject) «[Note: Or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "they" (هم), and the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of speech) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "he said" — i.e. Ibrāhīm — or "they said" — i.e. the people of Ibrāhīm — and the omitted clause has no grammatical position, resumptive.]». (آمنوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الواو) conjunction. (لم) a particle of negation, jussive and conversion [to the past]. (يلبسوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (أيمان) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (بظلم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يلبسوا). (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted khabar placed first. (الأمن) a mubtadaʾ placed later, nominative (marfūʿ). (الواو) conjunction. (هم) a pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (مهتدون) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «الذين آمنوا ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا..»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لم يلبسوا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause «[Note: It may be put in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) if (الذين) is taken as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ.]».
The clause «أولئك لهم الأمن»: in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «لهم الأمن»: in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك) «[Note: It may be parsed as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين) if (أولئك) is parsed as a badal (substitute) of the relative.]».
The clause «هم مهتدون»: in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause لهم الأمن «[Note: It may be put in the accusative as a ḥāl, the governing word in it being the meaning of "being established" (al-istiqrār) mentioned earlier.]».

* Benefits:
1- The interrogative أي is used to ask for the identification of a thing, as in "أي رجل جاء" (which man came?) and "أية امرأة جاءت" (which woman came?). It is used in the masculine with the masculine by dropping the tāʾ, and made feminine with the feminine by retaining the tāʾ marbūṭa.
When it contains the meaning of a condition it puts both verbs in the jussive, as in "أيّ رجل يستقم ينجح" (whichever man is upright succeeds).
It may convey the meaning of perfection, and is then called "of perfection" (al-kamāliyya), as in "فلان رجل أي رجل" (so-and-so is a man — what a man!); it is used only in annexation and agrees with what it qualifies in masculine and feminine. It may also be a link (wuṣla) for addressing what has ال. It is parsed according to what it is annexed to. We have alluded to this discussion before, so let it be consulted in its proper places.

safi-cedvel:83-83.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (تي) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn that is overt on the yāʾ, which was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address. (حجّة) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) «[Note: Or a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, following it in the nominative — or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of it.]», and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (آتينا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent), and (ها) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (إبراهيم) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); it is prevented from nunation on account of being a proper name and foreign. (على قوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "a proof against his people" «[Note: The preposition was not attached to a ḥāl of the mentioned (حجّتنا) because between it and the preposition there is a foreign separator, namely the clause آتيناها.]», and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (نرفع) an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "We" (نحن), for majesty. (درجات) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (نرفع). (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (نشاء) like نرفع. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb. (ربّ) the noun of inna, accusative, and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi. (حكيم) the khabar [of inna], nominative. (عليم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «تلك حجّتنا ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آتيناها ...»: in the position of the nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (تلك) «[Note: It may be a ḥāl, the governing word in it being the meaning of pointing; and it is only a khabar if (حجّتنا) is parsed as a badal of the demonstrative.]».
The clause «نرفع ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive «[Note: Or a ḥāl of the fāʿil of آتينا.
(3, 4) In the previous verse (83).]» «[Translator's note: the second line is so in the source; it is the text of footnotes 3 and 4 belonging to the next entry, merged here.]».
The clause «نشاء»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «إنّ ربّك حكيم ...»: has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).

* Rhetoric:
1- The saying of the Exalted «إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ»: in placing "the Lord", annexed to his — upon him be blessing and peace — pronoun, in the place of the nūn of majesty, by way of shift (iltifāt), in the course of describing the state of Ibrāhīm, upon him be peace, there is a manifest showing of extra kindness and care for him ﷺ.

safi-cedvel:84-84.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (وهبنا) like آتينا «3». (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb وهبنا. (إسحاق) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), prevented from nunation on account of being a proper name and foreign. (الواو) conjunction. (يعقوب) conjoined to إسحاق, accusative like it. (كلّا) mafʿūl bihi placed first, accusative. (هدينا) like آتينا «4». (الواو) conjunction. (نوحا) mafʿūl bihi placed first. (هدينا) like آتينا «[Note: In the previous verse (83).]». (من) a preposition. (قبل) a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive, attached to (هدينا). (الواو) conjunction. (من ذريّة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of داود and those conjoined to him, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (داود) conjoined to (نوحا), accusative like it «[Note: Or the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being (هدينا), and the conjoining then becomes the conjoining of clauses.]». (الواو) conjunction in the five places. (سليمان، ... هارون) nouns conjoined to (نوحا), accusative like it — or conjoined to داود. (الواو) parenthetical. (الكاف) a preposition «[Note: Or a noun in the sense of "like" (مثل), in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is its adjective.]». (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "We reward the doers of good with a reward like that", and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address. (نجزي) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "We" (نحن), for majesty. (المحسنين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «وهبنا..»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هدينا ...»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of إسحاق and يعقوب, i.e. "guided", or a ḥāl of the fāʿil of هدينا, i.e. "guiding them both".
The clause «(هدينا) the second»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «نجزي ...»: has no grammatical position, parenthetical.

safi-cedvel:85-87.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction in the four places. (زكريا ... إلياس) nouns conjoined to داود «1», accusative (manṣūb). (كل) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) «2». (من الصالحين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «كلّ من الصالحين»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the preceding nouns «[Note: Or it has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).]».
(86) (الواو) conjunction in the four places. (إسماعيل ... لوطا) nouns conjoined to زكريا — or داود — accusative. (كلّا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, accusative. (فضّلنا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.. and (نا) the fāʿil (agent). (على العالمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فضلنا), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «فضلنا ...»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
(87) (الواو) conjunction. (من آباء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فضّلنا) or to (هدينا), and من is partitive; and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) conjunction. (ذرّياتهم) conjoined to آبائهم and parsed like it, and likewise (إخوانهم). (الواو) conjunction. (اجتبينا) like فضلنا, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) conjunction. (هديناهم) like اجتبيناهم. (إلى صراط) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (هدينا). (مستقيم) a naʿt (adjective) of صراط, genitive like it.
The clause «اجتبيناهم»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause فضّلنا.
The clause «هديناهم ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause اجتبيناهم.

safi-cedvel:152-153.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (لا تقربوا مال): like لا تشركوا ...
شيئا [Note: In the previous ayah (151).]. (اليتيم): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (إلّا): a particle of restriction. (الباء): a preposition. (التي): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive; attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تقربوا) [Note: The relative has taken the place of the qualified noun, i.e.: by the trait which is best.]. (هي): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أحسن): khabar (predicate), nominative. (حتّى): a particle of limit and of the genitive. (يبلغ): an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after حتى; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. the orphan.
