(أشدّ): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يبلغ ...) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (تقربوا).
(الواو): conjunction. (أوفوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn .. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الكيل): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (والميزان): conjoined to الكيل by the wāw, accusative like it. (بالقسط): a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. being equitable [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of the object, i.e.: give full measure, being full, with equity.]. (لا): a negating particle. (نكلّف): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "naḥnu", for majesty. (نفسا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (إلّا): like the previous. (وسع): a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (إذا): an adverb of future time, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to the content of the apodosis because it carries the meaning of condition. (قلتم): a past verb .. and its fāʿil. (الفاء): connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (اعدلوا): like أوفوا. (الواو): circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (لو): a conditional particle that does not put the verb in the jussive. (كان): an incomplete past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. the one spoken about or spoken to. (ذا): khabar of كان, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the alif. (قربى): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif. (الواو): conjunction. (بعهد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the (أوفوا) that follows. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (أوفوا): like the first. (ذلكم وصاكم ... تذكّرون): like its counterpart «1».
The clause «لا تقربوا مال ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (التي). [Translator's note: So in the source; the ṣila of (التي) is the clause «هي أحسن», while «لا تقربوا مال ...» is a prohibition conjoined to the explicative clause of the previous ayah.]
The clause «يبلغ»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the concealed particle-relative (أن).
The clause «أوفوا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the explicative prohibitive clause «2».
The clause «لا نكلّف ...»: has no grammatical position, parenthetical.
The clause «قلتم ...»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «اعدلوا»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition ... and the condition, its protasis and its apodosis have no grammatical position, conjoined to the explicative clause «3».
The clause «كان ذا قربى ...»: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the omitted person spoken to, i.e. you spoke to someone ... and the apodosis of لو is omitted, indicated by the preceding words.
The clause «أوفوا (the second)»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تقربوا مال ...
The clause «ذلكم وصّاكم ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «وصّاكم به»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلكم).
The clause «لعلّكم تذكّرون»: has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تذكّرون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of لعلّ.
(153) (الواو): conjunction. (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator. (ها): a particle of alerting. (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the noun of أنّ. (صراط): khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (مستقيما): an emphasising ḥāl, accusative, from صراطي, and what governs it is the demonstrative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ هذا صراطي) is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being أتلو, i.e.: and I recite to you the straightness of my path [Note: The implied clause may be taken as resumptive, or it is conjoined to the clause أتل earlier in ayah (151); the interpreted maṣdar may also be conjoined to (ما حرّم) in that ayah ... The interpreted maṣdar may also be in the genitive by an omitted lām attached to the verb اتّبعوه, i.e.: follow my path because of its straightness.].
(الفاء): connective for the apodosis of an implied condition [Note: It may be a conjunction linking effect to cause, so that it conjoins a non-declarative (inshāʾ) to a declarative (khabar) clause.]. (اتّبعوا): like أوفوا, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو): conjunction. (لا تتّبعوا السبل): like لا تشركوا ...
شيئا [Note: The previous ayah (151).]. (الفاء): the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya). (تفرّق): an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after the fāʾ; one of the two tāʾs has been dropped from the verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هي". (الباء): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (تفرّق). (عن سبيل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تفرّق), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تفرّق) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding words, i.e.: let there be no following of the paths on your part, so that they would scatter ...
(ذلكم وصّاكم ... تتّقون): like its earlier counterpart [Note: In ayah (151) of this sūra.].
The clause «اتّبعوه ...»: in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if my path has become clear to you, then follow it.
The clause «لا تتّبعوا السبل»: conjoined to the clause اتّبعوه.
The clause «تفرّق بكم ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the concealed particle-relative (أن).
The clause «ذلكم وصّاكم به ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «وصّاكم به»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلكم).
The clause «لعلّكم تتّقون»: has no grammatical position, causal.
The clause «تتّقون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of لعلّ.

* Morphology:
(أشدّه): a noun meaning attainment or maturity. Its pattern is أفعل, of the measure of أسهم, with fatḥa on the hamza and ḍamma on the ʿayn; it is a plural with no singular, or a singular that has come on the structure of the plural.
(الكيل): a non-derived (jāmid) noun for the instrument with which one measures; the origin of الكيل is a maṣdar, then it was applied to the instrument. Its pattern is فعل with fatḥa on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(الميزان): a noun of instrument; its origin is a maṣdar, then it was transferred to a noun of instrument. Its pattern is مفعال with kasra on the mīm, and it has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution: its origin is موزان; the wāw came vowelless after a kasra, so it was changed to yāʾ.
(تذكّرون): with the dhāl light or doubled ... As for the light form, one of the two tāʾs has been dropped; as for the doubled form, the second tāʾ has been changed to dhāl and assimilated into the dhāl that is the fāʾ of the word.

safi-cedvel:125-125.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): resumptive. (من): a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (يرد): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), given a kasra because two quiescent letters met; its fāʿil (agent) is the Name of Majesty (الله), nominative (marfūʿ). (أن): a maṣdar particle governing the accusative. (يهدي): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he" (هو).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يهديه) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
(يشرح): imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (صدر): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (للإسلام): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يشرح). (الواو): conjunction. (من يرد أن يضله ... صدره): like من يرد أن يهديه ... (ضيقا): second mafʿūl bihi of the verb جعل. (حرجا): naʿt (adjective) of (ضيقا) «[Note: Or it is a third object, because (جعل) is one of the abrogating verbs (nawāsikh); since a multiple khabar is valid, multiple objects are valid however many they reach, because they are for one thing, and it is not required that the verb be transitive to two or three.]», accusative. (كأنما): the restraining and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). (يصّعد): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (في السماء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يصعد). (كذلك): its i'rab has already passed «[Note: In verse (122) of this sūra.]». ((يجعل): like the first «[Translator's note: the source has a doubled opening bracket here.]». (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الرجس): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (على): a preposition. (الذين): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive (majrūr), attached to (يجعل) by making it include the meaning of يلقي ("casts") «[Note: It may also be attached to an omitted second object, i.e. "being above" or "settled".]». (لا): negating. (يؤمنون): like يمكرون «[Note: In the previous verse (124).]».
The clause «من يرد الله....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يهديه» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «يشرح» has no grammatical position: apodosis of the condition not joined by the fāʾ.
The clause «من يرد ... (the second)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يرد الله (the repeated one)» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of condition and apodosis together.]».
The clause «يضله» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second particle relative (أن).
The clause «يجعل....» has no grammatical position: apodosis of the condition not joined by the fāʾ.
The clause «يصعد....» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (ضيّقا) or (حرجا) «[Note: It may be resumptive, so it would have no position.]».
The clause «يجعل (the second)» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يؤمنون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (الذين).

* Morphology:
(ضيّقا): a derived adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha), on the pattern فيعل, from ضاق يضيق; the yāʾ of فيعل was assimilated (idghām) into its ʿayn.
(يصّعد): it contains substitution (ibdāl) of the tāʾ into ṣād and its assimilation into the ṣād; its origin is يتصعد.

* Rhetoric:
1- Representational simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «كَأَنَّما يَصَّعَّدُ فِي السَّماءِ», He likened him, to stress the narrowness of his breast, to one who attempts what he is hardly able to do, for climbing up into the sky is proverbial for what lies outside the circle of capability. It contains an indication that faith is as unattainable for him as climbing is.

safi-cedvel:126-127.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (ها): particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذا): demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (صراط): khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (رب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (مستقيما): an emphasising ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), governed by the demonstrative «[Note: The demonstrative has something of the effect of a verb, because it means "I point".]». (قد): particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (فصّلنا): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn … and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent). (الآيات): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (لقوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فصلنا). (يذكّرون): imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «هذا صراط....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «فصّلنا....» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: Or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of الصراط if it is used metaphorically for the Qur'an, the link in the clause being implied.]».
The clause «يذكّرون» is in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.
(اللام): a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a fronted khabar. (دار): a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (السلام): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (عند): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to a ḥāl of دار السلام, what governs it being the meaning of settledness (istiqrār) «[Note: Or attached to السلام because it is a maṣdar.]». (ربّهم): like ربّك. (الواو): of the ḥāl. (هو): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (ولي): khabar, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الباء): a preposition of cause or of accompaniment (mulābasa). (ما): a maṣdar particle «[Note: Or a relative noun in the position of the genitive, the referring pronoun being omitted, i.e. يعملونه. (4, 5) They may be resumptive, so they would have no position.]». (كانوا): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogating verb (nāsikh) — indeclinable on the ḍamma … and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of the nominative as the noun of كان. (يعملون): like يذكرون.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا يعملون) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to ولي.
The clause «لهم دار السلام» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يذكرون «4».
The clause «هو وليهم» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يذكرون «5».
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «يعملون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of كانوا.

* Morphology:
(يذّكرون): it contains substitution (ibdāl) of the tāʾ into dhāl and its assimilation into the dhāl; its origin is يتذكرون.

* Benefits:
1- كَأَنَّما يَصَّعَّدُ فِي السَّماءِ: modern scientists hold that the higher a person rises above the surface of the earth, the lighter the atmospheric pressure becomes, and consequently the proportion of oxygen that living beings need during the process of breathing decreases. As a result, a person feels a tightness in his chest and constriction while breathing in the air, which may lead him to faint and then suffocate.
Some exegetes hold that this agrees with the saying of Allah the Exalted: «كَأَنَّما يَصَّعَّدُ فِي السَّماءِ». And Allah knows best what subtle ideas and fine meanings He has deposited in His words.

safi-cedvel:59-62.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (عنده) like عندي [Note: In verse (53) of this sūra.] [Translator's note: so in the source; «عندي» occurs in verses 50, 57 and 58]; (مفاتح) mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after, nominative; (الغيب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (لا) negating; (يعلم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (الواو) conjunctive; (يعلم) like the first, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (في البر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila of «ما»; (الواو) conjunctive; (البحر) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to البر, genitive like it; (الواو) conjunctive; (ما) negating; (تسقط) like يعلم; (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, relying on the negation; (ورقة) genitive in form, nominative in position, the fāʿil of تسقط; (إلا) like the first; (يعلمها) like the first; (الواو) conjunctive; (لا) redundant, for emphasizing the negation; (حبة) maʿṭūf to ورقة, genitive in form; (في الظلمات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «حبة»; (الأرض) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunctive in both places; (لا) redundant, for emphasizing the negation in both places; (رطب، يابس) two words conjoined to ورقة, genitive in form [Note: This is what al-Jamal's analysis and al-Suyūṭī went with regarding the conjoining ... but it is more evident that (حبّة) and what is conjoined to it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar (predicate) is (في كتاب مبين).]; (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (في كتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «حبة» [and] what is conjoined to it [Note: al-Zamakhsharī made it an emphasis of meaning for the clause يعلمها and a repetition of it, because His saying «ولا حبة ولا ... إلا في كتاب» means "except that He knows it", and He brought the particle of restriction once more because of the length of the speech ... and the second exception is of the type of a badal (substitute) from the first exception, either a substitute of the whole (badal kull) or a substitute of inclusion (badal ishtimāl).]; (مبين) a naʿt of «كتاب», genitive.
The clause «عنده مفاتح ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause الله أعلم [Note: In the previous verse.].
The clause «لا يعلمها إلا هو» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of «مفاتح الغيب» [Note: What governs it is the "being established" (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached ... and it may be resumptive.].
The clause «يعلم ما في البر» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause عنده مفاتح الغيب.
The clause «تسقط....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause عنده مفاتح الغيب.
The clause «يعلمها» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of «ورقة».
(60) (الواو) conjunctive; (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as khabar; (يتوفى) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "huwa"; (بالليل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتوفى); (الواو) conjunctive; (يعلم ما) like the first; (جرحتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil; (بالنهار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جرحتم); (ثم) a conjunction; (يبعثكم) like يتوفاكم; (في) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يبعث); (اللام) the lām of reason (taʿlīl); (يقضى) an imperfect passive verb, accusative by an implied «أن», the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif; (أجل) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (مسمى) a naʿt of «أجل», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the implied ḍamma.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يقضى) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (يتوفاكم ويبعثكم).
(ثم) a conjunction; (إليه) like فيه, attached to an omitted khabar placed first; (مرجع) mubtadaʾ placed after, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ثم) like the first; (ينبئكم) like يتوفاكم; (الباء) a preposition, and (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive [Note: The returning pronoun is omitted ... It may be a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive, attached to (ينبئ).], attached to (ينبئ); (كنتم) an incomplete past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... (تم) a pronoun, the noun of kāna; (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil ...
The clause «هو الذي....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause عنده مفاتح الغيب.
The clause «يتوفاكم» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «يعلم....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila of the relative.
The clause «جرحتم» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يبعثكم....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يتوفاكم.
The clause «يقضى أجل» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «إليه مرجعكم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يبعثكم.
The clause «ينبّئكم....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إليه مرجعكم.
The clause «كنتم....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the nominal or particle relative (ما).
The clause «تعملون»: is in the position of accusative as the khabar of kuntum.
(61) (الواو) conjunctive; (هو القاهر) a mubtadaʾ, nominative, and its khabar; (فوق) an adverb (ẓarf), accusative, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the pronoun in القاهر, i.e. "being exalted above" [Note: Or attached to the active participle القاهر in the sense of "the Dominant over His servants".]; (عباد) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (يرسل) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil a latent pronoun implied as "huwa"; (على) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يرسل); (حفظة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (حتّى) a particle of inception; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis توفّته; (جاء) a past verb; (أحد) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الموت) fāʿil, nominative, with a muḍāf omitted [Translator's note: the source has «يضاف», a misprint for «مضاف»], i.e. "the causes of death"; (توفّت) a past verb ... and (التاء) is for the feminine; indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; (رسل) fāʿil, nominative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (هم) like هو; (لا) negating; (يفرّطون) like تعملون.
The clause «هو القاهر»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هو الذي ...
The clause «يرسل....»: is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the khabar (القاهر [Note: It may be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ implied as "huwa", the nominal clause being a ḥāl of the pronoun latent in (القاهر) ... and it may be resumptive with no grammatical position.]).
The clause «جاء أحدكم الموت»: is in the position of genitive by (إذا) being annexed to it.
The clause «توفّته رسلنا»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «هم لا يفرّطون»: is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of «رسلنا».
The clause «لا يفرّطون»: is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.
(ثمّ) a conjunction; (ردّوا) a past passive verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil; (إلى الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ردّوا); (مولى) a naʿt of the Name of Majesty, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the alif, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الحقّ) a second naʿt, genitive; (ألا) a particle of alerting; (اللام) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a khabar placed first; (الحكم) mubtadaʾ placed after, nominative; (الواو) conjunctive; (هو) like the first; (أسرع) khabar, nominative; (الحاسبين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «ردّوا ... »: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the apodosis clause توفّته.
The clause «له الحكم»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هو أسرع....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.

* Morphology:
(مفاتح): either the plural of مِفتاح with kasra on the mīm, a noun of instrument on the pattern مِفْعال, and it was permissible to pluralize it thus just as مصباح was pluralized as مصابح ... or it is the plural of مَفْتِح — with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the tāʾ — meaning "storehouse" ... or it is the plural of مَفْتَح — with fatḥa on the mīm and the tāʾ — which is the key, the well-known instrument.
al-Wāḥidī allowed مفاتح to be the plural of مَفْتَح with fatḥa on the mīm and tāʾ, as a mīmī maṣdar, i.e. "with Him are the openings of the unseen".
(البرّ): a primitive (jāmid) noun for dry land; its pattern is فَعْل with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(البحر): see verse (50) of Sūrat al-Baqara.
(ورقة): singular of الورق, a primitive noun for what is found on trees or in a book; its pattern is فَعَلة with fatḥa on the fāʾ and ʿayn.
(رطب): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb رطب يرطب, of the pattern-classes نصر and كرم; its pattern is فَعْل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(يابس): an active participle of يبس ييبس, of the pattern-classes فرح and وثق; its pattern is فاعل.
(يتوفّاكم): the alif in it is converted from a yāʾ, because its bare form is وفي يفي; the yāʾ came vowelled and what precedes it has fatḥa, so it was converted to alif; its pattern is يتفعّلكم.
(يقضى): the alif in it is converted from a yāʾ to suit the passive form; the yāʾ came vowelled after a fatḥa so it was converted to alif; its pattern is يُفْعَل with ḍamma on the yāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(مسمّى): a passive participle from the quadriliteral سمّى; its pattern is مُفَعَّل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn.
(حفظة): plural of حافظ, an active participle from the triliteral حفظ, of the pattern فاعل; the pattern of حفظة is فَعَلة with two fatḥas.
(توفّته): in the verb there is a weakening (iʿlāl) by deletion because of the meeting of two quiescent letters: the quiescent alif before the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine was deleted; its pattern is تفعّته.
(أسرع): a derived adjective; its pattern is أفعل, an elative form that does not carry comparison; its verb is سرع يسرع, of the pattern-classes فرح and كرم.
(الحاسبين): plural of الحاسب, an active participle of حسب يحسب, of the pattern-class نصر; its pattern is فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- Explicit realized metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya al-taḥqīqiyya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَعِنْدَهُ مَفاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ», where He borrowed "keys" for knowledge [Translator's note: the source literally says "borrowed knowledge for the keys"], and the contextual indicator (qarīna) is the annexation to «الغيب».
2- Metonymy (al-kināya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَلا حَبَّةٍ فِي ظُلُماتِ الْأَرْضِ», where darkness is a metonymy for the interior [of the earth], because nothing is perceived in it, just as nothing is perceived in darkness.
3- Contrast (al-muqābala): He set in correspondence land and sea, and the moist and the dry..
4- Repetition (al-takrīr): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «إِلَّا يَعْلَمُها» and in His saying «إِلَّا فِي كِتابٍ مُبِينٍ». The benefit of this repetition is refreshing what has become distant: when He conjoined to «ورقة», after the affirmation intended for knowledge had preceded in His saying «إِلَّا يَعْلَمُها», and these conjoined items were included in the affirmation of knowledge — which is the intent — and they grew long and the connection of their end with the earlier affirmation became distant, that was worthy of renewing the bond with the intent; then what befitted the eloquence familiar in the Qur'an was renewal with another expression, so that the listener receives it fresh and new, not wearied by repetition. This secret is only dug out by one who is master of the science of bayān and the subtleties of the learned.
5- Dependent metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tabaʿiyya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ», i.e. He puts you to sleep in it, where "taking [the soul]" (tawaffī) is borrowed from death for sleep, because of what they share of the disappearance of the sensation of the outward senses and of discernment — and, it is said, of the inward ones too.
6- Metrical revelation (al-tanzīl al-manẓūm): in this noble verse; it is what occurs in the Qur'an metrically without the intent of poetry, and that is in His saying «وَيَعْلَمُ ما جَرَحْتُمْ بِالنَّهارِ», which is a hemistich of a verse in the wāfir metre. There is found in the Qur'an what is a complete verse or a hemistich, yet it does not acquire the name of poetry, nor its author the name of poet. Among that is the saying of Allah the Exalted in the ṭawīl metre, which is the hemistich of a verse: «فَمَنْ شاءَ فَلْيُؤْمِنْ وَمَنْ شاءَ فَلْيَكْفُرْ».

* Benefits:
1- The saying of Allah the Exalted: «وَيَعْلَمُ ما جَرَحْتُمْ بِالنَّهارِ» is a metrical hemistich in the wāfir metre.
The like of this occurs spontaneously in the Noble Qur'an, yet it is not poetry, nor is Muḥammad a poet; it is rather by way of coincidence. Poets have exploited such expressions and included them in the odes they composed. The scholars have a view on this, whose gist is that it is permissible on condition that the words of the Qur'an are not debased, and that it is not used in what disparages the Qur'an or degrades it to what the Qur'an is above mentioning and above its level.

safi-cedvel:21-24.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), (أظلم) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), (من) a preposition and (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أظلم), (افترى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he), (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (افترى), (كذبا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), (أو) a conjunction, (كذب) like افترى, (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذّب), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters) and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of إنّ, and it is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), (لا) negating, (يفلح) an imperfect verb, nominative, (الظالمون) fāʿil, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «من أظلم..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «افترى ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «كذّب بآياته» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «إنّه لا يفلح..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive, having the force of a causal clause.
The clause «لا يفلح الظالمون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
(22) (الواو) conjunction, (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to the verb لا يفلح, because it is conjoined to an implied adverb attached to the same verb, i.e.: the wrongdoers will not prosper today, nor on the day We gather them all [Note: The noun may be parsed as a mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember), or "اتقوا" (beware), or "احذروا" (be wary) ...], (نحشر) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن" (We), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, (جميعا) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of the object pronoun in (نحشرهم), (ثم) a conjunction, (نقول) like نحشر, (اللام) a preposition, (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (نقول), (أشركوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, (أين) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar, (شركاء) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, (الذين) a relative noun in the position of the nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of شركاء, (كنتم) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, (تم) a pronoun in the position of the nominative as the noun of كان, (تزعمون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and the two objects of the doubly transitive verb are implied ... i.e. تزعمونهم شركاء (you claimed them to be partners).
The clause «نحشرهم ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «نقول..» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause نحشرهم.
The clause «أشركوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the first relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أين شركاؤكم» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying).
The clause «كنتم تزعمون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «تزعمون» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of كنتم.
(23) (ثمّ) a conjunction, (لم) a particle of negation, jussive and conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning], (تكن) a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), (فتنة) the noun of تكن, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle, (قالوا) like أشركوا, (الواو) the wāw of the oath, (الله) the Name of Majesty, genitive by the wāw, attached to the implied verb أقسم (I swear), (ربّنا) naʿt of the Name of Majesty, genitive, or a badal (substitute) of it ... (ونا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, (ما) negating, (كنّا) like كنتم, (مشركين) khabar of كنا, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن قالوا) is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of تكن.
The clause «لم تكن فتنتهم ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause نقول ...
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «(نقسم) بالله ...» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «ما كنا مشركين» has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath.
(24) (انظر) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you), (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, governed by (كذبوا), which is like أشركوا, (على أنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذبوا), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, (الواو) conjunction - or resumptive -, (ضلّ) like افترى, (عن) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (ضلّ) by making it include the meaning of غاب (was absent), (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil, and the referential pronoun (al-ʿāʾid) is omitted [Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil.], (كانوا) like كنتم, (يفترون) like تزعمون.
The clause «انظر ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كذبوا ...» is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the verb of looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.
The clause «ضلّ ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause كذبوا [Note: It may be resumptive, so that it has no grammatical position.].
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يفترون ...» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of (كانوا).

* Benefits:
1- The excepted with «إلّا» has an ample discussion which the grammarians have treated exhaustively with study and clarification. What concerns us in this verse is only «the emptied exception (al-istithnāʾ al-mufarragh)», in the expression of some of them, or «the parsing of the excepted with إلّا according to the governing words», in the expression of others. Whether this definition or that pleases us, the excepted must meet two conditions in order to be parsed according to the governing words: First, that [the sentence] is emptied of mention of the thing excepted from (al-mustathnā minhu).
Second: that the speech is negative. In this case we may call «إلا» a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), in the expression of the scholars of rhetoric.
1- The grammarians are agreed that «كيف» is a noun used to ask about the state of a thing. It may acquire the meaning of wonder, as in «كَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِاللَّهِ», or the meaning of negation and disapproval, as in:
«كيف افعل هذا (how could I do this?)», or the meaning of rebuke, as in His saying, the Exalted: «وَكَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ وَأَنْتُمْ تُتْلى عَلَيْكُمْ آياتُ اللَّهِ وَفِيكُمْ رَسُولُهُ». «كيف» may contain the meaning of condition, either joined to «ما», as in «كيفما تكن يكن قرينك (however you are, your companion will be)», or not joined to it, as in: «كيف تجلس أجلس (however you sit, I sit)».
Concerning whether it governs or not there are two schools: the school of the Kufans, who put the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) in the jussive by it;
and the school of the Basrans, for whom it is a non-jussive conditional noun, so the two verbs after it are nominative. So choose whichever of them is nearer to what is right, and spare no effort ... !
[Translator's note: The source numbers both benefits "1-".]

safi-cedvel:25-25.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) [Note: It may be a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: بعض منهم من يستمع (some of them are those who listen) ... and in that case the relative noun becomes the khabar.], (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, (يستمع) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he), (إلى) a preposition, (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يستمع), (الواو) conjunction - or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) -, (جعلنا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... (ونا) fāʿil, (على قلوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of أكنّة [Note: If the verb is in the meaning of صيّر (to make into), the preposition and its genitive noun are a second object; and if the verb is in the meaning of ألقى (to cast), the preposition is attached to it.], and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), (أكنّة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle, (يفقهوا) accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يفقهوه) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "out of dislike that they understand it".
(الواو) conjunction, (في آذان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what (على قلوبهم) is attached to, by virtue of the conjunction; and likewise (وقرا) is conjoined to أكنّة [Note: It is permissible to imply an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned, i.e. "and We placed in their ears a heaviness", and the implied clause is conjoined.], (الواو) conjunction, (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle, (يروا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, (كلّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, (آية) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), (لا) negating, (يؤمنوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), like يروا, (الباء) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يؤمنوا), (حتّى) a particle of commencement (ḥarf ibtidāʾ), (إذا) an adverb of the future containing the meaning of condition, in the position of the accusative, attached to (يقول), (جاؤوا) a past verb and its fāʿil, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, (يجادلون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the fāʿil is the wāw, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, (يقول) like يستمع, (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil, (كفروا) like جاؤوا, (إن) a particle of negation, (ها) a particle of calling attention (tanbīh), (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), (أساطير) khabar, nominative, (الأوّلين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «منهم من يستمع ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يستمع....» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «جعلنا....» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause [Note: The clause may be in the accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) implied, i.e. he listens to it while the coverings have been placed on his heart.].
The clause «يفقهوه» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يروا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «لا يؤمنوا بها ...» has no grammatical position, being an apodosis not joined with the الفاء.
The clause «جاؤوك ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يجادلونك....» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of جاؤوك.
The clause «يقول الذين ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إن هذا إلا أساطير» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying).

* Morphology:
(أكنّة), plural of كنان, like أعنة and عنان; a primitive (jāmid) noun from the verb كن, of the class of ردّ. The pattern of كنان is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ, and the pattern of أكنّة is أفعلة; the ʿayn and the lām came from one letter.
(وقرا), an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb وقر يوقر, of the class of فرح and the class of وعد ...
And وقر الله الأذن (Allah made the ear heavy) ... so the verb is used intransitively and transitively. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(أساطير), plural of أسطورة, with ḍamma on the hamza, and إسطارة, with kasra on the hamza; and it is said that أساطير is the plural of أسطار, which is the plural of سطر with fatḥa on the ṭāʾ. أسطورة is a noun meaning a false tale; its pattern is أفعولة with ḍamma on the hamza, and the pattern of أساطير is أفاعيل.
(الأوّلين), plural of الأول, a noun indicating order in number; it alone comes in this form, while what follows it is on the pattern of فاعل, such as الثاني and الثالث ...

* Rhetoric:
1- Kināya (metonymy): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَجَعَلْنا عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَنْ يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِي آذانِهِمْ وَقْراً».
The speech, according to more than one [scholar], is a representation (tamthīl), a kināya for the completeness of their ignorance of the affairs of the Prophet ﷺ, the excessive aversion of their hearts from understanding the Noble Qur'an, and the deafness of their hearing. They also permitted that there be an explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya), an implicit metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya), or mushākala (verbal correspondence).

safi-cedvel:128-128.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (يوم): an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being يقول ("He will say"). (يحشر): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو), i.e. Allah. (جميعا): ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of the accusative pronoun in (يحشرهم). (يا): vocative particle. (معشر): the one addressed (munādā), in construct, accusative. (الجن): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (قد): particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (استكثرتم): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn … (وتم) a pronoun, fāʿil. (من الإنس): a preposition and its genitive noun, with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "of misleading mankind", attached to (استكثرتم). (الواو): conjunction. (قال): past verb. (أولياء): fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (من الإنس): like the first, attached to a ḥāl of أولياء. (رب): the one addressed, in construct, with the vocative particle omitted, accusative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (استمتع): like the first. (بعض): fāʿil, nominative, and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi. (ببعض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (استمتع). (الواو): conjunction. (بلغنا): like استكثرتم. (أجل): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi. (الذي): relative, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (أجلنا). (أجّلت): like استكثرتم. (اللام): a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أجلت) «[Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl of the object pronoun in (أجّلت), i.e. "You appointed it, made subservient to us".]». (قال): like the first, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو), i.e. Allah. (النار): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (مثوى): khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (كم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (خالدين): ḥāl, accusative, of the genitive pronoun in مثواكم «[Note: This is if مثوى is a mīm-maṣdar, i.e. "the Fire is the place of your abiding" … what governs it may be an implied verb, with مثوى being a noun of place.]». (في): a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to خالدين. (إلا): particle of exception. (ما): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil), i.e. "except a time that Allah wills", excepted from the everlasting perpetual time «[Note: (ما) may be taken in the sense of (من), i.e. "except whomever Allah wills not to abide forever".]». (إن): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh). (ربّ): noun of إن, accusative, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (حكيم): khabar of إن, nominative. (عليم): second khabar, nominative.
The clause «يحشرهم....» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The vocative clause and its answer are in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of the implied verb of saying يقول.
The clause «قد استكثرتم....» has no grammatical position: answer to the vocative.
The clause «قال أولياؤهم» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the implied resumptive clause.
The vocative clause «ربنا» is in the position of the accusative as the second object of speech.
The clause «استمتع بعضنا....» has no grammatical position: answer to the vocative.
The clause «بلغنا.» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause استمتع بعضنا.
The clause «أجّلت لنا» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «قال....» has no grammatical position: explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «النار مثواكم» is in the position of the accusative as the third object of speech.
The clause «شاء الله» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «إن ربك حكيم....» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya) — or merely resumptive —.

* Morphology:
(معشر): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) meaning a group; its pattern is مفعل, with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn … and its plural is معاشر.

* Rhetoric:
1- The startling exception: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «خالِدِينَ فِيها إِلَّا ما شاءَ اللَّهُ». al-Zamakhsharī mentioned in his book al-Kashshāf: "except what Allah wills" means except the times in which they are moved from the torment of the Fire to the torment of the bitter cold (al-zamharīr); for it is related that they enter a valley in which there is such bitter cold that it separates some of their limbs from others, so they howl at one another and ask to be returned to Hell. Or it may be like the saying of the wronged avenger who has got hold of the one who wronged him and keeps gnashing his teeth at him, when he is asked to loosen his grip on his throat: "May Allah destroy me if I loosen it for you — except if I will"; and it is known that he wills nothing but to take revenge on him with the utmost harshness and severity he is capable of. So his saying "except if I will" is among the severest of threats, together with mockery of the one threatened, since it comes out in the form of an exception that holds out hope.

safi-cedvel:154-154.t:
* I'rab:
(ثمّ): a particle brought for resumption [Note: In the scholars' explanations of the conjunction with (ثمّ) there are many views. Some said it is for ordering the reports, because the giving to Moses was before the revelation of the Qur'an ... Some made it conjoin what follows it to أتل, the implied form being: come, I will recite what He has forbidden, then I will recite what We gave ... It was also said that it is conjoined to وصّاكم به, on the assumption that the injunction is ancient, handed down by every nation on the tongue of its prophet ... etc. But resumption with (ثمّ) is not impossible, and evidence for this exists in the Noble Qur'an, as in the words of the Exalted: «أولم يروا كيف يبدأ الخلق ثمّ يعيده» (al-ʿAnkabūt - 19).]. (آتينا): a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). (موسى): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa. (الكتاب): a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (تماما): mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative [Note: Or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), either from الكتاب, i.e. complete, or from the fāʿil pronoun, i.e. completing.
It may also be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar because it is its kind, i.e.: We gave it to him with a giving of completeness, not deficiency; or because it is the noun of the maṣdar, on the assumption of: We gave it to him, i.e. We completed it fully.]. (على): a preposition. (الذي): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive; attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تماما). (أحسن): a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (الواو): conjunction. (تفصيلا): conjoined to (تماما), accusative. (لكلّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تفصيلا). (شيء): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. (الواو): conjunction in both places. (هدى، رحمة): two nouns conjoined to (تماما), accusative like it, the sign of the accusative on the first being an implied fatḥa. (لعلّ): a particle resembling the verb, for hope — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of لعلّ. (بلقاء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤمنون). (ربّ): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يؤمنون): an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «آتينا ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أحسن ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «لعلّهم ... يؤمنون»: has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يؤمنون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ.

* Morphology:
(تماما): a non-regular (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb تمّ يتمّ, of the bāb ḍaraba; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ, and it may come with kasra and ḍamma on it. There are other maṣdars of the verb: (تمّا) with fatḥa, kasra and ḍamma on the tāʾ, and (تمامة) with fatḥa and kasra on the tāʾ.
(تفصيلا): a regular maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb فصّل; its pattern is تفعيل.
(لقاء): a non-regular maṣdar of the verb لقي يلقى, of the bāb fariḥa; its pattern is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ. There are other maṣdars of this verb: لقاءة with kasra and fatḥa on the lām; لقاية with kasra on the lām; لقيان with ḍamma and kasra on the lām; لقيانة with kasra on the lām; لقيّ with ḍamma and kasra on the lām and a doubled yāʾ, with kasra on the qāf in both; لقية with fatḥa and ḍamma on the lām; and لقى with ḍamma on the lām.
لقاء is also a non-regular maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb لاقى; as for the regular maṣdar, it is ملاقاة.
In the maṣdar there is substitution of the yāʾ by hamza because it came final after a vowelless alif; its origin is لقاي. (See ayah 130 of this sūra.)

* Benefits:
1- There is disagreement about the conjunction with «ثم»; of it we mention the view of al-Zamakhsharī, for it is the most sound. He says: If you ask: to what are His words "ثم آتينا موسى الكتاب" conjoined? I say: «to وصاكم به». If you ask: how is it valid to conjoin it to it with «ثم», when the giving was a long time before the directing? I say: this injunction is ancient; every nation has continued to be enjoined with it on the tongue of their prophet, in old times and new.

safi-cedvel:155-157.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (ها): a particle of alerting. (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (كتاب): khabar (predicate), nominative. (أنزلنا): a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (مبارك): a naʿt (adjective) of كتاب [Note: It may be a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هذا).], nominative. (الفاء): connective for an implied apodosis [Note: Or a conjunction linking effect to cause.]. (اتبعوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو): conjunction. (اتقوا): like اتبعوا. (لعلكم): its i'rab has passed [Note: In the previous ayah (154).]. (ترحمون): a passive imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «هذا كتاب ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أنزلناه ...»: in the position of nominative as a naʿt of كتاب [Note: It may be a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هذا).].
The clause «اتّبعوه»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if you want to benefit from the Book and seek blessing through it, then follow it.
The clause «اتقوا»: conjoined to the clause اتبعوا.
The clause «لعلكم ترحمون»: has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «ترحمون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of لعل.
(156) (أن): a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative. (تقولوا): an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is an attached pronoun, the ṣila of the relative, in the position of nominative as fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تقولوا) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), on the omission of a muḍāf; what governs it is an implied verb indicated by the verb أنزلنا in the previous ayah, i.e.:
We sent it down for fear of your saying [Note: It may be the mafʿūl bihi of the verb (اتقوا) earlier in the previous ayah; in that case the clause لعلكم ترحمون is parenthetical, functioning as a statement of cause.].
(إنّما): the restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). (أنزل): a passive past verb. (الكتاب): nāʾib fāʿil, nominative. (على طائفتين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ since it is a dual. (من قبلنا): a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition is attached to (أنزل) [Note: Or attached to a naʿt of طائفتين.]. (الواو): conjunction. (إن): lightened from the heavy form, and its noun is an omitted pronoun, its implied form being (إننا). (كنا): an incomplete past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (نا) is a pronoun, the noun of كان, in the position of nominative. (عن دراسة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to غافلين, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (اللام): the distinguishing lām that differentiates the lightened إن from the negating one. (غافلين): khabar of كان, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «أنزلناه ... أن تقولوا»: has no grammatical position, a resumption confirming the content of what preceded.
The clause «تقولوا»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «أنزل الكتاب»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إن كنّا ... لغافلين»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause that is the object of the saying.
The clause «كنّا ... لغافلين»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the lightened إن.
(157) (أو): a conjunction. (تقولوا): an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to the first and parsed like it. (لو): a conditional particle that does not put the verb in the jussive. (أن): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator — and (نا) is a pronoun, the noun of أن, in the position of accusative. (أنزل ... الكتاب): like the first. (على): a preposition, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (أنزل). (اللام): occurring in the apodosis of لو. (كنا أهدى): like كنا غافلين, and the sign of the accusative in أهدى is an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif. (من): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (أهدى).
The interpreted maṣdar (أنا أنزل ...) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being ثبت ... i.e.: if the sending down of the Book upon us had been established, we would have been better guided than they ...
(الفاء): causal [Note: Or connective for the apodosis of an implied condition.]. (قد): a particle of realisation. (جاء): a past verb, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بينة): fāʿil, nominative. (من ربّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاء) [Note: Or attached to an omitted naʿt of بينة.], and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction in both places. (هدى، رحمة): two nouns conjoined to بينة, nominative, the sign of the nominative of the first being an implied ḍamma. (الفاء): resumptive. (من أظلم ... بآيات الله): the i'rab of its counterpart has passed [Note: In ayah (144) of this sūra.]. (الواو): conjunction. (صدف): a past verb, and the fāʿil is "huwa". (عن): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (صدف). (السين): a particle of the future. (نجزي): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن", for majesty. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (يصدفون): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (عن آيات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يصدفون), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الباء): for the genitive. (ما): maṣdar-forming. (كانوا): incomplete, and its noun. (يصدفون): like the first.
The clause «تقولوا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that is the ṣila of the particle-relative.
The clause «(ثبت) ... the implied»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «أنزل علينا ...»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of أن.
The clause «كنا أهدى»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «قد جاءكم بينة»: has no grammatical position, giving the cause of something omitted, i.e.: do not make excuses, for there has come to you [Note: Or it is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if you are truthful in what you claimed about your being better guided than the two groups, then there has come to you a clear proof.].
The clause «من أظلم ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كذّب بآيات الله»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «صدف عنها»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «سنجزي ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive and causal.
The clause «يصدفون (the first)»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «كانوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «يصدفون (the second)»: in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا يصدفون) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (سنجزي).

* Morphology:
(دراسة): a non-regular (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb درس يدرس, of the bāb naṣara; its pattern is فعالة with kasra on the fāʾ. There is another maṣdar of the verb, درس, its pattern being فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Putting the overt noun in the place of the pronoun: in the words of the Exalted «مِمَّنْ كَذَّبَ بِآياتِ اللَّهِ», where the relative is put in the place of the pronoun (هم) by way of iltifāt (shift of person), to state explicitly that they are characterised by what is within the scope of the ṣila, to indicate the cause of the judgement, and to drop them from the rank of being addressed.

safi-cedvel:88-88.t:
* I'rab:
(ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address. (هدى) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) «[Note: Or a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, and the khabar is the clause يهدي ...]», the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (الله) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (يهدي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied ḍamma; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو), i.e. Allah. (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يهدي). (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (يشاء) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (من عباد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative «[Note: Or of its implied resumptive pronoun, i.e.: "whose guidance He wills, from among His servants ..."]», and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle. (أشركوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لو. (حبط) a past verb. (عن) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (حبط) by its being made to carry the meaning of "was removed" or "was brought down". (ما) a maṣdar particle «[Note: Or a relative noun, the fāʿil of حبط, with the resumptive pronoun omitted, i.e.: "what they used to do (it)".]». (كانوا) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of kāna. (يعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا يعملون) is in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of حبط.
The clause «ذلك هدى الله ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يهدي ...»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of هدى الله, the governing word being the pointing «[Note: Or it is a ḥāl of the Name of Majesty ... or a second khabar of the demonstrative, or the only khabar if (هدى الله) is parsed as a badal of the demonstrative.]».
The clause «يشاء....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «أشركوا....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «حبط ...»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «كانوا....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative.
The clause «يعملون»: in the position of the accusative as the khabar of (كانوا).

safi-cedvel:89-89.t:
* I'rab:
(أولئك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). (آتينا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.... and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent), and (هم) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (الكتاب) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (الواو) conjunction in the two places. (الحكم، النبوة) two nouns conjoined to الكتاب, accusative. (الفاء) conjunction. (إن) a jussive conditional particle. (يكفر) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (الباء) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يكفر). (ها) a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil. (الفاء) linking the apodosis of the condition. (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq). (وكّلنا) like آتينا. (بها) like the first, attached to (وكّلنا). (قوما) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (ليسوا) a defective (nāqiṣ), inflexible (jāmid) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of laysa. (بها) like the first, attached to كافرين. (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (كافرين) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of ليسوا, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «أولئك الذين....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آتيناهم....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يكفر بها هؤلاء»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «قد وكّلنا....»: in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ليسوا بها بكافرين»: in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (قوما).

safi-cedvel:90-90.t:
* I'rab:
(أولئك الذين هدى الله) like أولئك الذين آتينا «[Note: In the previous verse (89).]». (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition. (بهدى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اقتد), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (اقتد) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and (الهاء) the hāʾ of pausing (hāʾ al-sakt), having no position «[Note: Or it is a pronoun in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is the pronoun of the maṣdar, i.e. "follow [them] in the following" ...
Among the readers, some retain it both in pause and in connected recitation, and some retain it only in pause.]»; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت). (قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you" (أنت). (لا) negative. (أسأل) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "I" (أنا), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (على) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (أجرا) — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies. (أجرا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (إن) a negative particle. (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (ذكرى) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (للعالمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of ذكرى «[Note: Or attached to the maṣdar (ذكرى).]», the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «أولئك الذين....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هدى الله»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «اقتده»: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: "if you come to a state like theirs, then follow بهواهم" «[Translator's note: so in the source, evidently a misprint for بهداهم, "their guidance".]».
The clause «قل....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أسألكم....»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «هو ذكرى»: has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(اقتده): it has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the indeclinability [of the imperative]. Its pattern is افتعه.

safi-cedvel:91-91.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (ما) negative. (قدروا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (حق) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being annexed to the maṣdar, accusative. (قدر) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قدروا). (قالوا) like قدروا. (ما) like the first. (أنزل) a past verb. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (على بشر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزل). (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (شيء) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi. (قل) an imperative verb; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت). (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أنزل) like the first, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of الكتاب. (جاء) like أنزل. (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (جاء). (موسى) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (نورا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of the genitive pronoun in (به). (هدى) conjoined to (نورا) by the wāw, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif. (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of هدى. (تجعلون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (قراطيس) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative «[Note: Or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in sheets" (في قراطيس), and so attached to the verb.]». (تبدون) like تجعلون, and (هاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) conjunction. (تخفون) like تجعلون. (كثيرا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (علمتم) a past verb, passive, indeclinable on the sukūn ...
and (تم) a pronoun, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective ... and the clause after it is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of it.]». (لم) a particle of negation, jussive and conversion [to the past]. (تعلموا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as a tawkīd (emphasis) of the agent pronoun in (تعلموا). (الواو) conjunction. (لا) redundant, to emphasize the negation. (آباء) conjoined to the agent pronoun in (تعلموا), nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (قل) like the first. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative «[Note: Or the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being "sent down" (أنزل).]», and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "sent down the Book" (أنزل الكتاب). (ثم) a conjunction. (ذر) like قل, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (في خوض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ذرهم) «[Note: Or attached to (يلعبون), or attached to an omitted ḥāl of the object of ذرهم, i.e.: "leave them trifling in their plunging" ... and in that case the clause يلعبون becomes a ḥāl emphasizing the content of what precedes it.]», and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يلعبون) like تجعلون.
The clause «ما قدروا....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قالوا....»: in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ما أنزل الله....»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «قل....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «من أنزل....»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أنزل الكتاب»: in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «جاء به موسى....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «تجعلونه.....»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in (به), so the governing word is جاء; or a ḥāl of الكتاب, so the governing word is أنزل.
The clause «تبدونها»: in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of قراطيس.
The clause «تخفون....»: in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause تبدونها, and the linking pronoun is omitted, i.e. "you conceal much of them".
The clause «علّمتم....»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) assumed.
The clause «لم تعلموا....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «قل (the second)»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «الله (أنزله)»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «ذرهم»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قل ...
The clause «يلعبون»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the object in (ذرهم).

* Morphology:
(قدره): an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb قدر يقدر, of the bāb نصر and the bāb ضرب. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa on the fāʾ. There is another maṣdar of the verb, namely قدر with two fatḥas.
(خوضهم): an aural maṣdar of the verb خاض يخوض, of the bāb نصر. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:92-92.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (ها) a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (كتاب) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (أنزلنا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent), and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (مبارك) a naʿt (adjective) of كتاب, nominative. (مصدق) another naʿt of كتاب, nominative. (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (بين) an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila. (يدي) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (اللام) the lām of reason (taʿlīl). (تنذر) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت). (أم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (القرى) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تنذر) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (أنزلنا); and this genitive maṣdar is conjoined to an implied maṣdar, i.e. "We sent it down for belief in it, and so that you may warn ..."
(الواو) conjunction. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, conjoined to أمّ, in the position of the accusative. (حول) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to the omitted ṣila of (من). (الواو) conjunction. (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ «[Note: Or in the position of the accusative, conjoined to أم, i.e. "and so that you may warn those who believe ..." — and in that case the second clause يؤمنون is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative.]». (يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (بالآخرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the first (يؤمنون). (يؤمنون) like the first. (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to the second (يؤمنون) «[Note: Mentioning this preposition and its genitive noun is obligatory, because the khabar is of the same wording as the mubtadaʾ.]». (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (على صلاة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يحافظون), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يحافظون) like يؤمنون.
The clause «هذا كتاب....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أنزلناه»: in the position of the nominative as a naʿt of كتاب.
The clause «تنذر....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.
The clause «الذين يؤمنون....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يؤمنون (the first)»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يؤمنون (the second)»: in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين) «[Note: What springs to mind at first glance is that the meaning of this nominal clause is not complete, since the mubtadaʾ and khabar are alike in wording; but the meaning in them differs because of the difference in meaning of the two complements (faḍla).]».
The clause «هم يحافظون»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «يحافظون»: in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Morphology:
(أمّ): a primitive (jāmid) noun meaning the mother or the origin; here it is a name for Makka al-Mukarrama. Its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- He brought the first adjective as a verbal [clause], namely the clause أنزلناه, because the sending down is renewed time after time; and the second adjective came as a noun, and likewise the third, to indicate permanence, continuity and the perpetuity of the blessing.

safi-cedvel:63-65.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "anta"; (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (ينجي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun implied as "huwa"; (من ظلمات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ينجيكم); (البرّ) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (الواو) conjunctive; (البحر) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to البر, genitive; (تدعون) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (تضرّعا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being a kind of it [Note: Or it meets its verb in meaning: تدعون in the sense of تتضرّعون ... It may also be a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial).]; (خفية) maʿṭūf to (تضرّعا) by the wāw, accusative; (اللام) paving the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (أنجى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun implied as "huwa"; (من) a preposition; (ها) a particle of alerting; (ذه) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of genitive, attached to (أنجانا); (اللام) the lām of oath; (نكوننّ) an incomplete imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative ... and the nūn is for emphasis, and its noun is a latent pronoun implied as "naḥnu"; (من الشاكرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of نكوننّ, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قل ... »: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «من ينجيكم؟»: is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «ينجيكم....»: is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «تدعونه»: is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the accusative pronoun in (ينجيكم).
The clause «إن أنجانا....»: has no grammatical position, explicative (tafsīriyya) [Note: Or the maqūl al-qawl of an implied saying that is a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تدعون, i.e. "saying" or "they say: if He saves us".].
The clause «نكوننّ....»: has no grammatical position, the answer of the oath ... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer of the oath.
(64) (قل) like the first; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (ينجيكم) like the first; (من) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ينجيكم); (الواو) conjunctive; (من كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what (منها) is attached to, being conjoined to it; (كرب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (أنتم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, in the position of nominative; (تشركون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قل....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
