The clause «الله ينجيكم»: is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «ينجيكم»: is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «الله».
The clause «أنتم تشركون»: is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «تشركون»: is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم).
(65) (قل) like the first; (هو القادر) a mubtadaʾ and khabar, both nominative; (على) a preposition; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (يبعث) an imperfect verb, accusative, its fāʿil a latent pronoun implied as "huwa".
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يبعث) is in the position of genitive by the preposition, attached to the active participle (القادر).
(على) like the first, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يبعث); (عذابا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من فوق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (عذابا) [Note: It may be attached to the verb (يبعث).], and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أو) a conjunction; (من تحت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what (من فوقكم) is attached to, being conjoined to it; (أرجل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أو) a conjunction; (يلبس) an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (يبعث), and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (شيعا) a ḥāl, accusative, of the accusative pronoun [Note: al-ʿUkbarī said: it may be accusative as a maṣdar not from its verb's root, just as it may be a ḥāl in this sense, i.e. a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl.]; (الواو) conjunctive; (يذيق) like يبعث and conjoined to it; (بعض) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (بأس) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (بعض) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (انظر) an imperative verb, and the verb [Translator's note: so in the source; read "the fāʿil"] is a latent pronoun implied as "anta"; (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, governed by (نصرّف), which is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "naḥnu" (We) for majesty; (الآيات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope (tarajjī), and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of laʿalla; (يفقهون) an imperfect verb like تشركون.
The clause «قل....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هو القادر»: is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «يبعث»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «يلبسكم....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause of the particle relative.
The clause «يذيق....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause of the particle relative.
The clause «انظر....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «نصرّف»: is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the verb of looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.
The clause «لعلّهم يفقهون»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يفقهون»: is in the position of nominative as the khabar of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(تضرّعا): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the five-letter verb تضرّع, on the pattern of its past with ḍamma on the letter before the last; its pattern is تفعُّل.
(خفية): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb خفي يخفى, of the pattern-class فرح; its pattern is فُعْلة with ḍamma on the fāʾ. There are two other maṣdars of the verb: خِفية with kasra on the khāʾ, and خَفاء with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(أنجانا): in it the wāw is converted to alif, because its bare form is نجا ينجو; its origin is أنجونا, and since the wāw came vowelled after a fatḥa it was converted to alif; its pattern is أفعلنا.
(كرب): a heard maṣdar of the verb كرب يكرب, of the pattern-class نصر; its pattern is فَعْل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(شيعا): plural of شيعة. In al-Qāmūs: «شيعة الرجل», with kasra, are his followers and supporters; it applies to the one, the two and the plural, masculine and feminine; its pattern is فِعْلة with kasra on the fāʾ and sukūn on the yāʾ.

safi-cedvel:66-66.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (كذّب) a past verb; (الباء) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كذّب); (قوم) fāʿil (agent), nominative, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (الحقّ) khabar (predicate), nominative; (قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "anta"; (لست) an incomplete past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn ... (التاء) the noun of laysa; (على) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to «وكيل»; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (وكيل) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of laysa.
The clause «كذّب به قومك»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هو الحقّ»: is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) [Note: It may be resumptive with no grammatical position.].
The clause «قل ... »: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لست ... بوكيل»: is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).

safi-cedvel:67-67.t:
* I'rab:
(لكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a khabar (predicate) placed first; (نبأ) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (مستقرّ) mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; (الواو) resumptive; (سوف) a particle of the future; (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
The clause «لكلّ نبأ مستقرّ»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تعلمون»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مستقرّ): a noun of time from the six-letter verb استقرّ; it may be a mīmī maṣdar, and some make it a noun of place; its pattern is مُسْتَفْعَل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:26-26.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction, (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), (ينهون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the retention of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), (عن) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ينهون), and the object of ينهون is omitted, i.e. "they forbid people". (ينأون عنه) like ينهون عنه, (الواو) resumptive, (إن) negating, (يهلكون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya), (ما) negating, (يشعرون) like (ينهون) [Translator's note: the source has "مل", evidently for "مثل" (like).].
The clause «هم ينهون ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «ينهون....» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ هم.
The clause «ينأون....» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause ينهون.
The clause «يهلكون ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ما يشعرون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) [Note: The clause may be conjoined to the clause يهلكون, so that it has no grammatical position ... or it may be made resumptive in the first place.].

* Morphology:
(ينهون), it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is ينهاون: the alif and the wāw came vowelless, so the alif was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; its pattern is يفعون.
(ينأون), it contains iʿlāl that proceeds in the same way as ينهون.

* Rhetoric:
- Jinās (paronomasia): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَهُمْ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ وَيَنْأَوْنَ عَنْهُ». It is the jinās of inflection (jinās al-taṣrīf), which is the difference in form between two words through the replacement of one letter by a letter close to it in point of articulation, whether the replacement is at the beginning, in the middle or at the end.

* Benefits:
1- Before we leave this verse, it is fitting for us to pause at length at His saying ينهون and ينأون: it is incomplete jinās (jinās nāqiṣ), as the scholars of rhetoric say.
The definition of jinās is «the agreement of two words in pronunciation and their difference in meaning»: if their pronunciations differ by one letter, it is called incomplete jinās, as in this verse, and it is among the verbal embellishments in the Qur'an. It seems that this art played a great role in the minds and tastes of men of letters during one of the literary ages, until it ended up as one of the phenomena of artificiality during the ages of stagnation and rigidity. The folk poets took it up from their colleagues, the educated poets, and reckoned that it was one of the glories of literature, that it was an end and not a means, and that it was sought for its own sake; so they took it as the standard for weighing poets against one another. On it is based the art of al-ʿatābā and other arts of folk poetry, and they call it «al-marṣūd». In truth it is a kind of committing oneself to what is not obligatory (iltizām mā lā yalzam) in poetry or in prose. Jinās remains a genuine art as long as it comes spontaneously; but when the writer goes panting after it, it becomes artificiality, affectation and a mark of weakness in the poetry of poets and the prose of prose writers.

safi-cedvel:27-27.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (لو) a non-jussive conditional, (ترى) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you) [Note: (ترى) may be a verb of visual seeing, its object being implied, i.e. "you see their state" ... or it may be a mental verb putting two objects in the accusative, both likewise implied, i.e.: "if you saw them afraid".], (إذ) an adverb used for the future because it is treated as realised, (وقفوا) a passive past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), (على النار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وقفوا) by making it include the meaning of عرضوا (they were presented), (الفاء) conjunction, (قالوا) a past verb and its fāʿil, (يا) a particle of calling attention [Note: Or a vocative particle, and the one addressed is omitted, its implied form being "يا قوم" (O people).], (ليت) a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters), for wishing, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of ليت, (نردّ) a passive imperfect verb, nominative, and the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن" (we), (الواو) the wāw of accompaniment (wāw al-maʿiyya), (لا) negating, (نكذّب) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the wāw of accompaniment, and the fāʿil is "نحن", (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نكذب), (رب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نكذّب) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "would that we had a return, and the absence of belying of the signs of our Lord, and our being among the believers".
[Translator's note: The source has "إنفاء تكذيب", evidently a misprint for "انتفاء تكذيب" (the absence of belying); rendered accordingly.]
(الواو) conjunction, (نكون) a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (نكذّب), and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن", (من المؤمنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of نكون.
The clause «ترى....» has no grammatical position, being resumptive ... and the apodosis of لو is omitted, i.e.: "you would have seen a tremendous thing".
The clause «وقفوا» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا....» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause وقفوا.
The clause «ليتنا نرد» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying) [Note: It may be the response to the vocative, and the vocative clause is the maqūl al-qawl.].
The clause «نرد....» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of ليت.
The clause «لا نكذّب» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «نكون ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause of the particle-relative.

* Rhetoric:
1- Concision by omission (al-ījāz bi-l-ḥadhf): here in the verse it is the omission of the apodosis of «لو», relying on its being evident, and signalling that expression falls short of detailing it. Likewise the object of ترى [is omitted] because what is within the scope of the adverb indicates it, i.e. «if you saw them» when they are made to stand over the Fire so that they behold it, you would see what expression cannot encompass. The past form is to indicate certainty of realisation.

* Benefits:
1- It is conventionally agreed that «إذ» is an adverb of past time, but it may, rarely, be an adverb of the future, as in His saying, the Exalted: فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ إِذِ الْأَغْلالُ فِي أَعْناقِهِمْ.
It is one of the indeclinable adverbs, its indeclinability being on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative. It may come as muḍāf ilayhi, as in His saying, the Exalted: «رَبَّنا لا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنا», and it may occur in the place of the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), as in «وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ كُنْتُمْ قَلِيلًا». It is always annexed to clauses.
The clause after it may be omitted and compensated for by the tanwīn of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), as in His saying, the Exalted: فَلَوْلا إِذا بَلَغَتِ الْحُلْقُومَ وَأَنْتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنْظُرُونَ», i.e. "and you, at the time when the soul reaches the throat, are looking on".

safi-cedvel:28-29.t:
* I'rab:
(بل) for digression (iḍrāb) and commencement, (بدا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (بدا), (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent), (كانوا) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the noun of كان, (يخفون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, (من) a preposition, (قبل) a noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive, attached to (يخفون), (الواو) conjunction, (لو) a non-jussive conditional, (ردّوا) a passive past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لو, (عادوا) like قالوا «1», (اللام) a preposition, (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (عادوا), (نهوا) like ردّوا, (عنه) like the previous «2», attached to (نهوا), (الواو) conjunction, (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters) and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of إنّ, (اللام) it is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), conveying emphasis, (كاذبون) khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
[Translator's note: The footnote markers «1» and «2» have no accompanying footnote text in the source.]
The clause «بدا لهم ما كانوا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كانوا....» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (ما).
The clause «يخفون....» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of كانوا.
The clause «ردّوا....» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause بدا لهم ...
The clause «عادوا» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «نهوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
The clause «إنهم لكاذبون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause عادوا [Note: It may be taken as a resumption, so that it has no grammatical position.].
(29) (الواو) conjunction, (قالوا) like the first [Note: In verse (27) of this sūra.], (إن) a particle of negation, (هي) a detached pronoun [Note: The pronoun refers back to the notion of (الحياة) (life), evident in the context of the two previous verses.] in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), (حياة) khabar, nominative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), (الدنيا) naʿt (adjective) of الحياة, nominative like it, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the alif, (الواو) conjunction, (ما) negating, operating like ليس, (نحن) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as the noun of ما, (الباء) redundant (zāʾida), (مبعوثين) the khabar of ليس, genitive in wording, accusative in position, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause عادوا [Note: Or conjoined to the clause (إنهم لكاذبون).].
[Translator's note: The source has "جمل عادوا", evidently for "جملة عادوا" (the clause عادوا).]
The clause «إن هي إلا حياتنا ...» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying).
The clause «ما نحن بمبعوثين» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause of the maqūl al-qawl.

* Morphology:
(بدا), it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion (qalb); its origin is بدو with fatḥa on the wāw, imperfect يبدو ... the wāw came with a vowel after a fatḥa, so it was converted into an alif.
(يخفون), it contains iʿlāl by making vowelless and iʿlāl by deletion; its origin is يخفيون, with ḍamma on the second yāʾ along with the first ... the ḍamma on the second yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made vowelless - iʿlāl by making vowelless - and the vowel was transferred to the fāʾ ... then the yāʾ was deleted because it met, vowelless, with the vowelless wāw of the plural, and it became (يخفون); its pattern is يفعون, with ḍamma on the yāʾ and the ʿayn. It also involves the deletion of the hamza of the past tense [form أخفى].
(عادوا), it contains iʿlāl by conversion; its origin is عودوا with fatḥa on the wāw; the wāw came with a vowel after a fatḥa, so it was converted into an alif.
(بمبعوثين), plural of مبعوث, passive participle of the triliteral بعث; its pattern is مفعول.

safi-cedvel:129-129.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (الكاف): a preposition of likening «[Note: Or a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar … or in the position of the nominative as khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: الأمر كذلك ("the matter is thus") or مثل ذلك ("like that")….]». (ذلك): demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq governed by the verb that follows it «[Note: Or attached to the omitted khabar of an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. الأمر كذلك.]», and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address. (نولي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "we" (نحن). (بعض): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الظالمين): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ. (بعضا): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative «[Note: Or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "We make some of the wrongdoers allies over others", i.e. We give them power over others.]». (بما كانوا يكسبون): like بما كانوا يعملون «[Note: In verse (127) of this sūra.]» in its individual words and in the interpreted maṣdar.
The clause «نولّي....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the particle or nominal relative (ما).
The clause «يكسبون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

safi-cedvel:130-133.t:
* I'rab:
(يا معشر الجن): its i'rab has already passed «[Note: In verse (128) of this sūra.]». (الواو): conjunction. (الإنس): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الجن, genitive (majrūr) like it. (الهمزة): for the interrogative of rebuke (al-istifhām al-tawbīkhī). (لم): a particle of negation, inversion (qalb) and the jussive. (يأت): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (رسل): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (من): a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of رسل. (يقصون): imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (عليكم): like منكم, attached to (يقصون). (آيات): mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (ينذرون): like يقصّون, and (كم) is the first mafʿūl bihi. (لقاء): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (يوم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi. (ها): particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذا): demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive as ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) or badal (substitute) of يوم. (قالوا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (شهدنا): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn … and (نا) is the fāʿil. (على أنفس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (شهدنا), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): resumptive. (غرّت): past verb … and (التاء) is for the feminine, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الحياة): fāʿil, nominative. (الدنيا): naʿt of الحياة, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (الواو): conjunction. (شهدوا): like قالوا. (على أنفسهم): like على أنفسنا, attached to (شهدوا). (أن): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) — and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of أن. (كانوا): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) verb — an abrogating verb — and its noun. (كافرين): khabar (predicate), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The vocative clause «يا معشر» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يأتكم رسل ...» has no grammatical position: answer to the vocative.
The clause «يقصون....» is in the position of the nominative as a naʿt of رسل «[Note: It may be in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of رسل, since it is qualified.]».
The clause «ينذرونكم ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يقصون «[Note: Or in the position of the accusative, conjoined.]».
The clause «قالوا....» has no grammatical position: explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «شهدنا على أنفسنا» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «غرّتهم الحياة» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «شهدوا....» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause غرتهم الحياة.
The clause «كانوا....» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of أن.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنهم كانوا كافرين) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, namely the bāʾ, attached to (شهدوا).
(131) (ذلك): demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) … and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address. (أن): lightened from the heavy form (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), i.e. أنه. (لم): a particle of negation, the jussive and inversion. (يكن): an incomplete imperfect verb — an abrogating verb — jussive. (ربّ): noun of يكن, nominative, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (مهلك): khabar, accusative. (القرى): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the implied kasra. (بظلم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the pronoun in مهلك, i.e. "clothed with injustice".
The interpreted maṣdar (أنه لم يكن ربك مهلك ...) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted lām, i.e. "because He was not …", and the preposition and its noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك.
(الواو): of the ḥāl. (أهل): mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (غافلون): khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «ذلك أن لم يكن....» has no grammatical position: explanatory resumption.
The clause «لم يكن ربّك مهلك....» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the lightened أن.
The clause «أهلها غافلون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
(132) (الواو): conjunction. (لكلّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar. (درجات): a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (من): a preposition. (ما): a maṣdar particle «[Note: Or a relative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to a naʿt of درجات, the referring pronoun being omitted.]». (عملوا): past verb and its fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما عملوا) is in the position of the genitive by (من), attached to an omitted naʿt of درجات.
(الواو): conjunction. (ما): negating, working like ليس. (رب): noun of ما, nominative, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الباء): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (غافل): genitive in form, accusative in position, khabar of ما. (عن): a preposition. (ما): like the first. (يعملون): imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يعملون) is in the position of the genitive by (عن), attached to غافل.
The clause «لكل درجات....» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause غرتهم الحياة.
The clause «عملوا» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the first particle relative (ما).
The clause «ما ربك بغافل....» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لكل درجات.
The clause «يعملون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second particle relative (ما) «[Note: Or the ṣila of the nominal relative, the referring pronoun being omitted, i.e. يعملونه.]».
(133) (الواو): a conjunction. (رب): mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الغني): naʿt, nominative «[Note: (الغني) may be a first khabar and (ذو الرحمة) a second khabar.]». (ذو): second naʿt, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw. (الرحمة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إن): a jussive conditional particle. (يشأ): imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he" (هو). (يذهب): imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (الواو): conjunction. (يستخلف): like يذهب, conjoined to it, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يستخلف), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (ما): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi «[Note: The use of (ما) here is by way of predominance (taghlīb), or it is borrowed for rational beings in place of (من).]». (يشاء): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أنشأكم) is in the position of the genitive by the kāf, the preposition «[Note: Or it is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar.]», attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "He makes successors after you whatever He wills, a producing like His producing of you from the offspring of another people" … and (أنشأكم) is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو).
(من ذرية): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنشأكم). (قوم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (آخرين): naʿt of قوم, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «ربّك الغني ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لكل درجات.
The clause «إن يشأ يذهبكم» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ربك) «[Note: Or an explanatory resumption, coming as an answer to an implied question …]».
The clause «يذهبكم....» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a jussive condition not joined by the fāʾ.
The clause «يستخلف....» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «يشاء....» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative (ما). «[Translator's note: above, this (ما) was parsed as a relative noun (mawṣūl ismī), not a particle relative; the source has "particle" (الحرفي) here.]»

* Morphology:
(لقاء): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the three-letter verb لقي, and a heard maṣdar of the four-letter verb لاقى; its pattern is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ. It contains substitution (ibdāl) of the final weak letter into a hamza after the quiescent alif; its origin is لقاي.
(مهلك): active participle of the four-letter verb أهلك; its pattern is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the lām.

* Rhetoric:
- Preferring «ما» over «من»: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «ما يَشاءُ», to show the perfection of majesty and to drop them from the rank of rational beings.

safi-cedvel:158-158.t:
* I'rab:
(هل): an interrogative particle with the meaning of negation. (ينظرون): an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (إلا): a particle of restriction. (أن): a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative. (تأتي): an imperfect verb, accusative, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الملائكة): fāʿil, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تأتيهم الملائكة) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, governed by ينظرون, i.e.: they await the coming of the angels.
(أو): a conjunction. (يأتي): like تأتي and conjoined to it. (ربّ): fāʿil, nominative, on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. the command of your Lord and His punishment, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (أو يأتي ... آيات ربك): like the first. (يوم): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (لا ينفع). (يأتي بعض آيات ربك): like the first. (لا): a negating particle. (ينفع): an imperfect verb, nominative. (نفسا): mafʿūl bihi placed first, accusative. (إيمان): fāʿil placed later, nominative, and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (لم): a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive. (تكن): an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي", i.e. the soul. (آمنت): a past verb ... and (التاء) is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is "hiya". (من): a preposition. (قبل): a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of genitive; attached to (آمنت). (أو): a conjunction. (كسبت): like آمنت. (في إيمان): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كسبت), and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (خيرا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (قل): an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "anta". (انتظروا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator — and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إن. (منتظرون): khabar (predicate) of إن, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «ينظرون»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تأتيهم»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يأتي ربك»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تأتيهم.
The clause «يأتي بعض ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يأتي ربك.
The clause «يأتي بعض (the second)»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لا ينفع نفسا ايمانها»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لم تكن آمنت ...»: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in إيمانها [Note: It may be in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (نفسا), despite the separation of the adjective from the qualified noun by the fāʿil, which is not foreign, since the qualified noun and the fāʿil share in being governed ... It may also be resumptive, and so have no grammatical position.].
The clause «آمنت ...»: in the position of accusative as the khabar of تكن.
The clause «كسبت ...»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause آمنت.
The clause «قل ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «انتظروا»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنا منتظرون»: has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(منتظرون): plural of منتظر, which is an active participle of the five-letter verb انتظر; its pattern is مفتعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
- The speech in this noble ayah contains the type known in the science of bayān and rhetoric as laff (folding together).
The underlying form of the speech is: on the day some of the signs of your Lord come, it will not benefit a soul that was not believing before, its believing afterwards, nor a soul that did not earn good in its faith before, the good it earns afterwards; except that He folded the two statements together and made them a single statement, for eloquence, concision and inimitability.

safi-cedvel:159-159.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh). (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the noun of إن. (فرّقوا): a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (دين): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو): conjunction. (كانوا): an incomplete past verb — an abrogator — indeclinable on ḍamma ... and the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of كان. (شيعا): khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative. (لست): an incomplete, frozen (jāmid) past verb ... and the tāʾ is the noun of ليس. (من): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of ليس. (في شيء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar [Note: It may be the khabar itself, and (منهم) is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of شيء — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies.]. (إنما): the restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa), having no governing effect. (أمر): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إلى الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. (ثم): a conjunction. (ينبئ): an imperfect verb, nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (الباء): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun [Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by what follows; the resumptive pronoun is omitted for both, its implied form being يفعلونه ... and the clause after it is a naʿt (adjective) in the position of genitive.], indeclinable, in the position of genitive; attached to (ينبّئهم). (كانوا): like the first. (يفعلون): an imperfect verb, nominative .. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «إن الذين ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «فرقوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «كانوا شيعا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «لست منهم ...»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of إن.
The clause «إنما أمرهم إلى الله»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «ينبّئهم ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «كانوا يفعلون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يفعلون»: in the position of accusative as the khabar of (كانوا).

safi-cedvel:160-160.t:
* I'rab:
(من): a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (جاء): a past verb, indeclinable, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (بالحسنة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جاء) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of جاء, i.e.: he came bearing the good deed.]. (الفاء): connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (اللام): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first. (عشر): mubtadaʾ placed later, nominative [Note: The word (عشر) has come in the masculine, whereas it should have been feminine, because in its tamyīz (specification) its meaning was taken into account, namely الحسنات (good deeds).]. (أمثال): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (من جاء بالسيئة): like its earlier counterpart. (الفاء): connective for the apodosis. (لا): negating. (يجزى): a passive imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring to (من). (إلا): a particle of restriction. (مثل): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. he will be recompensed the like of its recompense, and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): resumptive. (هم): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (لا): negating. (يظلمون): a passive imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «من جاء ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «جاء بالحسنة»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «1».
The clause «له عشر أمثالها»: in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «من جاء (the second)»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «جاء بالسيئة»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «2».
The clause «لا يجزى ...»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو" ... and the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ [Note: The imperfect verb has come in the apodosis nominative and joined with the fāʾ, so the clause, in the view of the majority, is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو".].
The clause «هم لا يظلمون»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا يظلمون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Morphology:
(يجزى): it has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution on account of the passive; its origin is يجزي — with yāʾ at its end — the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa, so it was changed to alif.

* Benefits:
1- The masculine and feminine of numbers:
The rule: from three to ten the number differs from the counted noun, so it is feminine with the masculine and masculine with the feminine. «عشر» has come in this ayah contrary to the rule, being made masculine with the masculine:
«عَشْرُ أَمْثالِها». The explanation of this is that the annexation has an effect on that, and the implied form here is «عشر حسنات» (ten good deeds), and الحسنة is feminine; or that the masculine word is in reality feminine, for the "like" is the good deed; or that something is joined to the word that conveys the meaning of femininity, as in the words of ʿUmar ibn Abī Rabīʿa:
فكان مجنيّ دون من كنت أتقي ... ثلاث شخوص كاعبان ومعصر
(So my shield against the one I feared was three figures: two full-breasted maidens and one just come of age.)
For الشخوص (figures), even though the word is masculine, is an allusion to three women. We have no need to review the whole topic of numbers.

safi-cedvel:161-161.t:
* I'rab:
(قل): an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (النون) is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إن. (هدى): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, and (النون) is for protection, and (الياء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (ربّ): fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (إلى صراط): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (هداني) [Note: The verb (هدى) is transitive to the second object through the preposition إلى: «وهداه إلى صراط مستقيم» (al-Naḥl «121»), or directly: «اهدنا الصراط المستقيم» (al-Fātiḥa).]. (مستقيم): a naʿt (adjective) of صراط, genitive. (دينا): mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being عرّفني (He made known to me) [Note: It may be a badal (substitute) for the position of صراط, because it is the second object of the verb هدى.]. (قيما): a naʿt of (دينا), accusative. (ملّة): a badal of (دينا), accusative. (إبراهيم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa. (حنيفا): a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, from إبراهيم [Note: It is valid as a ḥāl of إبراهيم because the muḍāf is a part of the muḍāf ilayhi.]. (الواو): conjunction. (ما): a negating particle. (كان): an incomplete past verb — an abrogator — and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (من المشركين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of كان, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قل ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إنني هداني ...»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «هداني ربّي»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of إن.
The clause «ما كان من المشركين»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the wording of the ḥāl (حنيفا) [Note: It may be cut off as a resumption, and so have no grammatical position.].

* Morphology:
(قيما): a derived adjective; its pattern is فعل with kasra on the fāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn, lightened from the doubled form (قيّم), with fatḥa on the qāf and kasra on the doubled yāʾ. In the word قيّم there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution: its origin is قيوم — with sukūn on the yāʾ and a vowel on the wāw; the wāw and the yāʾ came together, the first being the yāʾ, vowelless, so the wāw was changed to yāʾ and the two yāʾs were assimilated together; then the word was lightened to قيم, with kasra on the fāʾ and fatḥa on the yāʾ.

safi-cedvel:93-93.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أظلم) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (من) a preposition. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أظلم). (افترى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو). (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (افترى). (كذبا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its synonym.]». (أو) a conjunction. (قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (أوحي) a past verb, passive. (إلى) a preposition and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) «[Note: It is possible — in the view of al-ʿUkbarī — that the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun referring back to the revealing understood from the context; the preposition is then attached to the verb.]». (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (لم) a particle of negation, jussive and conversion [to the past]. (يوح) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), passive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter. (إليه) like إليّ, attached to (يوح). (شيء) nāʾib fāʿil, nominative. (الواو) conjunction. (من) like the first, and conjoined to it, in the position of the genitive. (قال) like the first. (السين) a particle of the future. (أنزل) an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "I" (أنا). (مثل) mafʿūl bihi, accusative «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, because it is its adjective, i.e. "I will send down a sending down like Allah's sending down", and in that case (ما) is a maṣdar particle.]». (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, and the clause after it is a naʿt (adjective) of it ... or it is a maṣdar particle.]». (أنزل) like قال. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الواو) conjunction — or resumptive. (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle. (ترى) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت), and the object is omitted, its implied form being "the unbelievers" or "the wrongdoers". (إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, attached to (ترى). (الظالمون) mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw. (في غمرات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. (الموت) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الواو) circumstantial. (الملائكة) mubtadaʾ, nominative. (باسطو) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw, and the nūn was dropped for the annexation. (أيدي) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (أخرجوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (اليوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تجزون) «[Note: It may be attached to (أخرجوا), in which case one must pause on اليوم.]». (تجزون) an imperfect verb, nominative.... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil. (عذاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الهون) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الباء) a preposition of cause (sababiyya). (ما) like the first «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, and the clause after it is a naʿt of it, or it is a maṣdar particle.]», attached to (تجزون). (كنتم) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.... and (تم) a pronoun, the noun of kāna. (تقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative.... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (على الله) like the first, attached to (تقولون) by its being made to carry the meaning of "you lie" (تكذبون). (غير) mafʿūl bihi «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its adjective, i.e. "a saying other than the truth".]», accusative. (الحق) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو) conjunction. (كنتم.... تستكبرون) like كنتم.... تقولون, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (تستكبرون) by its being made to carry the meaning of "you keep away" (تبتعدون).
The clause «من أظلم....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «افترى....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «قال....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila of the relative.
The clause «أوحي إلي....»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «لم يوح ... شيء»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
The clause «قال (the second)»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (من).
The clause «سأنزل....»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أنزل الله»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «لو ترى....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause — or resumptive — and the apodosis (jawāb) of (لو) is omitted, its implied form being "you would have seen a tremendous thing".
The clause «الظالمون في غمرات»: in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «الملائكة باسطو»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «أخرجوا....»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl of an implied verb of saying, i.e. "they say: bring out", and the clause of saying is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in (باسطو).
The clause «تجزون....»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «كنتم تقولون....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «تقولون....»: in the position of the accusative as the khabar of كنتم.
The clause «كنتم (the second)»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause....
or resumptive.
The clause «تستكبرون»: in the position of the accusative as the khabar of the second كنتم.

* Morphology:
(يوح): it has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the jussive. Its pattern is يفع, with ḍamma on the yāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(غمرات): plural of غمرة, the noun from غمر يغمر, of the bāb نصر, in the sense of "went to the extreme" and "covered"; it is hardship (al-shidda). Its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn. It has another plural, غمار with kasra on the ghayn, and غمر with ḍamma on the ghayn and fatḥa on the mīm.
(الهون): an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb هان يهون, of the bāb نصر. Its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn. There is another maṣdar of the verb, namely هوان with fatḥa on the hāʾ, and it has a mīmī maṣdar, مهانة.

* Rhetoric:
1- The explicit representative metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya al-tamthīliyya): in the saying of the Exalted «فِي غَمَراتِ الْمَوْتِ», for the original sense of الغمرة is the water that overwhelms, and it was borrowed for overpowering hardship.

safi-cedvel:94-94.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq). (جئتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn ... and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent), and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida), being the lengthening (ishbāʿ) of the vowel of the mīm, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (فرادى) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), of the agent pronoun. (الكاف) a preposition, and (ما) a maṣdar particle. (خلقنا) a past verb and its fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (أوّل) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلقنا) «[Note: (أوّل) is not parsed as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), so that "the first creation" not be assumed, and because that would call for a second creation, whereas there is no second creation, but only a re-creation (Ḥāshiyat al-Jamal ʿalā al-Jalālayn).]». (مرة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما خلقناكم) is in the position of the genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted second ḥāl of the fāʿil of جئتمونا «[Note: Or to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "a coming like your coming at the time We created you" ... or "being alone, with an aloneness like your state the first time".]».
(الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (تركتم) like جئتم. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (خولنا) like خلقنا, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (وراء) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (تركتم). (ظهور) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negative. (نرى) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "We" (نحن), for majesty. (مع) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (نرى), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (شفعاء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi. (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of شفعاء. (زعمتم) like جئتم. (أن) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of anna. (في) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to شركاء, with the omission of two muḍāfs, i.e. "in the right of your worship". (شركاء) the khabar (predicate), nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنهم فيكم شركاء) stands in place of the two objects of زعمتم.
(اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (قد) a particle of realization. (تقطع) a past verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هو), referring back to the bond understood from the context of the speech in His saying (أنهم فيكم شركاء). (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (تقطع) «[Note: Or it is a naʿt of the omitted fāʿil of تقطع, i.e. "the bond between you has been cut" ... It is also possible that (بينكم) is itself the fāʿil, in the sense of "the bond", and the word was made indeclinable on the fatḥa by analogy with the most frequent states of the adverb, and because it is annexed here to an indeclinable word, [being] in the position of the nominative (see al-Shudhūr by Ibn Hishām, p. 94).]», and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (ضل) a past verb. (عنكم) like فيكم, attached to (ضلّ) by its being made to carry the meaning of "vanished" (زال). (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil. (كنتم) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator — indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (تم) a pronoun, the noun of kāna. (تزعمون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and the wāw is the fāʿil ... and the two objects of the verb are omitted, His saying (أنهم فيكم شركاء) indicating them, i.e.: "you claimed them to be partners".
The clause «جئتمونا....»: has no grammatical position, the answer to an implied oath.
The clause «خلقناكم....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «تركتم....»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) assumed «[Note: Or resumptive, having no grammatical position.]».
The clause «خولناكم»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «ما نرى....»: in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause تركتم «[Note: Or it has no grammatical position, being conjoined to a resumption.]».
The clause «زعمتم....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «تقطع....»: has no grammatical position, the answer to an implied oath.
The clause «ضلّ....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تقطع.
The clause «كنتم تزعمون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «تزعمون»: in the position of the accusative as the khabar of كنتم.

* Morphology:
(فرادى): a plural or a collective noun (ism jamʿ). Those who said it is a plural differed about its singular: it is فرد, or فريد, or فردان. The pattern of فرادى is فعالى with ḍamma on the fāʾ, of the measure of سكارى; therefore they preferred that its singular be فردان, like سكران. In any case it is a derived adjective.

safi-cedvel:95-95.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh). (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb). (فالق) the khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (الحب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (النوى) conjoined to الحب by the wāw, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (يخرج) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو). (الحي) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (من الميت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يخرج). (الواو) conjunction. (مخرج) the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "he" (هو), nominative. (الميت) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (من الحي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مخرج. (ذلكم) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.... and (اللام) for distance, and (كم) for address. (الله) the Name of Majesty, khabar, nominative. (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition «[Note: Or it is a conjunction linking the effect to the cause, and the clause after it is conjoined to the resumptive clause before it.]». (أنّى) an interrogative noun in the sense of "how" (كيف), in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), its governing word being (تؤفكون), an imperfect verb, passive, nominative ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «إن الله فالق....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يخرج الحي....»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) «[Note: It may be a second khabar, so that the conjoining of (مخرج) to the verb is valid under one of the explanations.]».
The clause «ذلكم الله»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أنى تؤفكون»: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: "if the demonstration of Allah's power has become clear to you, then how are you deluded and turned away from faith?"

* Morphology:
(فالق): an active participle from فلق يفلق, of the bāb ضرب. Its pattern is فاعل.
(الحب): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) whose unit is حبّة; its plural is حبوب with ḍamma on the ḥāʾ ...
and حبان likewise. The pattern of الحب is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(النوى): plural of نواة, a primitive (jāmid) noun for the stone of the date and the like. The alif in it is changed from a yāʾ: its original form is النوي with a yāʾ at its end; it came vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was changed to alif. Its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.

* Rhetoric:
The art of departing from the expected: in the saying of the Exalted «يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَمُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتِ مِنَ الْحَيِّ». The right view — and Allah knows best — is to say: the original [expectation] was to bring the form of the active participle, in keeping with its counterparts in the verse; but He turned away from that to the imperfect in this description alone, intending the picturing of the bringing forth of the living from the dead and making it present in the mind of the hearer, and that is achieved only by the imperfect, not by the active participle or the past; as in the saying of the Exalted «أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً فَتُصْبِحُ الْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً», where He turned away from the past that would match أنزل.

safi-cedvel:134-134.t:
* I'rab:
(إن): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh). (ما): relative noun, in the position of the accusative as the noun of إن, the referring pronoun being omitted. (توعدون): imperfect verb, passive, nominative (marfūʿ) … and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (اللام): the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis. (آت): khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the deleted yāʾ. (الواو): conjunction. (ما): negating, working like ليس. (أنتم): a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as the noun of ما. (الباء): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (معجزين): genitive in form, accusative in position, khabar of ما, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «إن ما توعدون لآت» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «توعدون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «ما أنتم بمعجزين» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(آت): active participle of the three-letter verb أتى; its pattern is فاع, because it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the yāʾ was deleted on account of the tanwīn.
(بمعجزين): plural of معجز, active participle of the four-letter verb أعجز; its pattern is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Benefits:
1- These successive emphasisers have a single aim, but one that is mighty with Allah: they emphasise the occurrence of the Day of Resurrection, and that the raising of people after their death and their standing for the reckoning does not incapacitate Allah, when they will be recompensed with good for good and with evil for evil; and that is not difficult for Allah.
So look at the emphasising «إنّ», then this emphasising lām which إن shifted from the beginning of the mubtadaʾ (subject) to the beginning of the khabar, then the manner of negation by «ما», followed by the bāʾ, which is a redundant preposition — its redundancy being in the domain of i'rab, not in the domain of its emphasising and establishing the intended meaning.
2- Tanwīn (nunation) is a quiescent nūn that attaches to the end of a noun in pronunciation and is omitted in writing. Its well-known kinds are four:
a- Tanwīn al-tamkīn (of full declinability): that which attaches to declinable nouns to indicate their firm establishment in nounhood.
b- Tanwīn al-tankīr (of indefiniteness): that which attaches to some indeclinable nouns, as in مررت بسيبويه لا مثيل له ("I passed by a Sībawayh without equal").
c- Tanwīn al-muqābala (of correspondence): it attaches to the sound feminine plural, and corresponds to the nūn in the sound masculine plural.
d- Tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ (of compensation): it may be compensation for a word, for a clause, or for a letter.
The compensation for a clause is that which attaches to the word «إن» «[Translator's note: the source has «إن»; the standard example of tanwīn compensating for a clause is إذ, as in يومئذ.]». There are other, less well-known kinds of tanwīn which we will mention in other places that call for detail, if Allah wills.

safi-cedvel:135-135.t:
* I'rab:
(قل): imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you" (أنت). (يا): vocative particle. (قوم): the one addressed (munādā), in construct, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ that is deleted for lightness, and the deleted (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (اعملوا): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (على مكانة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اعملوا), with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "the firming of your position" or "the strengthening of your position", and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) — and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of إن. (عامل): khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (الفاء): causal. (سوف): particle of the future. (تعلمون): imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (من): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) «[Note: (من) may be an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar is the clause (تكون له عاقبة الدار), i.e.: "you will know which of us will have …"; and the nominal clause من تكون.... stands either in place of the two objects of تعلمون, if it is a verb of the heart, or in place of the single object, if it is in the sense of recognising.]». (تكون): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb — an abrogating verb — nominative. (اللام): a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive (majrūr), attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (عاقبة): noun of تكون, nominative. (الدار): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إنّه): like إنّي «[Note: The hāʾ is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn).]». (لا): negating. (يفلح): imperfect verb, nominative. (الظالمون): fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw. «[Translator's note: the source repeats "the sign of the nominative" (وعلامة الرفع) twice here.]»
The clause «قل....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The vocative clause «يا قوم....» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اعملوا....» has no grammatical position: answer to the vocative.
The clause «إني عامل....» has no grammatical position: explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «سوف تعلمون» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تكون له عاقبة....» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «إنه لا يفلح....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يفلح الظالمون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of إن.

* Morphology:
(مكانة): feminine of مكان, a noun of place from the verb كان, so the mīm on this view is augmentative; its pattern is مفعل, with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn, because the ʿayn of the verb in the imperfect has ḍamma … It is also said that the mīm in مكانة is a root letter, from the verb مكن, so it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) meaning "being established", and its pattern is فعالة.

safi-cedvel:68-68.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إذا) an adverb (ẓarf) of future time carrying the meaning of condition, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis أعرض; (رأيت) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. (التاء) the fāʿil (agent); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يخوضون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (في آيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يخوضون), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (أعرض) an imperative verb, indeclinable, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "anta"; (عن) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أعرض); (حتّى) a particle of limit and genitive; (يخوضوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after ḥattā, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (في حديث) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يخوضوا); (غير) a naʿt (adjective) of «حديث», genitive like it, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخوضوا) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (أعرض).
(الواو) conjunctive; (ان) a jussive conditional particle; (ما) redundant (zāʾida), with no effect; (ينسينّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and the nūn is for emphasis, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the second object is omitted, its implied form being "what you were commanded" ...; (الشيطان) fāʿil, nominative; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تقعد) an imperfect verb, jussive, and the fāʿil is "anta"; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تقعد); (الذكرى) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the alif; (مع) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (تقعد); (القوم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الظالمين) a naʿt of «القوم», genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «رأيت....»: is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يخوضون..»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «أعرض عنهم»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يخوضوا....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «ينسينّك الشيطان»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive [clause] made up of the condition إذا, its protasis and its apodosis.
The clause «لا تقعد....»: is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition (إن), joined to the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(الذكرى): a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the five-letter verb تذكّر, meaning "remembering"; its pattern is فِعْلى with kasra on the fāʾ, and there is no maṣdar on this pattern except ذكرى.

* Rhetoric:
1- Metaphor (al-istiʿāra): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «الَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِي آياتِنا»; the original meaning of "khawḍ" is wading through water; it was borrowed for engaging in discussion of matters.
2- Placing the overt noun in the place of the pronoun: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ», i.e. "with them"; the overt noun was put in the place of the pronoun to denounce them for being, by that plunging, wrongdoers who put denial and mockery in the place of belief and reverence, firmly rooted in that.

* Benefits:
1- The use of conditional particles has occasions that differ according to the subject of the condition, and there is nothing in the speech of the Arabs that distinguishes, in the use of conditional particles, according to the situations as the Noble Qur'an distinguishes. In this verse it used «إذا» in a situation not in doubt, namely their plunging into the signs of Allah, glorified is He. And in the second condition, which is Satan's causing the Messenger ﷺ to forget, it used the conditional particle «إن», because the subject of the condition is a doubtful matter that may happen and may not happen. So glory be to the One whose speech this is; and this is the inimitability (iʿjāz) of His noble Book.

safi-cedvel:69-69.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (ما) negating; (على) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (يتقون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and its object is omitted, implied as "Allah"; (من حساب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «شيء» — a naʿt (adjective) placed before the noun it qualifies —, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (شيء) a noun, genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; (الواو) conjunctive; (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk) with no effect; (ذكرى) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "they remind them a reminding" [Note: Or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ implied as "huwa", i.e. the prohibition against sitting with them.... or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "upon them is a reminder".. It may also be conjoined to the position of (شيء).]; (لعلّهم يتّقون) like لعلّهم يفقهون [Note: In verse (65) of this sūra.], and the object of يتّقون is omitted, its implied form being "plunging into the signs" ...
The nominal clause «ما على الذين ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause of the previous verse.
The clause «يتّقون....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause « (يذكرونهم) ذكرى»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ما على الذين....
The clause «لعلّهم يتّقون»: has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يتّقون (the second)»: is in the position of nominative as the khabar of laʿalla.

safi-cedvel:70-70.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ذر) an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "anta"; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (اتّخذوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (دين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لعبا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: Some permitted (لعبا) to be a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), by making the verb اتّخذوا include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "acquired", transitive to one object, i.e. "they acquired it for the sake of play".]; (الواو) conjunctive; (لهوا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (لعبا), accusative; (الواو) conjunctive; (غرّت) a past verb, indeclinable ... and the tāʾ is for the feminine, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الحياة) fāʿil, nominative; (الدنيا) a naʿt (adjective) of «الحياة», nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma. (الواو) conjunctive; (ذكّر) like ذر; (الباء) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ذكّر); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (تبسل) an imperfect verb, accusative, passive; (نفس) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تبسل) is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "for fear that a soul be given up to destruction".
(الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition, with the returning pronoun omitted, i.e. "for what it earned".]; (كسبت) like غرّت, and the fāʿil is "hiya", i.e. the soul.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كسبت) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (تبسل) [Note: Or attached to an omitted naʿt of «نفس».].
(ليس) an incomplete, non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb; (اللام) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of laysa; (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «وليّ» [Note: It may be attached to the omitted khabar of laysa.] — a naʿt placed before the noun it qualifies —; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (وليّ) genitive in form, nominative in position, the noun of laysa placed after; (الواو) conjunctive; (لا) redundant, for emphasizing the negation; (شفيع) maʿṭūf to وليّ, nominative in position, genitive in form; (الواو) conjunctive; (ان) a jussive conditional particle; (تعدل) an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil a latent pronoun implied as "hiya" — the soul —; (كلّ) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, standing in for the maṣdar, being annexed to the maṣdar; (عدل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (لا) negating; (يؤخذ) an imperfect passive verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (منها) like لها, in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil [Note: It is not permissible to make the latent pronoun in (يؤخذ) the nāʾib fāʿil, because it refers to (كلّ عدل), which is a maṣdar, and it is not sound that a maṣdar be "taken", because it is an event and not an entity ... This analysis becomes sound if the verb is made to include the meaning of "accepted", and the preposition then becomes attached to the verb (see Shudhūr al-Dhahab, p. 192).]; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) for address; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك [Note: Or in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, with the khabar being the clause لهم شراب.. or in the position of nominative as a naʿt of the demonstrative, with the khabar being the clause لهم شراب.]; (أبسلوا) a past passive verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; (بما كسبوا) like بما كسبت..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كسبوا) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (أبسلوا), and the bāʾ is for causation, i.e. they were given up to destruction because of their earning.
(لهم) like لها, attached to a khabar placed first; (شراب) mubtadaʾ placed after, nominative; (من حميم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of «شراب»; (الواو) conjunctive; (عذاب) maʿṭūf to شراب, nominative like it; (أليم) a naʿt of «عذاب», nominative; (بما) like the first; (كانوا) an incomplete past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) —, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the noun of kāna; (يكفرون) an imperfect verb, nominative. And the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «ذر الذين ... »: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «اتّخذوا.....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «غرّتهم الحياة....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «ذكّر به....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «تبسل نفس.....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «كسبت....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle or nominal relative (ما).
The clause «ليس لها....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of «نفس» — because it is qualified — or of the pronoun in (كسبت).].
The clause «تعدل ... »: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ليس لها ... [Note: Or its position is accusative, conjoined to the clause ليس لها....].
The clause «لا يؤخذ منها»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a condition, not joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «أولئك الذين....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أبسلوا....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «كسبوا»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second (ما), particle or nominal.
The clause «لهم شراب»: is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك) [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in (أبسلوا). The clause may also be an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), and so have no grammatical position.].
The clause «كانوا....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the third (ما), particle or nominal.
The clause «يكفرون»: is in the position of accusative as the khabar of kānū.

* Morphology:
(حميم): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the intransitive حمّ يحمّ, of the pattern-class فتح, used as a noun meaning extremely hot water; its pattern is فعيل.

safi-cedvel:136-136.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (جعلوا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma … and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (لله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جعلوا) if it is transitive to one object, or attached to a second object if it is transitive to two. (من): a preposition. (ما): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive (majrūr), attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (نصيبا) «[Note: Or attached to the verb جعلوا.]». (ذرأ): past verb, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he" (هو), i.e. Allah. (من الحرث): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ذرأ) «[Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl of the omitted referring pronoun or of (ما).]». (الواو): conjunction. (الأنعام): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الحرث, genitive. (نصيبا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object) governed by جعلوا, accusative (manṣūb). (الفاء): conjunction. (قالوا): like جعلوا. (ها): particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذا): demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (لله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). (بزعم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قالوا) by making it include the meaning of a verb transitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "they acted according to their claim" «[Note: Or "they said that by a claim, not with certainty" … and it may be attached to the settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached.]». (الواو): conjunction. (هذا لشركائنا): like هذا لله, and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء): conjunction. (ما): a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (كان): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogating verb (nāsikh) — in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its noun a latent pronoun, implied as "it" (هو), referring to (ما). (لشركاء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of كان, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء): connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (لا): negating. (يصل): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is "it" (هو), referring to (ما). (إلى الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يصل). (الواو): conjunction. (ما كان لله): like ما كان لشركائهم. (الفاء): connecting the apodosis. (هو): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
