(يصل إلى شركائهم): like يصل إلى الله … and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (ساء): past verb for performative blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm). (ما): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil, the referring pronoun being omitted. (يحكمون): imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil …
The one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e.: "evil is what they judge — this judgement of theirs".
The clause «جعلوا....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ذرأ....» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause جعلوا.
The clause «هذا لله ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «هذا لشركائنا» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause هذا لله.
The clause «ما كان ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause قالوا ...
The clause «كان لشركائهم» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of (ما) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of condition and apodosis together.]».
The clause «لا يصل ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "it" (هو), i.e. فهو لا يصل «[Note: (ما) may be a relative, mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is the clause (لا يصل) … with the fāʾ redundant because ما resembles a condition.]» … and the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined by the fāʾ.
The clause «ما كان ... (the second)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ما كان (the first).
The clause «كان لله» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of (ما) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of condition and apodosis together.]».
The clause «هو يصل» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined by the fāʾ.
The clause «يصل....» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو).
The clause «ساء ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يحكمون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(زعم): maṣdar (verbal noun) of زعم يزعم, of the class نصر; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn. This is the dialect of the Ḥijāz; in the dialect of Banū Asad it has ḍamma on the fāʾ. Some claim that the form with ḍamma is a noun and the form with fatḥa is the maṣdar.

* Benefits:
1- «ما» occurs after نعم, بئس and ساء in three types:
The first: that it stands alone, i.e. not followed by anything.
The second: that it is followed by a single word.
The third: that it is followed by a clause.
The first, as in: أنزلته منزلا نعمّا ("I lodged him in a lodging — how excellent!"). There are two views on it:
1- That it is definite, a relative noun, «fāʿil».
2- An indefinite complete noun (nakira tāmma), the one specified being omitted: «نعم المنزل».
The second, as in: نعمّا هي, and بئسما التزويج بلا مهر ("how bad is marriage without a dower"). There are three views on it:
1- A complete definite noun, fāʿil. 2- A complete indefinite noun. 3- Compounded with the verb before it, in a compounding similar to that of «ذا with حبّ», so it has no position in i'rab and what follows it is the fāʿil.
The third: that followed by a verbal clause, as in «نِعِمَّا يَعِظُكُمْ بِهِ، وبِئْسَمَا اشْتَرَوْا بِهِ أَنْفُسَهُمْ». There are several views on it, the most important being four:
1- That it is an indefinite noun in the position of a tamyīz (specification), accusative.
2- That it is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil.
3- That it is itself the one specified for praise or blame.
4- That it is restraining (kāffa).

safi-cedvel:162-163.t:
* I'rab:
(قل إن): like the first [Note: In the previous ayah (161).]. (صلاة): the noun of إن, accusative, the sign of the accusative being an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو): conjunction in the three places. (نسكي، محياي، مماتي): nouns in annexation, conjoined to صلاتي, accusative like it, and (الياء) in them is muḍāf ilayhi. (لله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of إنّ. (رب): a badal (substitute) of the Name of Majesty, genitive, or a naʿt (adjective) of it. (العالمين): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قل ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إن صلاتي ... لله»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
(163) (لا): of generic negation (nāfiya li-l-jins). (شريك): the noun of لا, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative. (اللام): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to the khabar of لا. (الواو): resumptive. (الباء): a preposition. (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive; attached to (أمرت), and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) is for address. (أمرت): a passive past verb ... and (التاء) is a pronoun, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (الواو): conjunction. (أنا): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أول): khabar, nominative. (المسلمين): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «لا شريك له»: in the position of accusative as an emphasising ḥāl (circumstantial), emphasising the meaning of His words رب العالمين [Note: Or resumptive, and so has no grammatical position.].
The clause «أمرت»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أنا أول المسلمين»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أمرت.

* Morphology:
(محياي): a mīmī maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral verb حيي; its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the ʿayn because it is weak, of the adjacent doubly-weak type (lafīf maqrūn). It has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution: the yāʾ — the lām of the word — was changed to alif because it was voweled and the letter before it had fatḥa. It may indicate a noun of place or time.
(مماتي): a mīmī maṣdar of the triliteral verb مات; its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the ʿayn because it is hollow (ajwaf). It has iʿlāl by substitution: its origin is مموت; the vowel of the wāw was transferred to the mīm — iʿlāl by making vowelless — and when the letter before the wāw, which was originally voweled, became voweled, it was changed to alif.

* Benefits:
1- From this ayah
al-Shāfiʿī drew, from the Messenger ﷺ, the opening supplication of the prayer (duʿāʾ al-istiftāḥ), whose content is: «وجهت وجهي للذي فطر السماوات الأرض حنيفا وما أنا من المشركين إن صلاتي ونسكي ومحياي ومماتي لله رب العالمين لا شريك له وبذلك أمرت وأنا أول المسلمين» (I have turned my face to the One who created the heavens and the earth, inclining to truth, and I am not of the polytheists. My prayer, my rites, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds; He has no partner; with that I have been commanded, and I am the first of the Muslims).
(لا) of generic negation is the one that indicates the meaning of negating all individuals of the genus, as in: لا رجل في الدّار (there is no man in the house); the meaning is that there is not any of the men in it. It governs as إنّ does, putting the mubtadaʾ in the accusative and the khabar in the nominative, as in: لا أحد أغير من الله (no one is more jealous than Allah). Its noun and its khabar must both be indefinite. If its noun is single (mufrad), it is made indeclinable on fatḥa, as in: لا كسول ممدوح (no lazy person is praised). If it is in annexation (muḍāf) or resembles one in annexation, it is declinable and accusative, as in: لا رجل سوء عندنا (no evil man is with us); لا قبيحا خلقه حاضر (no one of ugly character is present).

safi-cedvel:164-164.t:
* I'rab:
(قل): an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta". (الهمزة): for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī). (غير): mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first [Note: Or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (ربّا) — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies — if (ربّا) is parsed as mafʿūl bihi.]. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. (أبغي): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". (ربّا): tamyīz (specification), accusative [Note: Or a ḥāl, accusative, interpreted as a derived word, i.e. worshipped.]. (الواو): circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (هو): a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (ربّ): khabar (predicate), nominative. (كل): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (شيء): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو): resumptive [Note: Or a conjunction.]. (لا): a negating particle. (تكسب): an imperfect verb, nominative. (كل): fāʿil, nominative. (نفس): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إلا): a particle of restriction. (على): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl of the omitted object, i.e.: no soul earns a sin except as being returned upon it with harm and punishment [Translator's note: the source reads بالمضمرة, apparently a misprint for بالمضرّة (harm).] ... or as being written against it. (الواو): conjunction. (لا تزر وازرة): like لا تكسب كل نفس. (وزر): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (أخرى): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being an implied kasra on the alif; it is on the omission of a qualified noun, i.e. the burden of another soul. (ثم): a conjunction. (إلى رب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar placed first, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (مرجع): mubtadaʾ placed later, nominative, and (كم) is like the previous. (الفاء): conjunction. (ينبّئ): like تكسب, and the fāʿil is "huwa", and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الباء): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive; attached to (ينبّئكم). (كنتم): an incomplete past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh) ... and (تم) is the noun of كان. (في): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (تختلفون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative .. and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «قل ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أبغي ...»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «هو رب ...»: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «لا تكسب كل ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: Or in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause that is the object of the saying, if the clause is from the speech of the Messenger, upon him be peace.].
The clause «لا تزر وازرة ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تكسب.
The clause «إلى ربكم مرجعكم»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تزر.
The clause «ينبّئكم»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إلى ربكم مرجعكم.
The clause «كنتم ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «تختلفون»: in the position of accusative as the khabar of كنتم.

* Morphology:
(وازرة): feminine of وازر, an active participle of the triliteral وزر; its pattern is فاعلة.

safi-cedvel:165-165.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (هو): like the previous [Note: In the previous ayah (164).]. (الذي): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). (جعل): a past verb, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (خلائف): a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الأرض): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. (الواو): conjunction. (رفع): like جعل. (بعض): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (فوق): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (رفع). (بعض): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (درجات): a badal (substitute) of the adverb فوق, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra [Note: It may be a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. possessing degrees ... or it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl ... or it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar because it coincides with it in meaning, for الدرجة means الرفعة — with fatḥa on the rāʾ — i.e. He raised some of you by raisings, i.e. degrees ... See further explanations at ayah (253) of Sūrat al-Baqara, the beginning of the third juzʾ ... and see likewise ayah (83) of this sūra.]. (اللام): for causation. (يبلو): an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after the lām, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "huwa", i.e. Allah.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يبلوكم) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (رفع).
(في): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive; attached to (يبلوكم), and the resumptive pronoun is omitted. (آتى): a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "huwa", i.e. Allah. (إن): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh). (رب): the noun of إن, accusative, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (سريع): khabar of إن, nominative. (العقاب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو): conjunction. (إن): like the first, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إن. (اللام): the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), conveying emphasis. (غفور): khabar of إن, nominative. (رحيم): a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «هو الذي ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «جعلكم ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «رفع ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يبلوكم»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the concealed particle-relative (أن).
The clause «آتاكم»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «إن ربك سريع»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إنه لغفور ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إن ربك سريع.

* Morphology:
(خلائف): plural of خليفة. In al-Miṣbāḥ: الخليفة is originally خليف without hāʾ, because it has the meaning of the agent; the hāʾ entered it for intensiveness, as in علامة and نسّابة. It is an attribute of a man specifically, and one says خليفة آخر with the masculine, while some say خليفة أخرى. It is pluralised, with regard to its origin, as خلفاء, and with regard to its wording, as خلائف.

* Rhetoric:
1- Kināya (metonymy): in the words of the Exalted «وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَكُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجاتٍ», for excellence and wealth.

safi-cedvel:96-99.t:
* I'rab:
(فالق) the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "he" (هو). (الإصباح) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (الواو) conjunction. (جعل) a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو). (الليل) first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (سكنا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative «[Note: Or it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) if (جعل) is made to carry the meaning of "created" (خلق).]». (الواو) conjunction in the two places. (الشمس، القمر) two nouns conjoined to الليل, accusative like it, and (حسبانا) conjoined to (سكنا), accusative «[Note: (حسبانا) may be the second mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being جعل, with الشمس and what is conjoined to it as the first mafʿūl bihi; the conjoining then becomes the conjoining of clauses.]». (ذلك) like ذلكم «[Note: In the previous verse (95).]». (تقدير) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك, nominative (marfūʿ). (العزيز) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (العليم) a badal (substitute) of العزيز, genitive like it.
The clause «(هو) فالق الإصباح»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «جعل الليل سكنا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «ذلك تقدير ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive «[Note: Or parenthetical, because it has intervened between two clauses conjoined to each other, namely the clause (هو) فالق ... and the clause هو الذي ...]».
(97) (الواو) conjunction. (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as khabar. (جعل) like the first. (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi «[Note: And attached to (جعل) if it is made to carry the meaning of "created".]». (النجوم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (اللام) of reason (taʿlīl). (تهتدوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الباء) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position [of the genitive], attached to (تهتدوا). (في ظلمات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تهتدوا, i.e.: "travelling" or "being in the darknesses of the land". (البر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو) conjunction. (البحر) conjoined to البر, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تهتدوا) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (جعل) «[Note: The lām here is of reason, and the (اللام) in (لكم) is of granting possession — possession of benefit; for this reason it is permissible to attach both of them to the same verb ... Some make the second a badal of the first, a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl).]».
(قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq). (فصّلنا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (نا) a pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil. (الآيات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فصلنا). (يعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «هو الذي ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (هو) فالق ...
The clause «جعل ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «تهتدوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «قد فصلنا ...»: has no grammatical position, parenthetical — or resumptive.
The clause «يعلمون»: in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.
(98) (الواو) conjunction. (هو الذي أنشأ) like هو الذي جعل, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (من نفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb أنشأ. (واحدة) a naʿt of نفس, genitive. (الفاء) conjunction. (مستقر) mubtadaʾ, nominative; its khabar is omitted and placed before it, i.e. "for you there is a dwelling place". (الواو) conjunction. (مستودع) conjoined to مستقر, nominative. (قد فصّلنا ... يفقهون) like its counterpart قد فصّلنا ... يعلمون.
The clause «هو الذي....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هو الذي جعل ...
The clause «أنشأكم»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «(لكم) مستقر»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause, and the resumptive pronoun is omitted, its implied form being "by His permission" or "His will".
The clause «فصّلنا لكم»: has no grammatical position, parenthetical or resumptive.
The clause «يفقهون»: in the position of the genitive as a naʿt of قوم.
(99) (الواو) conjunction. (هو الذي أنزل) like هو الذي جعل. (من السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزل), i.e. "from the clouds". (ماء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الفاء) conjunction. (أخرجنا) like فصّلنا. (به) like بها, attached to (أخرجنا), and the bāʾ is causal (sababiyya). (نبات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (كلّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الفاء) conjunction. (أخرجنا) like فصّلنا. (منه) like بها, attached to (أخرجنا). (خضرا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; it is an adjective that has taken the place of the noun it qualifies. (نخرج) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "We" (نحن), for majesty. (منه) like بها, attached to (نخرج). (حبّا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (متراكبا) a naʿt of (حبّا), accusative. (الواو) conjunction. (من النخل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar placed first. (من طلع) a preposition and its genitive noun, a badal of the first, and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (قنوان) a mubtadaʾ placed later, nominative. (دانية) a naʿt of قنوان, nominative. (الواو) conjunction. (جنّات) conjoined to نبات, accusative like it, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (من أعناب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of جنات. (الواو) conjunction in the two places. (الزيتون، الرمان) two nouns conjoined by the two conjunctions to نبات, accusative like it. (مشتبها) a ḥāl of الزيتون and الرمان, i.e. their leaves. (الواو) conjunction. (غير) conjoined to (مشتبها), accusative. (متشابه) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (انظروا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (إلى ثمر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (انظروا), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إذا) an adverb of the future, stripped of the conditional sense, in the position of the accusative, attached to (انظروا). (أثمر) a past verb, and the fāʿil is "it" (هو), i.e. the fruit. (الواو) conjunction. (ينع) conjoined to ثمر, genitive, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (إن) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh). (في) a preposition. (ذلكم) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted khabar placed first; and (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address, and (الميم) a particle for the masculine plural. (اللام) the lām of the beginning (lām al-ibtidāʾ), conveying emphasis. (آيات) the noun of inna placed later, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of آيات. (يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «هو الذي أنزل ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هو الذي جعل ...
The clause «أنزل....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «أخرجنا به»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أخرجنا منه»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «نخرج منه»: in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of (خضرا) «[Note: Or it has no grammatical position, resumptive.]».
The clause «من النخل ... قنوان»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause, and the resumptive pronoun is omitted, its implied form being "by Our will" or "by His will".
The clause «انظروا....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أثمر»: in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «إنّ في ذلكم لآيات»: has no grammatical position, giving the reason — an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يؤمنون»: in the position of the genitive as a naʿt of قوم.

* Morphology:
(الإصباح): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb أصبح. Its pattern is إفعال.
(سكنا): a noun for that in which one finds repose, such as wealth or a child.. It may also be an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb سكن, of the bāb نصر.
(حسبانا): an aural maṣdar of the verb حسب يحسب, of the bāb نصر, in the sense of الحساب (reckoning), with kasra on the ḥāʾ. There is another maṣdar of the verb, namely حسبان with kasra on the ḥāʾ.
In al-Miṣbāḥ: حسبت المال حسبا, of the bāb قتل: I counted it in number; and for the maṣdar there are also حسبة with kasra and حسبانا with ḍamma ...
(تقدير): a regular maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb قدّر. Its pattern is تفعيل.
(النجوم): plural of النجم; it is a primitive (jāmid) noun, from whose wording comes the verb نجم ينجم, of the bāb نصر, in the sense of "appeared" and "rose".
(مستودع): a noun of place from the six-letter verb استودع, so it is on the pattern of the passive participle ... It may also be a mīmī maṣdar in the sense of الاستيداع (depositing) ... Its pattern is مستفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(خضرا): a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) from the verb خضر يخضر, of the bāb فرح. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then kasra ... The word may be used as a noun in the sense of crops or green herbage.
(متراكبا): an active participle from the five-letter تراكب. Its pattern is متفاعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(النخل): a collective generic noun (ism jins jamʿī), treated as masculine and feminine: (نخل منقعر), (نخل خاوية); its unit is نخلة.
(طلعها): a noun for something that comes out of the palm tree as if it were two sandals pressed together, with the yield between them arranged in layers; or what first appears of its fruit when it emerges.
(قنوان): plural of قنو, whose pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn; it is a primitive noun, and in the palm it is like the bunch (ʿunqūd) in grapes. It is pluralized as أقناء and قنيان with ḍamma and kasra on the qāf, and قنوان with ḍamma and kasra on the qāf.
(دانية): feminine of دان, an active participle from دنا يدنو. Its pattern is فاعلة.
(الزيتون): a collective generic noun for the well-known fruit or the well-known tree; its unit is زيتونة; فعلون.
(الرمان): a collective generic noun for the well-known fruit; its unit is رمانة. Its pattern is فعال, with ḍamma on the fāʾ and shadda on the ʿayn.
(مشتبها): an active participle from the five-letter اشتبه. Its pattern is مفتعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(متشابه): an active participle from the five-letter تشابه. Its pattern is متفاعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(ينعه): an aural maṣdar of the verb ينع يينع, of the bāb ضرب and the bāb فرح. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn. In the lexicon: ينع يينع, of the bāb ضرب and the bāb فتح.

* Rhetoric:
1- It is pleasing here to point to the arts of eloquence found in this verse, in which the Noble Qur'an has run a wide course that the faculties of the eloquent can scarcely reach, and which the language of the ḍād falls short of achieving except in the speech of Allah, which has rendered every challenger incapable and challenged every prose writer and poet. In this verse we find the art of "congruence" (al-mushākala) and the art of "the representative metaphor" (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya) in His saying «فالق الإصباح»: He brought the active participle in congruence with the saying of the Exalted: فالق الحب والنوى.
He used "the splitting of the dawn", likening it to the splitting of the grain or the date-stone by way of representative metaphor: He likened the cleaving of the pillar of daybreak and the bursting forth of the dawn to the splitting of the morning. 2- The likening of the night to repose (sakan): in likening the night to repose there is an inimitability in which the incapacity of man is embodied.
3- Metaphor (istiʿāra): in the saying of the Exalted «لِتَهْتَدُوا بِها فِي ظُلُماتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ», i.e. the confusing roads, which He expressed as darknesses by way of metaphor.
4- Allusion (taʿrīḍ) to those who do not reflect on the signs of Allah and take no lesson from His creatures: since He restricted knowledge of the detailed signs and understanding of them to a people, He intimated that a people other than them have neither knowledge nor understanding; and Allah grants success.
1- Shift (iltifāt): in the saying of the Exalted «فَأَخْرَجْنا بِهِ نَباتَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ», where He shifted to the first person to show the perfection of care for the matter for whose sake the water was sent down. Some mentioned a special subtle point for this shift other than what has been mentioned, namely that when He, Glorified is He, mentioned in what preceded that which alerts you that He is the Creator, that called for turning to Him so that He is addressed; and the choice of the pronoun of majesty rather than the pronoun of the speaker alone is to show perfection of care, i.e. "so We, by Our majesty, brought forth by that water, despite its being one, the growth of every thing".

safi-cedvel:137-137.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (كذلك): its i'rab has already passed «[Note: In verse (129) of this sūra.]». (زين): past verb. (لكثير): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (زيّن). (من المشركين): a preposition and its genitive noun, a naʿt (adjective) of كثير. (قتل): a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), governed by زين. (أولاد): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (هم): a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (شركاء): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) like the first «[Note: In this verse there is a second, sound and mass-transmitted (mutawātir) reading, the reading of Ibn ʿĀmir, with (زيّن) made passive, (قتل) nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), (أولاد) accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar قتل, and (شركائهم) as muḍāf ilayhi, by annexation of the maṣdar to its agent, with a separation between the muḍāf and the muḍāf ilayhi — something the grammarians refuse; but this reading is more deserving than the verses of salvation (آي النجاة) «[Translator's note: "آي النجاة" is probably a misprint for "آراء النحاة" — "the opinions of the grammarians".]».]». (اللام): of purpose (taʿlīl). (يردّوا): imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يردوا) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (زين).
(الواو): conjunction. (ليلبسوا): like ليردوا in its individual words and its interpreted maṣdar, and attached to what the first is attached to. (على): a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يلبسوا). (دين): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (لو): a non-jussive conditional particle. (شاء): past verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (ما): particle of negation. (فعلوا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma … and the wāw is the fāʿil and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (فذرهم وما يفترون): its i'rab has already passed «[Note: In verse (112) of this sūra.]», in its words and clauses.
The clause «زين.... شركاؤهم» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يردوهم» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «يلبسوا» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «لو شاء الله» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «ما فعلوه» has no grammatical position: apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.

* Benefits:
In this verse there are many readings, on which a great disagreement arose among the leading authorities of grammar and i'rab, in which a group of the great verifiers took part, among them al-Zamakhsharī and Abū Ḥayyān, al-Fārisī, Ibn Jinnī and Abū ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAlāʾ. The battle turned on separating the muḍāf from the muḍāf ilayhi, since some grammarians regard the two as a single unit that cannot be split into parts. But we find that in what al-Mutanabbī said in praise of Abū l-Qāsim Ṭāhir ibn al-Ḥusayn:
حملت إليه من لساني حديقة ... سقاها الحجا سقي الرياض السحائب
(I carried to him from my tongue a garden, which intellect watered as the clouds water the meadows.)
He separated «سقي» from «السحائب» by the word الرياض, and that was an argument against those who forbid separation. So reflect — while taking into account that the saying of al-Mutanabbī is not a proof.

safi-cedvel:138-139.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (قالوا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma…. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (ها): particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذه): demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أنعام): khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (حرث): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to أنعام by the wāw, nominative. (حجر): naʿt (adjective) of حرث, nominative. (لا): negating. (يطعم): imperfect verb, nominative, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (إلا): particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (من): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil. (نشاء): imperfect verb, nominative … its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "we" (نحن). (بزعم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil in the verb قالوا, i.e. "clothed with their claim", and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (أنعام): khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "they" (هي) «[Note: Or هذه أنعام.]». (حرّمت): past verb, passive … and (التاء) is for the feminine. (ظهور): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative, and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (أنعام): like the last. (لا): negating. (يذكرون): imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (اسم): mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (على): a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يذكرون). (افتراء): mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) «[Note: Or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is a kind of the act, i.e. "saying of fabrication".]», accusative, governed by the verb of saying. (عليه): like عليها, attached to افتراء. (السين): particle of the future. (يجزي): imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (الباء): a preposition of cause. (ما): a maṣdar particle. (كانوا): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogating verb (nāsikh) — indeclinable on the ḍamma … and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of كان. (يفترون): like يذكرون.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا يفترون) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (سيجزيهم).
The clause «قالوا....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «هذه أنعام....» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لا يطعمها» is in the position of the nominative as a naʿt of أنعام and of the conjoined noun.
The clause «نشاء» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «(هي) أنعام» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause that is the object of speech.
The clause «حرّمت ظهورها» is in the position of the nominative as a naʿt of the second أنعام.
The clause «(هي) أنعام (the second)» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause that is the object of speech.
The clause «لا يذكرون ...» is in the position of the nominative as a naʿt of the third أنعام «[Note: This clause is a naʿt of أنعام, but it is not reported as part of their speech; rather, it is presented from Allah the Exalted's side, to specify the thing qualified and distinguish it from others … Hence it is of the type of explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), an answer to an implied question about these third livestock … It is also possible that the clause (أنعام لا يذكرون اسم الله عليها) is resumptive, from Allah the Exalted's direction and not from their sayings.]».
The clause «سيجزيهم....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كانوا يفترون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «يفترون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of كانوا.
(139) (الواو): conjunction. (قالوا): like the first. (ما): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (في بطون): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila of ما. (ها): for alerting. (ذه): demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi. (الأنعام): badal (substitute) of ذه or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), genitive. (خالصة): khabar of the mubtadaʾ ما. (لذكور): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خالصة, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (محرم): maʿṭūf to خالصة, nominative. (على أزواج): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to محرم, and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (إن): a jussive conditional particle. (يكن): an incomplete imperfect verb — an abrogating verb — jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its noun a latent pronoun, implied as "it" (هو), referring to (ما) with regard to its wording. ميتة): khabar of يكون, accusative. (الفاء): connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (في): a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (شركاء), which is the khabar, nominative. (سيجزيهم): like the first. (وصف): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "the recompense of their describing", and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle — and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of إن. (حكيم): khabar of إن, nominative. (عليم): second khabar, nominative.
The clause «قالوا....» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the first clause قالوا.
The clause «ما في بطون....» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech.
The clause «إن يكن ميتة» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause that is the object of speech.
The clause «هم فيه شركاء» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined by the fāʾ.
The clause «سيجزيهم وصفهم» has no grammatical position: explanatory resumption.
The clause «إنّه حكيم....» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(حجر): a derived adjective meaning "forbidden" (maḥjūra); its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.
(افتراء): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the five-letter verb افترى; its pattern is افتعال … and in the noun there is substitution (ibdāl) of the yāʾ into hamza because it came final after a quiescent alif.
(وصف): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb وصف يصف, of the class ضرب; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
1- دار السلام (the Abode of Peace): an expression for Paradise. Several names for one named thing, namely Paradise, occur in the Noble Qur'an; among these names, by way of example and not of exhaustive listing: الجنة, جنة الخلد, دار السلام, جنات عدن, جنة النعيم, and the other names there are. This variety in naming is to extol its greatness, its beauty and the utmost happiness in it.
2- This dialogue taking place between the Lord, Mighty and Majestic, and those of His servants who associated partners with Him has many dimensions and multiple aims in the Qur'an.

safi-cedvel:140-140.t:
* I'rab:
(قد): particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (خسر): past verb. (الذين): relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent). (قتلوا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (أولاد): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (سفها): mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, accusative. (2, 3) In verse (138) of this sūra.]». (بغير): a preposition and its genitive noun, in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) emphasising the content of السفه. (علم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الواو): conjunction. (حرموا): like قتلوا. (ما): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (رزق): like خسر, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (افتراء على الله): the i'rab of its like has already passed «2». (قد): like the first. (ضلّوا): like قتلوا. (الواو): conjunction. (ما): particle of negation. (كانوا): its i'rab has already passed «3». (مهتدين): khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «قد خسر الذين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قتلوا....» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «حرّموا....» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «رزقهم الله» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (ما), the referring pronoun being omitted, its implied form being به.
The clause «قد ضلوا» has no grammatical position: an emphasising resumption.
The clause «ما كانوا مهتدين» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause قد ضلّوا «[Note: Or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl emphasising the content of the preceding clause.]».

* Morphology:
(سفها): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb سفه يسفه, of the class فرح; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.

* Rhetoric:
1- Using the overt noun where a pronoun would be expected (al-iẓhār fī maqām al-iḍmār): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «افْتِراءً عَلَى اللَّهِ», the Majestic Name is made overt in the place of a pronoun to show the extremity of their insolence and transgression.

safi-cedvel:141-141.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (هو): a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). (الذي): relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). (أنشأ): past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو). (جنات): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (معروشات): naʿt (adjective), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (الواو): conjunction. (غير): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to معروشات, accusative. (معروشات): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (النخل، الزرع، الزيتون، الرمان): nouns conjoined to جنات by conjunctions, accusative. (مختلفا): ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of النخل and الزرع. (أكل): fāʿil of the active participle, nominative (marfūʿ), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (متشابها): ḥāl, accusative, of الزيتون and الرّمان. (الواو): conjunction. (غير): maʿṭūf to متشابها, accusative. (متشابه): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (كلوا): imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (من ثمر): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كلوا), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (إذا): an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of the accusative, attached to the content of the apodosis. (أثمر): past verb, and the fāʿil is "it" (هو), referring to الثمر. (الواو): conjunction. (آتوا): like كلوا. (حقّ): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يوم): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (آتوا). (حصاد): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (لا): the jussive lā of prohibition. (تسرفوا): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (إن): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogating particle (nāsikh) — and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of إن. (لا): particle of negation. (يحبّ): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (المسرفين): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «هو الذي ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أنشأ ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «كلوا....» has no grammatical position: explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) or causal.
The clause «أثمر» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi…. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "when it bears fruit, then eat of its fruit".
The clause «آتوا....» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause كلوا.
The clause «لا تسرفوا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause كلوا.
The clause «إنه لا يحب.» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لا يحب المسرفين» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of إن.

* Morphology:
(معروشات): plural of معروشة, feminine of معروش, passive participle of the three-letter verb عرش; its pattern is مفعول.
(مختلفا): active participle of the five-letter verb اختلف; its pattern is مفتعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(حصاد): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb حصد يحصد, of the class نصر and of the class ضرب; its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ … and it may come with kasra on it. There is another maṣdar, حصد, whose pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:100-100.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (جعلوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of شركاء — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies «[Note: The preposition and its genitive noun may be made the second object, with (شركاء) the first object and (الجن) a badal (substitute) of شركاء.]». (شركاء) second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), placed first. (الجن) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (خلق) a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) conjunction. (خرقوا) like جعلوا. (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (خرقوا). (بنين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ, since it is treated like the sound masculine plural. (الواو) conjunction. (بنات) conjoined to بنين, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra, since it is treated like the sound feminine plural. (بغير) a preposition and its genitive noun, in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of خرقوا, i.e. "they fabricated for Him sons and daughters, being ignorant". (علم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (سبحان) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, of an omitted verb, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (تعالى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (عن) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (تعالى) «[Note: (ما) may be a maṣdar particle ... and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive, attached to (تعالى).]», and the resumptive pronoun is omitted. (يصفون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «جعلوا ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «خلقهم»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) assumed.
The clause «خرقوا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «(نسبح) سبحانه»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تعالى ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نسبّح.
The clause «يصفون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(يصفون): it has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the yāʾ of the imperfect and the kasra of the verb's ʿayn, for it is an assimilated (mithāl) weak verb.... Its pattern is يعلون.

safi-cedvel:101-101.t:
* I'rab:
(بديع) the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "he" (هو). (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (الواو) conjunction. (الأرض) conjoined to السموات, genitive like it. (أنى) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as an adverb, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of the defective verb, placed first «[Note: Or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), the governing word being the complete (tāmm) verb يكون.]». (يكون) a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), nominative (marfūʿ). (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a ḥāl of ولد — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies. (ولد) the noun of yakūn, nominative «[Note: Or the fāʿil (agent) of the complete (يكون), nominative.]». (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (لم) negative. (تكن) يخرج like يكون «[Translator's note: so in the source; يخرج is evidently a misprint for يعرب, "is parsed".]», and it is jussive (majzūm). (له) like the first, attached to a khabar placed first — or attached to the complete verb. (صاحبة) like ولد in both cases. (الواو) conjunction. (خلق) a past verb; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو). (كلّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو) conjunction. (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ. (بكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم. (شيء) like the first. (عليم) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو, nominative.
The clause «(هو) بديع....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يكون له ولد»: has no grammatical position, resumptive «[Note: It may be a khabar if (بديع) is parsed as a mubtadaʾ.]».
The clause «لم تكن له صاحبة»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl emphasizing the content of the clause before it. The clause «خلق ...»: in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the circumstantial clause «[Note: Or it has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.]» ...
The clause «هو.... عليم»: in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause خلق «[Note: Or it has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.]».

* Morphology:
(صاحبة): feminine of صاحب, an active participle from the triliteral صحب. Its pattern is فاعلة.

* Benefits:
1- The word «بديع» occurs in the sense of «مبدع» (originator); this is a use of the ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) in place of the active participle. This form occurs in the Noble Qur'an once in the sense of novelty, i.e. bringing a thing into being from the start and without a previous model,
and once in the sense of admirable excellence. Of this is the saying of ʿUmar ibn Abī Rabīʿa:
فأتتها فأخبرتها بعذري ... ثم قالت أتيت أمرا بديعا.
(So she came to her and told her my excuse ... then she said: you have done an extraordinary thing.)

safi-cedvel:104-104.t:
* I'rab:
(قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq). (جاء) a past verb, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بصائر) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (من رب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جاء) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of بصائر.]», and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الفاء) conjunction. (من) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أبصر) a past verb, indeclinable, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو), and the object is omitted, i.e. "saw them". (الفاء) linking the apodosis of the condition. (لنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "his seeing" (إبصاره), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (من عمي) like من أبصر. (الفاء) linking the apodosis of the condition. (على) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a khabar, and the mubtadaʾ is implied, i.e. "his blindness" (عماه). (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negative, operating like laysa. (أنا) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as the noun of mā. (عليكم) like عليها, attached to حفيظ. (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (حفيظ) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of mā.
The clause «جاءكم بصائر....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «من أبصر ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أبصر ...»: in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «1».
The clause «(إبصاره) لنفسه»: in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «من عمي.»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من أبصر.
The clause «عمي.»: in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «2».
The clause «(عماه) عليها»: in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ما أنا ... بحفيظ»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(بصائر): plural of بصيرة, a primitive (jāmid) noun denoting intellect, perspicacity and proof; it may be used in the place of an adjective, as in "جوارحه بصيرة عليه" (his limbs are a witness against him), i.e. bearing witness. Its pattern is فعيلة. In بصائر there is the change of the yāʾ into a hamza, because it came as an augment after a quiescent alif. Its pattern is فعائل.

safi-cedvel:105-105.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (كذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive by the kāf «[Note: The kāf may be a noun in the sense of "like" (مثل), so it is in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its adjective.]», attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e.: "We vary the signs with a varying like that" «[Note: I.e. We vary the signs in other than this sūra with a varying like the varying in this sūra, or We vary them in this sūra as We varied them in others.]»; and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address. (نصرف) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is for majesty. (الآيات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (الواو) conjunction. (اللام) of reason (taʿlīl). (يقولوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām. (درست) a past verb and its fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يقولوا) is in the position of the genitive, attached to the lām [sic], attached to (نصرف).
(الواو) conjunction. (اللام) of reason, or the lām of consequence (lām al-ʿāqiba). (نبيّن) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "We" (نحن), for majesty. (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نبيّن). (يعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نبيّن) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to what the first interpreted maṣdar is attached to, because it is conjoined to it.
The clause «نصرف ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يقولوا....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «درست»: in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «نبينه»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «يعلمون»: in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

* Rhetoric:
1- If you say: what difference is there between the two lāms in «ليقولوا» and «ولنبينه»?
I say: the difference between them is that the first is figurative and the second literal. That is because the signs were varied for the sake of making clear, and were not varied so that they would say "you have studied"; but because this saying came about through the varying of the signs, just as the making clear came about, it was likened to it and so was brought in the same course.

* Benefits:
- وليقولوا درست.
The readings of the word «درست» are many, so that they have been made thirteen readings, differing from one another in strength and weakness; perhaps only three of them are mutawātir:
The first: درست, in the active voice.
The second: درست, the tāʾ being the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine.
The third: دارست, like قاتلت, in the sense of "you have studied with someone other than yourself, O Muḥammad".

safi-cedvel:102-103.t:
* I'rab:
(ذلكم) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), mubtadaʾ (subject); and (اللام) for distance and (كم) for address. (الله) the Name of Majesty, khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) «[Note: Or a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, and the khabar in that case is what follows the Name of Majesty.]». (رب) a second khabar, nominative «[Note: Or a badal of the Name of Majesty if it is a khabar.]». (لا) of generic negation. (إله) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative. (إلا) for exception. (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as a badal of the latent pronoun in the omitted khabar «[Note: Or a badal of the position of lā and its noun, because its position is the nominative ... See the i'rab of verses (163, 255) of Sūrat al-Baqara, verses (1, 6, 18) of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān, and verse (86) of Sūrat al-Nisāʾ.]». (خالق) a fourth khabar, nominative «[Note: Or a badal of ربكم.]». (كل) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition «[Note: Or a conjunction linking the effect to the cause, according to those who conjoin the non-declarative (inshāʾ) to the declarative (khabar); and it is for mere causation according to those who do not permit that.]». (اعبدوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الواو) conjunction. (هو على كل شيء وكيل) like هو بكل شيء عليم «[Note: In verse (101) of this sūra.]».
The clause «ذلكم الله ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا إله إلا هو»: in the position of the nominative as a third khabar of the demonstrative (ذلكم).
The clause «اعبدوه»: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if these are the attributes of Allah, then worship Him".
The clause «هو ... وكيل»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
(103) (لا) negative. (تدرك) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الأبصار) fāʿil, nominative. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ. (يدرك) like تدرك, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (الأبصار) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (الواو) conjunction. (هو) like the previous one. (اللطيف) khabar, nominative. (الخبير) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «لا تدركه الأبصار»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هو يدرك....»: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object pronoun in (تدركه).
The clause «يدرك الأبصار»: in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو).
The clause «هو اللطيف»: in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause هو يدرك.

* Morphology:
(خالق): an active participle from the triliteral خلق. Its pattern is فاعل.
(اللطيف): a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) derived from the verb لطف يلطف, of the bāb نصر. Its pattern is فعيل.

* Rhetoric:
1- The art of "folding and unfolding" (al-laff wa-l-nashr): in this noble verse, for the saying of the Exalted «وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ» is a giving of the reason for the two preceding judgments by way of laff and nashr, i.e. sight does not perceive Him because He is the Subtle (al-Laṭīf), and He perceives all sight because He is the All-Aware (al-Khabīr).
2- The art of antithesis (al-muṭābaqa): that is between the saying of the Exalted «لا تُدْرِكُهُ الْأَبْصارُ» and the saying of the Exalted «وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ الْأَبْصارَ».

* Benefits:
ذا is a demonstrative for the masculine singular. The demonstrative is preceded by the hāʾ, which is a particle of drawing attention,
so one says: هذا, and it points to what is near. The kāf, which is a particle of address, is attached to ذا,
so one said ذلك, and it also points to what is far.

safi-cedvel:142-144.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (من الأنعام): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being أنشأ «[Note: It may be attached to the verb mentioned in the previous verse (أنشأ), in which case there is no new clause.]». (حمولة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الواو): conjunction. (فرشا): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to حمولة, accusative. (كلوا مما): like كلوا من ثمره «[Note: In the previous verse (141).]», and ما is a relative. (رزق): past verb, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (الواو): conjunction. (لا): the jussive lā of prohibition. (تتبعوا): like تسرفوا «1». (خطوات): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (الشيطان): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (إنه): its i'rab has already passed «2». (اللام): a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (عدوّ), which is the khabar (predicate) of إن, nominative. (مبين): naʿt (adjective) of عدو, nominative.
The clause «(أنشأ) من الأنعام حمولة» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أنشأ in the previous verse.
The clause «كلوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive, caused by the preceding speech.
The clause «رزقكم الله» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا تتبعوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause كلوا.
The clause «إنه.... عدوّ» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
(143) (ثمانية): badal (substitute) of حمولة…. accusative like it. (أزواج): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (من الضأن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the implied verb أنشأ — or أنزل — «[Note: Or it is a badal of الأنعام with repetition of the preposition … or it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of اثنين — an adjective placed before what it qualifies — governed by أنشأ.]». (اثنين): badal of (فرشا) «[Note: al-Zamakhsharī and al-ʿUkbarī allowed it to be a badal of (ثمانية أزواج), even though the latter is itself a badal, and that is the apparent view …]», accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ, since it is treated like the dual. (الواو): conjunction. (من المعز اثنين): like من الضأن اثنين. (قل): imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you" (أنت). (الهمزة): for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī). (الذكرين): a fronted mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ. (حرم): past verb, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (أم): a conjunction. (الأنثيين): maʿṭūf to الذكرين, accusative like it, and with the same sign of the accusative. (أم): like the first. (ما): relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative, conjoined to الأنثيين. (اشتملت): past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine. (على): a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (اشتملت). (أرحام): fāʿil, nominative. (الأنثيين): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ. (نبّئوا): imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil, (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بعلم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نبئوني). (إن): a jussive conditional particle. (كنتم): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogating verb (nāsikh) — indeclinable on the sukūn «[Note: In the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).]», and (تم) a pronoun, the noun of كان. (صادقين): khabar, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «حرّم» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اشتملت.... أرحام» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «نبئوني....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position: resumptive … and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then inform me with knowledge".
(144) (الواو): conjunction. (من الإبل اثنين ... أرحام الأنثيين): see the i'rab of its like, من الضأن اثنين ..., above. (أم): the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, meaning بل together with the hamza. (كنتم): like the first. (شهداء): khabar of كنتم, accusative, barred from tanwīn because it is assimilated to words ending in the extended feminine alif, on the pattern فعلاء. (إذ): an adverb of past time, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, attached to شهداء. (وصّى): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الباء): a preposition. (ها): for alerting (tanbīh). (ذا): demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (وصّاكم). (الفاء): resumptive. (من): interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أظلم): khabar, nominative. (من): a preposition. (من): relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to أظلم. (افترى): like وصّى, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو), the referring pronoun. (على الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (افترى). (كذبا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is its synonym, i.e. افترى افتراء.]». (اللام): of purpose (taʿlīl). (يضلّ): imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he" (هو). (الناس): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (بغير): a preposition and its genitive noun, in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl governed by يضلّ «[Note: Or governed by افترى.]», i.e. "he misleads them while ignorant". (علم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إنّ الله لا يهدي القوم): like إنه لا يحب المسرفين «[Note: In verse (141) of this sūra.]». (الظالمين): naʿt of القوم, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «قل....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «حرّم....» is in the position of the accusative as the object of speech.
The clause «اشتملت ... أرحام» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «كنتم شهداء ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «وصاكم الله....» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «من أظلم....» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: It may be the apodosis of an implied condition, linked to what precedes it by a causal link, i.e. "if you speak about Allah other than the truth, then how great is your wrongdoing".]».
The clause «افترى....» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «يضلّ ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «إن الله لا يهدي....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يهدي ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of إن.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يضل ...) is in the position of the genitive by the lām of purpose, attached to (افترى).

* Morphology:
(حمولة): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) for all beasts that carry loads, especially the large ones; its pattern is فعولة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(فرشا): a collective noun for small beasts … Abū Zayd said: it may be a naming by the maṣdar (verbal noun), because it is originally a maṣdar, and it is shared among many meanings. It is said that small beasts were called فرش because from their wool, fur and hair is made what is spread out (yufrash), and this is the point of benefit.
(الضأن): it is said to be the plural of ضائن for the male and ضائنة for the female, and it is said to be a collective noun; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(المعز): what was said about الضأن is said about المعز; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn….
In al-Miṣbāḥ: المعز is a generic noun (ism jins) with no singular from its own root; it is the hairy kind of small cattle; the singular is شاة, which is feminine. The ʿayn takes fatḥa or sukūn. The plural of the form with sukūn is أمعز and معيز, like عبد, أعبد and عبيد. In المعزى the alif is for assimilation (ilḥāq), not for the feminine; hence it takes tanwīn when indefinite and its diminutive is معيز … Also in it: العنز is the female of المعز once a year has passed over it.
(الإبل): a collective noun with no singular from its own root; its pattern is فعل, with two kasras; its plural is آبال.

* Rhetoric:
1- Hyperbole (al-mubālagha): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «قُلْ آلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ», the speech is a denial that Allah the Exalted forbade them anything of these four kinds, and an exposure of their lying in that. The detailing of what is mentioned — the males and females and what is in their wombs — is for hyperbole in refuting them, by directing the denial at every single item of their fabrication.

safi-cedvel:145-145.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you". (لا) a particle of negation. (أجد) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, implied as "I". (في) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أجد). (أوحي) a passive past verb; its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, implied as "it", and it is the referent pronoun. (إلى) a preposition, and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أوحي). (محرّما) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) whose governing word is أجد, accusative (manṣūb); it is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "something forbidden". (على طاعم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (محرّما). (يطعم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, direct object; the fāʿil is "he". (إلا) a particle of exception. (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle. (يكون) an incomplete imperfect verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — in the subjunctive (manṣūb); its noun is a latent pronoun, implied as "it", i.e. the forbidden thing. (ميتة) its predicate, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يكون) is in the position of accusative as the excepted of a disjoined (munqaṭiʿ) or a conjoined (muttaṣil) exception, there being a difference of opinion on that [Note: It may be a badal (substitute) of (محرّما), in the position of accusative.].
(أو) a conjunction. (دما) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ميتة, accusative [Note: Or to the interpreted maṣdar that is accusative as the excepted; likewise the rest of the conjoined nouns.]. (مسفوحا) a naʿt of (دما), accusative. (أو) like the first. (لحم) conjoined to ميتة, accusative. (خنزير) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (الفاء) causal. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator — and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of accusative, the noun of inna. (رجس) its khabar (predicate), nominative. (أو) like the first. (فسقا) conjoined to ميتة, accusative. (أهلّ) a passive past verb; its nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun, implied as "it". (لغير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أهلّ). (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الباء) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أهلّ). (الفاء) resumptive. (من) a conditional noun causing the jussive, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject). (اضطر) like أهلّ, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (غير) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the deputy agent, accusative. (باغ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the omitted yāʾ, because it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ). (الواو) a conjunction. (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to reinforce the negation. (عاد) conjoined to باغ and parsed like it. (الفاء) causal. (إن ربك غفور) like إنه رجس. (رحيم) a second predicate, nominative.
The clause «قل....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا أجد....» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أوحي إليّ....» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «يطعمه» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of طاعم.
The clause «يكون....» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «إنه رجس....» has no grammatical position: parenthetical, giving the cause.
The clause «أهلّ ... » is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (فسقا).
The clause «من اضطرّ ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «اضطر ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «إن ربك غفور» has no grammatical position: causal ... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "then there is no blame on him".

* Morphology:
(أجد): it contains an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by omission: the first radical (fāʾ) was omitted because it is a mithāl weak verb (first radical weak) whose imperfect has kasra on the middle radical; its original form is أوجد ... Its pattern is أعل.
(طاعم): active participle of the triliteral طعم يطعم; its pattern is فاعل.
(مسفوحا): passive participle of the triliteral سفح, on the pattern مفعول.

* Benefits:
1- The foods forbidden in Islam, as in this verse, are four: carrion, blood poured out and shed, the flesh of swine, and what has been dedicated to other than Allah.
As for the Jews, other things were forbidden to them because of their transgression and their departure from what they were commanded; whoever wants the details should refer to the sources of jurisprudence and legislation.

safi-cedvel:146-147.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (على) a preposition. (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حرمنا). (هادوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma .... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (حرّمنا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... (ونا) a pronoun, the fāʿil. (كلّ) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (ذي) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ. (ظفر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو) a conjunction. (من البقر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the (حرّمنا) that follows. (الواو) a conjunction. (الغنم) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to البقر, genitive. (حرّمنا) like the first. (عليهم) a preposition and a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the second (حرّمنا). (شحوم) a direct object, accusative, and (هما) a pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (إلّا) a particle of exception. (ما) a relative noun [Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by what follows (nakira mawṣūfa), in the position of accusative.], indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the excepted. (حملت) a past verb .... and (التاء) for the feminine. (ظهور) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هما) like the first. (أو) a conjunction. (الحوايا) conjoined to ظهورهما [Note: What the backs carry, what the entrails carry and what is mixed with bone was not forbidden.], nominative; the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif [Note: (الحوايا) may be conjoined to ما, so it is in the position of accusative, or to الشحوم, so that they too are forbidden.]. (أو) a conjunction. (ما اختلط) like ما حملت and conjoined to it; the fāʿil is "it", the referent pronoun. (بعظم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اختلط). (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a fronted direct object whose governing word is جزيناهم ... or it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "the matter is that".]; the reference is to the prohibition, (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address. (جزينا) like حرّمنا, and (هم) a pronoun, direct object. (ببغي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جزينا); the bāʾ is causal, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) resumptive. (إن) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (نا) a pronoun in the position of accusative, the noun of inna. (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis. (صادقون) the khabar of inna, nominative; the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «هادوا....»: no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «حرّمنا (the first): no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «حرّمنا (the second)»: no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «حملت ظهورهما»: no grammatical position, the ṣila of the first relative (ما). The clause «اختلط....»: no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «ذلك جزيناهم»: no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «جزيناهم ... »: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلك); the linking pronoun is omitted, its implied form being "for it" (به) [Note: If the demonstrative is the object of the verb, the verbal clause is resumptive.].
The clause «إنّا لصادقون»: no grammatical position, resumptive.
(147) (الفاء) a conjunction. (إن) a conditional particle causing the jussive. (كذّبوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) ... the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الكاف) a pronoun, direct object. (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (قل) an imperative verb; the fāʿil is "you". (ربّ) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (ذو) khabar, nominative; the sign of the nominative is the wāw. (رحمة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (واسعة) a naʿt (adjective) of رحمة, genitive. (الواو) a conjunction. (لا) a particle of negation. (يردّ) a passive imperfect verb, nominative. (بأس) the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (عن القوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يردّ). (المجرمين) a naʿt of القوم, genitive; the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «كذّبوك»: no grammatical position, conjoined to the earlier resumptive clause [Note: قل لا أجد, in verse (145) of this sūra; in that case what lies between them is a parenthesis.].
The clause «قل....»: in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ربكم ذو رحمة....»: in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لا يردّ بأسه ... »: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause of the speech reported [Note: Or it has no grammatical position, resumptive, if the speech goes outside the scope of what the Messenger (ṣ) says.].

* Morphology:
(ظفر): a primitive (jāmid) noun; its pattern is فعل with two ḍammas. It has other dialectal forms: ظفر with ḍamma then sukūn, ظفر with two kasras, ظفر with kasra then sukūn, and أظفور with ḍamma on the hamza. The plural of the triliteral is أظفار, and the plural of أظفور is أظافير and أظافر.
(الغنم): a generic noun (ism jins) whose singular is شاة; it has the form of the maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb غنم, of the فرح class; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.
(شحوم): plural of شحم, a primitive noun for fat; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; a piece of it is شحمة.
(الحوايا): plural of حاوياء or حاوية; حويّة, like هديّة, is also permissible. If the singular is حاويا or حاوية, the pattern of الحوايا is فواعل, and the original form is حواوي, like صواري: the second wāw was changed into a hamza with fatḥa, حواءي; the yāʾ was voweled and the letter before it had fatḥa, so it was changed into an alif, حواءى; then the hamza was changed into a yāʾ because it fell between two alifs, giving حوايا.
If the singular is حويّة, the pattern of الحوايا is فعائل, like طرائق, and the original form is حوائي: the hamza was changed into a yāʾ with kasra, then that yāʾ was given fatḥa, then the second yāʾ, which is the final radical (lām) of the word, was changed into an alif, so it became حوايا.
[Translator's note: The source lists the singulars as حاوياء or حاوية and then says "if the singular is حاويا or حاوية"; translated as written.]
(عظم): a noun for the well-known body part, primitive; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; its singular (unit noun) is عظمة, on the measure فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
1- His saying, the Exalted, «ذلِكَ جَزَيْناهُمْ»: there are several views on the i'rab of ذلك. It is said: a mubtadaʾ, i.e. "that prohibition — We recompensed them with it". It is said: it is accusative as a maṣdar, since there is something similar in the speech of the Arabs, as in their saying ظننت ذلك, i.e. that supposition. And it is said: the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "the matter is that".
